note.basic_zh:
生命骰：1d12
豁免：力量、體魄
note.basic_en:
Hit Dice: 1d12
Saving Throw: STR, CON
note.lvl01_details_zh:
熟練

• 護甲：輕甲、中甲、盾牌
• 武器：簡易武器、軍用武器
• 技能：從動物馴養、運動、威嚇、自然、觀察、生存中選擇兩項

起始裝備

• 巨斧，或任一軍用近戰武器
• 兩把手斧，或任一簡易武器
• 探險者套組與四把標槍

狂怒

你可用附贈動作進入狂怒。未穿著重甲時，獲得以下效果：

• 力量檢定與力量豁免具有優勢
• 以力量進行近戰武器攻擊並命中時，傷害獲得狂怒加值
• 對鈍擊、穿刺與揮砍傷害具有抗性

狂怒持續 1 分鐘，也可用附贈動作提早結束。狂怒期間無法施法或專注於法術。1 級時，每次長休前可狂怒兩次；次數會隨等級提高。

無甲防禦

未穿著護甲時，護甲等級為 10 + 敏捷調整值 + 體魄調整值。使用盾牌不會失去此效果。
note.lvl01_details_en:
Proficiencies

• Armor: Light armor, medium armor, and shields
• Weapons: Simple and martial weapons
• Skills: Choose two from Animal Handling, Athletics, Intimidation, Nature, Perception, and Survival

Starting Equipment

• A greataxe or any martial melee weapon
• Two handaxes or any simple weapon
• An explorer's pack and four javelins

Rage

You can enter a rage as a bonus action. While not wearing heavy armor, you gain these benefits:

• Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws
• A rage damage bonus when you hit with a melee weapon attack using Strength
• Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage

Rage lasts for 1 minute, and you can also end it early as a bonus action. You cannot cast or concentrate on spells while raging. At 1st level, you can rage twice per long rest; this number increases with level.

Unarmored Defense

While not wearing armor, your Armor Class equals 10 + Dexterity modifier + Constitution modifier. You can still use a shield and gain this benefit.
note.lvl02_details_zh:
危險意識

在第二級，當附近的事物不正常時，你會獲得一種不可思議的感覺，這讓你在躲避危險時獲得優勢。對於你能看到的效果，例如陷阱和法術，你在敏捷豁免檢定上有優勢。為了獲得這種好處，你不能失明、耳聾或喪失能力。

魯莽攻擊

從第 2 級開始，你可以拋開所有防禦的顧慮，進行猛烈的絕望攻擊。當你在回合中進行第一次攻擊時，你可以決定魯莽地攻擊。這樣做可以讓你在本回合使用力量進行近戰武器攻擊檢定時獲得優勢，但對你的攻擊檢定在你的下一個回合之前具有優勢。
note.lvl02_details_en:
Danger Sense

At 2nd level, you gain an uncanny sense of when things nearby aren't as they should be, giving you an edge when you dodge away from danger. You have advantage on Dexterity saving throws against effects that you can see, such as traps and spells. To gain this benefit, you can't be blinded, deafened, or incapacitated.

Reckless Attack

Starting at 2nd level, you can throw aside all concern for defense to attack with fierce desperation. When you make your first attack on your turn, you can decide to attack recklessly. Doing so gives you advantage on melee weapon attack rolls using Strength during this turn, but attack rolls against you have advantage until your next turn.
note.lvl03_details_zh:
原始路徑

在第三級，你從可用路徑清單中選擇一條塑造你的狂怒本質的路徑。你的選擇將授予你第 3 級以及第 6、10 和 14 級的特性。

原始路徑選項

狂戰士道途

對某些野蠻人來說，狂怒是達到目的的手段──這個目的就是暴力。狂戰士之路是一條不受約束的狂怒之路，充滿鮮血。當你進入狂戰士之怒時，你會在戰鬥的混亂中感到興奮，不顧自己的健康或福祉。

狂亂

從第3級選擇這條路開始，當你狂怒時，你會陷入狂亂。如果你這樣做，在你的狂怒持續時間內，你可以在這之後的每個回合中進行一次近戰武器攻擊，作為附贈動作。當你的狂怒結束時，你會感到某種程度的力竭。

圖騰勇士道途

圖騰勇士之路是一次靈性之旅，因為野蠻人接受精神動物作為嚮導、保護者和靈感。在戰鬥中，你的圖騰靈魂會為你注入超自然的力量，為你的野蠻狂怒增添魔法燃料。

大多數野蠻部落認為圖騰動物是特定氏族的親屬。在這種情況下，一個人擁有多個圖騰獸靈是不尋常的，但也有例外。

靈魂探索者

你的道路尋求與自然世界的協調，讓你與野獸有親緣關係。在第 3 級，當你採用這條道路時，你獲得了施展野獸感知和與動物交談法術的能力，但只能作為儀式，如第 10 章所述。

圖騰精神

在第3級，當你選擇這條道路時，你選擇了一個圖騰精神並獲得了它的特徵。你必須製作或獲得一個實體圖騰物品——護身符或類似的裝飾品——其中包含圖騰動物的毛皮或羽毛、爪子、牙齒或骨頭。根據你的選擇，你還可以獲得一些次要的身體屬性，這些屬性會讓人想起你的圖騰精神。例如，如果你有熊圖騰精神​​，你可能會異常多毛和厚皮膚，或者如果你的圖騰是鷹，你的眼睛會變成亮黃色。

你的圖騰動物可能與此處列出的動物有關，但更適合你的祖國。例如，你可以選擇鷹或禿鷹來代替老鷹。

熊

狂怒時，你對心靈傷害以外的所有傷害都有抵抗力。熊的精神使你夠堅強，能夠承受任何懲罰。

鷹

當你狂怒且沒有穿著重甲時，其他生物在針對你的機會攻擊檢定上處於劣勢，並且你可以在你的回合中使用衝刺動作作為附贈動作。鷹的精神使你成為掠食者，可以輕鬆地在戰鬥中穿梭。

麋鹿

當你狂怒且沒有穿著重甲時，你的行走速度會增加 15 呎。麋鹿的精神使你異常敏捷。

虎

在狂怒時，你的跳遠距離可以增加 10 呎，跳高距離可以增加 3 呎。老虎的精神賦予你跳躍的力量。

狼

當你狂怒時，你的朋友在對你 5 呎內任何對你有敵意的生物進行近戰攻擊檢定時具有優勢。狼的精神使你成為獵人的領袖。
note.lvl03_details_en:
Primal Path

At 3rd level, you choose a path that shapes the nature of your rage from the list of available paths. Your choice grants you features at 3rd level and again at 6th, 10th, and 14th levels.

Primal Path Options

Path of the Berserker

For some barbarians, rage is a means to an end—that end being violence. The Path of the Berserker is a path of untrammeled fury, slick with blood. As you enter the berserker's rage, you thrill in the chaos of battle, heedless of your own health or well-being.

Frenzy

Starting when you choose this path at 3rd level, you can go into a frenzy when you rage. If you do so, for the duration of your rage you can make a single melee weapon attack as a bonus action on each of your turns after this one. When your rage ends, you suffer one level of exhaustion.

Path of the Totem Warrior

The Path of the Totem Warrior is a spiritual journey, as the barbarian accepts a spirit animal as guide, protector, and inspiration. In battle, your totem spirit fills you with supernatural might, adding magical fuel to your barbarian rage.

Most barbarian tribes consider a totem animal to be kin to a particular clan. In such cases, it is unusual for an individual to have more than one totem animal spirit, though exceptions exist.

Spirit Seeker

Yours is a path that seeks attunement with the natural world, giving you a kinship with beasts. At 3rd level when you adopt this path, you gain the ability to cast the beast sense and speak with animals spells, but only as rituals, as described in chapter 10.

Totem Spirit

At 3rd level, when you adopt this path, you choose a totem spirit and gain its feature. You must make or acquire a physical totem object—an amulet or similar adornment—that incorporates fur or feathers, claws, teeth, or bones of the totem animal. At your option, you also gain minor physical attributes that are reminiscent of your totem spirit. For example, if you have a bear totem spirit, you might be unusually hairy and thick-skinned, or if your totem is the eagle, your eyes turn bright yellow.

Your totem animal might be an animal related to those listed here but more appropriate to your homeland. For example, you could choose a hawk or vulture in place of an eagle.

Bear

While raging, you have resistance to all damage except psychic damage. The spirit of the bear makes you tough enough to stand up to any punishment.

Eagle

While you're raging and aren't wearing heavy armor, other creatures have disadvantage on opportunity attack rolls against you, and you can use the Dash action as a bonus action on your turn. The spirit of the eagle makes you into a predator who can weave through the fray with ease.

Elk

While you're raging and aren't wearing heaving armor, your walking speed increases by 15 feet. The spirit of the elk makes you extraordinarily swift.

Tiger

While raging, you can add 10 feet to your long jump distance and 3 feet to your high jump distance. The spirit of the tiger empowers your leaps.

Wolf

While you're raging, your friends have advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature within 5 feet of you that is hostile to you. The spirit of the wolf makes you a leader of hunters.
note.lvl04_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到4級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl04_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 4th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl05_details_zh:
額外攻擊

從第 5 級開始，每當你在自己的回合中採取攻擊行動時，你可以攻擊兩次，而不是一次。

快速移動

從第 5 級開始，當你不穿著重甲時，你的速度會增加 10 呎。
note.lvl05_details_en:
Extra Attack

Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

Fast Movement

Starting at 5th level, your speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing heavy armor.
note.lvl06_details_zh:
路徑特徵

在第 6 級，你從原始路徑中獲得一項特性。

原始路徑選項

狂戰士道途

無心之怒

從等級 6 開始，你在狂怒時無法被魅惑或驚嚇。如果你在進入狂怒狀態時受到魅惑或恐懼，則效果會在狂怒持續時間內暫停。

圖騰勇士道途

野獸之面

在第 6 級，你將根據你選擇的圖騰動物獲得神奇的好處。你可以選擇與第 3 級選擇的動物相同的動物，也可以選擇不同的動物。

熊

你獲得了熊的力量。你的承載能力（包括最大負載和最大升力）加倍，並且你在推、拉、舉起或打破物體的力量檢定中具有優勢。

鷹

你獲得了鷹的視力。你可以毫無困難地看到 1 英里以外的地方，甚至能夠辨別細微的細節，就像看著距離你不超過 100 呎的東西一樣。此外，昏暗的光線不會對你的感知（感知）檢查造成不利影響。

麋鹿

無論騎馬還是步行，你的行進速度都會加倍，最多 10 個同伴在距你 60 呎以內且你沒有喪失行動能力的情況下，行進速度也會加倍。麋鹿精神可以幫助你漫遊又遠又快。

虎

你可以熟練以下清單中的兩項技能：田徑、雜技、潛行和生存。貓精神磨練你的生存本能。

狼

你獲得了狼的狩獵敏感性。你可以在快速行進時追蹤其他生物，也可以在正常速度行進時隱密移動。
note.lvl06_details_en:
Path Feature

At 6th level, you gain a feature from your Primal Path.

Primal Path Options

Path of the Berserker

Mindless Rage

Beginning at 6th level, you can't be charmed or frightened while raging. If you are charmed or frightened when you enter your rage, the effect is suspended for the duration of the rage.

Path of the Totem Warrior

Aspect of the Beast

At 6th level, you gain a magical benefit based on the totem animal of your choice. You can choose the same animal you selected at 3rd level or a different one.

Bear

You gain the might of a bear. Your carrying capacity (including maximum load and maximum lift) is doubled, and you have advantage on Strength checks made to push, pull, lift, or break objects.

Eagle

You gain the eyesight of an eagle. You can see up to 1 mile away with no difficulty, able to discern even fine details as though looking at something no more than 100 feet away from you. Additionally, dim light doesn't impose disadvantage on your Wisdom (Perception) checks.

Elk

Whether mounted or on foot, your travel pace is doubled, as is the travel pace of up to ten companions while they're within 60 feet of you and you're not incapacitated. The elk spirit helps you roam far and fast.

Tiger

You gain proficiency in two skills from the following list: Athletics, Acrobatics, Stealth, and Survival. The cat spirit hones your survival instincts.

Wolf

You gain the hunting sensibilities of a wolf. You can track other creatures while traveling at a fast pace, and you can move stealthily while traveling at a normal pace.
note.lvl07_details_zh:
野性本能

到了 7 級，你的直覺已經磨練，你在主動擲骰上有優勢。

此外，如果你在戰鬥開始時感到驚訝並且沒有喪失行為能力，那麼你可以在第一個回合中正常行動，但前提是你在該回合中先進入狂怒狀態，然後再做任何其他事情。
note.lvl07_details_en:
Feral Instinct

By 7th level, your instincts are so honed that you have advantage on initiative rolls.

Additionally, if you are surprised at the beginning of combat and aren't incapacitated, you can act normally on your first turn, but only if you enter your rage before doing anything else on that turn.
note.lvl08_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到8級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 使用可選專長，你可以選擇一項專長。
note.lvl08_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 8th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM uses the optional Feats, you can instead take a feat.
note.lvl09_details_zh:
殘酷致命 (1 die)

從第 9 級開始，在確定近戰攻擊的致命一擊的額外傷害時，你可以擲出一個額外的武器傷害骰子。

這會在 13 級時增加兩個骰子，在 17 級時增加三個骰子。
note.lvl09_details_en:
Brutal Critical (1 die)

Beginning at 9th level, you can roll one additional weapon damage die when determining the extra damage for a critical hit with a melee attack.

This increases to two additional dice at 13th level and three additional dice at 17th level.
note.lvl10_details_zh:
路徑特徵

在第 10 級時，你從原始路徑中獲得一項特性。

原始路徑選項

狂戰士道途

令人生畏的存在

從第 10 級開始，你可以用你的行動用你的威脅性的存在來嚇唬別人。當你這樣做時，選擇一個你在 30 呎範圍內可以看到的生物。如果該生物能看到或聽到你，它必須通過感知豁免檢定（DC等於8+你的熟練加值+你的魅力調整值），否則就會害怕你，直到你的下回合結束。在隨後的回合中，你可以使用你的行動來延長受驚生物身上的此效果的持續時間，直到你的下一個回合結束。如果生物在視線之外或距離你超過 60 呎時結束回合，則此效果結束。

如果生物成功通過豁免檢定，則你在 24 小時內無法再次對該生物使用此特性。

圖騰勇士道途

靈魂行者

10級時，你可以施放自然公社法術，但只能作為儀式。當你這樣做時，你為圖騰之靈或野獸之相選擇的動物之一的精神版本會出現在你面前，傳達你所尋求的信息。
note.lvl10_details_en:
Path feature

At 10th level, you gain a feature from your Primal Path.

Primal Path Options

Path of the Berserker

Intimidating Presence

Beginning at 10th level, you can use your action to frighten someone with your menacing presence. When you do so, choose one creature that you can see within 30 feet of you. If the creature can see or hear you, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier) or be frightened of you until the end of your next turn. On subsequent turns, you can use your action to extend the duration of this effect on the frightened creature until the end of your next turn. This effect ends if the creature ends its turn out of line of sight or more than 60 feet away from you.

If the creature succeeds on its saving throw, you can't use this feature on that creature again for 24 hours.

Path of the Totem Warrior

Spirit Walker

At 10th level, you can cast the commune with nature spell, but only as a ritual. When you do so, a spiritual version of one of the animals you chose for Totem Spirit or Aspect of the Beast appears to you to convey the information you seek.
note.lvl11_details_zh:
無情的狂怒

從 11 級開始，你的狂怒可以讓你在受重傷的情況下繼續戰鬥。如果你在狂怒時生命值降至 0 並且沒有直接死亡，你可以進行 DC 10 的體質豁免。如果你成功了，你的生命值就會降到 1。

第一次使用此特性後，每次使用此特性，DC 都會增加 5。當你完成短暫或長休後，DC 會重設為 10。
note.lvl11_details_en:
Relentless Rage

Starting at 11th level, your rage can keep you fighting despite grievous wounds. If you drop to 0 hit points while you're raging and don't die outright, you can make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. If you succeed, you drop to 1 hit point instead.

Each time you use this feature after the first, the DC increases by 5. When you finish a short or long rest, the DC resets to 10.
note.lvl12_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到12級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 使用可選專長，你可以選擇一項專長。
note.lvl12_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 12th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM uses the optional Feats, you can instead take a feat.
note.lvl13_details_zh:
殘酷關鍵（2 顆骰子）

現在，在確定近戰攻擊的致命一擊的額外傷害時，你可以擲兩個額外的武器傷害骰子。
note.lvl13_details_en:
Brutal Critical (2 dice)

You now roll two additional weapon damage dice when determining the extra damage for a critical hit with a melee attack.
note.lvl14_details_zh:
路徑特徵

在 14 級時，你從原始路徑中獲得一項特性。

原始路徑選項

狂戰士道途

報復

從 14 級開始，當你受到距你 5 呎以內的生物傷害。你可以利用你的反應對該生物進行近戰武器攻擊。

圖騰勇士道途

圖騰調和

在第 14 級，你將獲得基於你選擇的圖騰動物的魔法好處。你可以選擇與先前選擇的動物相同或不同的動物。

熊

當你狂怒時，任何距離你 5 呎以內對你有敵意的生物在針對你或其他具有此特性的角色以外的目標的攻擊檢定上都會處於劣勢。如果敵人看不到或聽不到你或不能被嚇到，那麼它就不會受到此效果的影響。

鷹

狂怒時，你的飛行速度等於你目前的步行速度。這種好處只能在短時間內發揮作用；如果你在空中結束轉彎而沒有其他東西支撐你，你就會墜落。

麋鹿

狂怒時，你可以在移動過程中使用附贈動作穿過大型或小型生物的空間。該生物必須成功通過力量豁免檢定（DC 8 + 你的力量加值 + 你的熟練加值），否則就會被擊倒並受到等於 1d12 + 你的力量調整值的鈍擊傷害。

虎

當你狂怒時，如果你在對大型或小型目標進行近戰武器攻擊之前向其直線移動至少 20 呎，則可以使用附贈動作對其進行額外的近戰武器攻擊。

狼

當你狂怒時，當你用近戰武器攻擊擊中大型或小型生物時，你可以在回合中使用附贈動作將其擊倒。
note.lvl14_details_en:
Path feature

At 14th level, you gain a feature from your Primal Path.

Primal Path Options

Path of the Berserker

Retaliation

Starting at 14th level, when you take damage from a creature that is within 5 feet of you. you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against that creature.

Path of the Totem Warrior

Totemic Attunement

At 14th level, you gain a magical benefit based on a totem animal of your choice. You can choose the same animal you selected previously or a different one.

Bear

While you're raging, any creature within 5 feet of you that's hostile to you has disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than you or another character with this feature. An enemy is immune to this effect if it can't see or hear you or if it can't be frightened.

Eagle

While raging, you have a flying speed equal to your current walking speed. This benefit works only in short bursts; you fall if you end your turn in the air and nothing else is holding you aloft.

Elk

While raging, you can use a bonus action during your move to pass through the space of a Large or smaller creature. That creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + your Strength bonus + your proficiency bonus) or be knocked prone and take bludgeoning damage equal to 1d12 + your strength modifier.

Tiger

While you're raging, if you move at least 20 feet in a straight line toward a Large or smaller target right before making a melee weapon attack against it, you can use a bonus action to make an additional melee weapon attack against it.

Wolf

While you're raging, you can use a bonus action on your turn to knock a Large or smaller creature prone when you hit it with melee weapon attack.
note.lvl15_details_zh:
持續的狂怒

從 15 級開始，你的狂怒如此猛烈，只有當你失去知覺或選擇結束它時，它才會提前結束。
note.lvl15_details_en:
Persistent Rage

Beginning at 15th level, your rage is so fierce that it ends early only if you fall unconscious or if you choose to end it.
note.lvl16_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到16級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 使用可選專長，你可以選擇一項專長。
note.lvl16_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 16th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM uses the optional Feats, you can instead take a feat.
note.lvl17_details_zh:
殘酷關鍵（3 顆骰子）

現在，在確定近戰攻擊的致命一擊的額外傷害時，你可以擲出三個額外的武器傷害骰子。
note.lvl17_details_en:
Brutal Critical (3 dice)

You now roll three additional weapon damage dice when determining the extra damage for a critical hit with a melee attack.
note.lvl18_details_zh:
不屈的力量

從 18 級開始，如果你的力量檢定總分低於你的力量分數，你可以使用該分數來代替總分。
note.lvl18_details_en:
Indomitable Might

Beginning at 18th level, if your total for a Strength check is less than your Strength score, you can use that score in place of the total.
note.lvl19_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到19級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 使用可選專長，你可以選擇一項專長。
note.lvl19_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 19th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM uses the optional Feats, you can instead take a feat.
note.lvl20_details_zh:
原始冠軍

20級時，你體現了荒野的力量。你的力量和體質分數增加 4。你這些分數的最大值現在為 24。
note.lvl20_details_en:
Primal Champion

At 20th level, you embody the power of the wilds. Your Strength and Constitution scores increase by 4. Your maximum for those scores is now 24.

note.basic_zh:
生命骰：1d8
豁免：敏捷、魅力
note.basic_en:
Hit Dice: 1d8
Saving Throw: DEX, CHA
note.lvl01_details_zh:
熟練

• 護甲：輕甲
• 武器：簡易武器、手弩、長劍、細劍、短劍
• 工具：任選三種樂器
• 技能：任選三項

起始裝備

• 細劍、長劍或任一簡易武器
• 外交官套組或藝人套組
• 魯特琴或任一樂器
• 皮甲與匕首

施法

• 施法能力：魅力
• 法術豁免 DC：8 + 熟練加值 + 魅力調整值
• 法術攻擊加值：熟練加值 + 魅力調整值
• 戲法：從吟遊詩人法術表選擇兩個
• 1 環法術：從吟遊詩人法術表選擇四個
• 升級時，可將一個已知法術替換為另一個符合條件的吟遊詩人法術
• 可使用樂器作為施法法器

吟遊激勵

吟遊激勵的使用次數等於魅力調整值，至少一次，完成長休後恢復。你可用附贈動作選擇 60 呎內一名能聽見你的其他生物；該生物在 10 分鐘內可將一顆吟遊激勵骰（1 級時為 d6）加到一次能力檢定、攻擊檢定或豁免結果中。
note.lvl01_details_en:
Proficiencies

• Armor: Light armor
• Weapons: Simple weapons, hand crossbows, longswords, rapiers, and shortswords
• Tools: Three musical instruments of your choice
• Skills: Any three

Starting Equipment

• A rapier, longsword, or any simple weapon
• A diplomat's pack or entertainer's pack
• A lute or any other musical instrument
• Leather armor and a dagger

Spellcasting

• Spellcasting Ability: Charisma
• Spell Save DC: 8 + proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier
• Spell Attack Modifier: proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier
• Cantrips: Choose two from the bard spell list
• 1st-Level Spells: Choose four from the bard spell list
• When you gain a level, you can replace one known spell with another eligible bard spell
• You can use a musical instrument as a spellcasting focus

Bardic Inspiration

You can use Bardic Inspiration a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier, with a minimum of once, and regain all uses after a long rest. As a bonus action, choose another creature within 60 feet that can hear you. Within 10 minutes, it can add one Bardic Inspiration die—a d6 at 1st level—to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw.
note.lvl02_details_zh:
萬事通

從第 2 級開始，你可以將一半的熟練加值（無條件捨去）添加到你進行的任何不包括熟練加值的能力檢查中。

安息之歌 (d6)

從第 2 級開始，你可以在短休期間使用舒緩的音樂或演講來幫助受傷的盟友恢復活力。如果你或任何能聽到你表演的友方生物在短休結束時透過花費生命骰來恢復生命值，那麼每個生物都會額外恢復 1d6 生命值。

當你達到該職業的特定等級時，額外生命值會增加：9級時增加到1d8，13級時增加到1d10，17級時增加到1d12。
note.lvl02_details_en:
Jack of All Trades

Starting at 2nd level, you can add half your proficiency bonus, rounded down, to any ability check you make that doesn't already include your proficiency bonus.

Song of Rest (d6)

Beginning at 2nd level, you can use soothing music or oration to help revitalize your wounded allies during a short rest. If you or any friendly creatures who can hear your performance regain hit points by spending Hit Dice at the end of the short rest, each of those creatures regains an extra 1d6 hit points.

The extra hit points increase when you reach certain levels in this class: to 1d8 at 9th level, to 1d10 at 13th level, and to 1d12 at 17th level.
note.lvl03_details_zh:
吟遊學院

在第三級，你可以從可用學院清單中深入研究你選擇的吟遊詩人學院的先進技術。你的選擇將授予你第 3 級以及第 6 級和第 14 級的特性。

專業知識

在第 3 級，選擇你的兩項技能熟練程度。對於你使用任一所選熟練程度進行的任何能力檢查，你的熟練加值都會加倍。

在 10 級時，你可以選擇另外兩種技能熟練程度來獲得此好處。

吟遊學院選項

逸聞學院

知識學院的吟遊詩人對大多數事情都有所了解，他們從學術著作和農民故事等不同來源收集知識。無論是在酒館裡唱民歌，或是在宮廷裡吟唱精美的樂曲，這些吟遊詩人都會利用他們的天賦讓觀眾著迷。當掌聲平息後，觀眾可能會發現自己開始質疑自己所認為的一切，從對當地寺廟祭司的信仰到對國王的忠誠。

這些吟遊詩人的忠誠在於對美和真理的追求，而不是對君主的效忠或對神的信條的追隨。聘請這樣的吟遊詩人作為傳令官或顧問的貴族知道，吟遊詩人寧願誠實，也不願講政治。

學院的成員聚集在圖書館，有時甚至是真正的學院，有教室和宿舍，互相分享知識。他們還在節日或國家事務中見面，在那裡他們可以揭露腐敗，揭穿謊言，並嘲笑自以為是的權威人物。

加值熟練程度

當你進入第三級知識學院時，你可以熟練你選擇的三項技能。

切詞

同樣在第三級，你將學習如何運用你的智慧來分散、迷惑或削弱他人的信心和能力。當你在 60 呎內可以看到的生物進行攻擊檢定、能力檢定或傷害檢定時，你可以使用你的反應來消耗你的吟遊靈感的使用次數，投擲一個吟遊靈感骰子，並從該生物的擲骰中減去擲出的數字。你可以選擇在生物進行檢定之後、DM 確定攻擊檢定或能力檢定成功或失敗之前，或是在生物造成傷害之前使用此特性。如果該生物聽不到你的聲音或免疫被魅惑，則該生物免疫。

勇氣學院

英勇學院的吟遊詩人是勇敢的吟遊詩人，他們的故事讓過去偉大英雄的記憶永存，從而激勵了新一代的英雄。這些吟遊詩人聚集在蜂蜜酒大廳或營火周圍，歌頌過去和現在的偉人的事蹟。他們走遍這片土地，親眼目睹重大事件，並確保這些事件的記憶不會從世界上消失。他們用歌曲激勵其他人達到與古代英雄相同的成就高度。

加值熟練程度

當你在第 3 級加入英勇學院時，你將熟練中型盔甲、盾牌和軍用武器。

戰鬥靈感

同樣在第三級，你學會在戰鬥中激勵他人。擁有吟遊詩人靈感骰子的生物可以擲骰子並將擲出的數字加到它剛剛進行的武器傷害擲骰中。或者，當該生物進行攻擊檢定時，它可以在看到檢定之後但在知道它是否擊中或未擊中之前，使用其反應來投擲吟遊詩人靈感骰子，並將投擲的數字添加到其對抗該攻擊的AC中。
note.lvl03_details_en:
Bard College

At 3rd level, you delve into the advanced techniques of a bard college of your choice from the list of available colleges. Your choice grants you features at 3rd level and again at 6th and 14th level.

Expertise

At 3rd level, choose two of your skill proficiencies. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of the chosen proficiencies.

At 10th level, you can choose another two skill proficiencies to gain this benefit.

Bard College Options

College of Lore

Bards of the College of Lore know something about most things, collecting bits of knowledge from sources as diverse as scholarly tomes and peasant tales. Whether singing folk ballads in taverns or elaborate compositions in royal courts, these bards use their gifts to hold audiences spellbound. When the applause dies down, the audience members might find themselves questioning everything they held to be true, from their faith in the priesthood of the local temple to their loyalty to the king.

The loyalty of these bards lies in the pursuit of beauty and truth, not in fealty to a monarch or following the tenets of a deity. A noble who keeps such a bard as a herald or advisor knows that the bard would rather be honest than politic.

The college's members gather in libraries and sometimes in actual colleges, complete with classrooms and dormitories, to share their lore with one another. They also meet at festivals or affairs of state, where they can expose corruption, unravel lies, and poke fun at self-important figures of authority.

Bonus Proficiencies

When you join the College of Lore at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with three skills of your choice.

Cutting Words

Also at 3rd level, you learn how to use your wit to distract, confuse, and otherwise sap the confidence and competence of others. When a creature that you can see within 60 feet of you makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a damage roll, you can use your reaction to expend one of your uses of Bardic Inspiration, rolling a Bardic Inspiration die and subtracting the number rolled from the creature's roll. You can choose to use this feature after the creature makes its roll, but before the DM determines whether the attack roll or ability check succeeds or fails, or before the creature deals its damage. The creature is immune if it can't hear you or if it's immune to being charmed.

College of Valor

Bards of the College of Valor are daring skalds whose tales keep alive the memory of the great heroes of the past, and thereby inspire a new generation of heroes. These bards gather in mead halls or around great bonfires to sing the deeds of the mighty, both past and present. They travel the land to witness great events firsthand and to ensure that the memory of those events doesn't pass from the world. With their songs, they inspire others to reach the same heights of accomplishment as the heroes of old.

Bonus Proficiencies

When you join the College of Valor at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with medium armor, shields, and martial weapons.

Combat Inspiration

Also at 3rd level, you learn to inspire others in battle. A creature that has a Bardic Inspiration die from you can roll that die and add the number rolled to a weapon damage roll it just made. Alternatively, when an attack roll is made against the creature, it can use its reaction to roll the Bardic Inspiration die and add the number rolled to its AC against that attack, after seeing the roll but before knowing whether it hits or misses.
note.lvl04_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到4級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl04_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 4th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl05_details_zh:
吟遊詩人的靈感 (d8)

在第 5 級，你的吟遊詩人靈感骰子變成 d8。

靈感字體

從你達到第 5 級開始，當你完成短期或長期休息時，你會恢復所有已消耗的吟遊詩人靈感的使用量。
note.lvl05_details_en:
Bardic Inspiration (d8)

At 5th level, your Bardic Inspiration die changes to a d8.

Font of Inspiration

Beginning when you reach 5th level, you regain all of your expended uses of Bardic Inspiration when you finish a short or long rest.
note.lvl06_details_zh:
反魅惑

在第 6 級，你獲得使用音符或力量話語來破壞影響心靈的效果的能力。作為一個動作，你可以開始一場持續到下一個回合結束的表演。在此期間，你和周圍 30 呎內的任何友方生物在對抗驚嚇或魅惑的豁免檢定上都有優勢。生物必須能夠聽到你的聲音才能獲得此好處。如果你喪失行為能力或保持沉默，或者你自願結束表演（無需採取任何行動），表演將提前結束。

吟遊學院特色

在第 6 級，你將獲得吟遊學院的一項特性。

吟遊學院選項

逸聞學院

額外的魔法秘密

在第 6 級，你可以從任意職業中選擇兩種法術。你選擇的法術必須具有你可以施展的等級，如吟遊詩人表或戲法上所示。所選法術對你來說算是吟遊詩人法術，但不計入你所知道的吟遊詩人法術數量。

勇氣學院

額外攻擊

從 6 級開始，每當你在自己的回合進行攻擊動作時，你可以攻擊兩次，而不是一次。
note.lvl06_details_en:
Countercharm

At 6th level, you gain the ability to use musical notes or words of power to disrupt mind-influencing effects. As an action, you can start a performance that lasts until the end of your next turn. During that time, you and any friendly creatures within 30 feet of you have advantage on saving throws against being frightened or charmed. A creature must be able to hear you to gain this benefit. The performance ends early if you are incapacitated or silenced or if you voluntarily end it (no action required).

Bard College feature

At 6th level, you gain a feature from your Bard College.

Bard College Options

College of Lore

Additional Magical Secrets

At 6th level, you learn two spells of your choice from any class. A spell you choose must be of a level you can cast, as shown on the Bard table, or a cantrip. The chosen spells count as bard spells for you but don't count against the number of bard spells you know.

College of Valor

Extra Attack

Starting at 6th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
note.lvl08_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到8級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。正常情況下，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl08_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 8th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl09_details_zh:
安息之歌 (d8)

9級時，從《安息之歌》中獲得的額外生命值增加至1d8。
note.lvl09_details_en:
Song of Rest (d8)

At 9th level, the extra hit points gained from Song of Rest increases to 1d8.
note.lvl10_details_zh:
吟遊詩人的靈感 (d10)

在 10 級時，你的吟遊詩人靈感骰子變成 d10。

專業知識

10級時，你可以選擇另外兩種技能熟練度。對於你使用任一所選熟練程度進行的任何能力檢查，你的熟練加值都會加倍。

神奇的秘密

到了 10 級，你已經從廣泛的學科中掠奪了魔法知識。從任意職業中選擇兩個法術，包括這個。你選擇的法術必須達到你可以施展的等級，如吟遊詩人表或戲法上所示。

所選法術對你來說算是吟遊詩人法術，並包含在吟遊詩人表的已知法術列中的數字中。

你可以在 14 級從任何職業學習兩個額外的法術，並在 18 級再次學習。
note.lvl10_details_en:
Bardic Inspiration (d10)

At 10th level, your Bardic Inspiration die changes to a d10.

Expertise

At 10th level, you can choose another two skill proficiencies. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of the chosen proficiencies.

Magical Secrets

By 10th level, you have plundered magical knowledge from a wide spectrum of disciplines. Choose two spells from any class, including this one. A spell you choose must be of a level you can cast, as shown on the Bard table, or a cantrip.

The chosen spells count as bard spells for you and are included in the number in the Spells Known column of the Bard table.

You learn two additional spells from any class at 14th level and again at 18th level.
note.lvl12_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到12級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl12_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 12th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl13_details_zh:
安息之歌 (d10)

13級時，從《安息之歌》中獲得的額外生命值增加到1d10。
note.lvl13_details_en:
Song of Rest (d10)

At 13th level, the extra hit points gained from Song of Rest increases to 1d10.
note.lvl14_details_zh:
神奇的秘密

14級時，從任意職業中選擇兩個額外法術，包括這個。你選擇的法術必須達到你可以施展的等級，如吟遊詩人表或戲法上所示。

所選法術對你來說算是吟遊詩人法術，並包含在吟遊詩人表的已知法術列中的數字中。

吟遊學院特色

在 14 級時，你將獲得吟遊學院的一項特性。

吟遊學院選項

逸聞學院

絕世功力

從 14 級開始，當你進行能力檢定時，你可以消耗一次吟遊靈感。擲出一個吟遊詩人靈感骰子，並將擲出的數字加到你的能力檢定中。你可以選擇在擲骰子進行能力檢查之後、DM 告訴你成功或失敗之前執行此操作。

勇氣學院

戰鬥魔法

在 14 級時，你已經掌握了將施法和武器使用融為一體的藝術。當你使用動作施展吟遊詩人法術時，你可以進行一次武器攻擊作為附贈動作。
note.lvl14_details_en:
Magical Secrets

At 14th level, choose two additional spells from any class, including this one. A spell you choose must be of a level you can cast, as shown on the Bard table, or a cantrip.

The chosen spells count as bard spells for you and are included in the number in the Spells Known column of the Bard table.

Bard College feature

At 14th level, you gain a feature from your Bard College.

Bard College Options

College of Lore

Peerless Skill

Starting at 14th level, when you make an ability check, you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration. Roll a Bardic Inspiration die and add the number rolled to your ability check. You can choose to do so after you roll the die for the ability check, but before the DM tells you whether you succeed or fail.

College of Valor

Battle Magic

At 14th level, you have mastered the art of weaving spellcasting and weapon use into a single harmonious act. When you use your action to cast a bard spell, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.
note.lvl15_details_zh:
吟遊詩人的靈感 (d12)

在第 15 級，你的吟遊詩人靈感骰子變成 d12。
note.lvl15_details_en:
Bardic Inspiration (d12)

At 15th level, your Bardic Inspiration die changes to a d12.
note.lvl16_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到16級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl16_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 16th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl17_details_zh:
安息之歌 (d12)

17級時，從《安息之歌》獲得的額外生命值增加至1d12。
note.lvl17_details_en:
Song of Rest (d12)

At 17th level, the extra hit points gained from Song of Rest increases to 1d12.
note.lvl18_details_zh:
神奇的秘密

18級時，從任意職業中選擇兩個額外的法術，包括這個。你選擇的法術必須達到你可以施展的等級，如吟遊詩人表或戲法上所示。

所選法術對你來說算是吟遊詩人法術，並包含在吟遊詩人表的已知法術列中的數字中。
note.lvl18_details_en:
Magical Secrets

At 18th level, choose two additional spells from any class, including this one. A spell you choose must be of a level you can cast, as shown on the Bard table, or a cantrip.

The chosen spells count as bard spells for you and are included in the number in the Spells Known column of the Bard table.
note.lvl19_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到19級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl19_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 19th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl20_details_zh:
卓越的靈感

在 20 級，當你投出主動權且吟遊詩人靈感已用完時，你會重新獲得一次使用權。
note.lvl20_details_en:
Superior Inspiration

At 20th level, when you roll initiative and have no uses of Bardic Inspiration left, you regain one use.

note.basic_zh:
生命骰：1d8
豁免：感知、魅力
note.basic_en:
Hit Dice: 1d8
Saving Throw: WIS, CHA
note.lvl01_details_zh:
熟練

• 護甲：輕甲、中甲、盾牌
• 武器：簡易武器
• 技能：從歷史、察言觀色、醫藥、遊說、宗教中選擇兩項

起始裝備

• 錘矛，或戰錘（若具有熟練）
• 鱗甲、皮甲或鎖子甲（若具有熟練）
• 輕弩與 20 支弩矢，或任一簡易武器
• 祭司套組或探險者套組
• 盾牌與聖徽

施法

• 施法能力：感知
• 法術豁免 DC：8 + 熟練加值 + 感知調整值
• 法術攻擊加值：熟練加值 + 感知調整值
• 戲法：從牧師法術表選擇三個
• 1 級時擁有兩個 1 環法術位
• 每日準備的牧師法術數量為 感知調整值 + 牧師等級，至少一個；只能準備你擁有相應法術位環級的法術
• 可使用聖徽作為施法法器

神聖領域

選擇一個與信奉神祇相關的領域：知識、生命、光明、自然、風暴、詭術或戰爭。領域法術會自動準備，且不計入每日準備法術數量；升級後還會取得該領域的其他能力。

神域選項

知識神域

知識之神——包括歐格瑪、博卡布、吉利安、奧倫和托特——最重視的是學習和理解。有些人教導說，知識應該在圖書館和大學中收集和共享，或推廣工藝和發明的實用知識。有些神祇囤積知識並保守其秘密。有些人向他們的追隨者承諾，如果他們解開多元宇宙的秘密，他們將獲得巨大的力量。這些神的追隨者研究深奧的知識，收集古老的書籍，深入地球的秘密地方，並學習他們所能學到的一切。一些知識之神促進了工藝和發明的實用知識，包括貢德、雷奧克斯、奧納塔、摩拉丁、赫菲斯托斯和戈布尼烏等鐵匠神。

在每個指示的牧師級別，你將列出的法術添加到你準備的法術中。

|牧師等級 |法術|
| --- | --- |
|第一 |指令，辨識|
|第三 |占卜、建議|
|第五 |不被發現，與死者交談|
|第七 |神秘之眼，混亂|
|9日 |傳說傳說，占卜|

知識的祝福

在第一級，你可以選擇學習兩種語言。你還可以熟練選擇以下技能中的兩種：奧秘、歷史、自然或宗教。

對於任何使用這些技能的能力檢定，你的熟練加值都會加倍。

生命神域

生命領域專注於維持所有生命的充滿活力的正能量——宇宙的基本力量之一。生命之神透過治癒傷病者、照顧有需要的人以及驅散死亡和不死的力量來促進活力和健康。幾乎所有非邪惡的神都可以聲稱對這個領域有影響力，特別是農業神（如Chauntea、Arawi和Demeter）、太陽神（如Lathander、Pelor和Re-Horakhty）、治療或耐力之神（如Ilmater、Mishakal、Apollo和Diancecht）以及家庭和社區之神（如Hestia、Hath）。

在每個指示的牧師級別，你將列出的法術添加到你準備的法術中。

|牧師等級 |法術|
| --- | --- |
|第一 |祝福，治癒傷口|
|第三 |較小的恢復，精神武器|
|第五 |希望燈塔，復興|
|第七 |死亡病房，信仰守護者|
|9日 |大規模治癒傷口，復活死者|

加值熟練度

當你在第一級選擇這個領域時，你就會獲得重甲的熟練程度。

生命的門徒

同樣從 1 級開始，你的治療法術會更有效。每當你使用1級或更高等級的法術來恢復生物的生命值時，該生物會恢復等於2+法術等級的額外生命值。

光明神域

光明之神——包括赫爾姆、洛山達、菲爾圖斯、布蘭查拉、銀焰、貝勒努斯、阿波羅和雷霍拉赫蒂——宣揚重生和更新、真理、警惕和美麗的理想，經常使用太陽的象徵。其中一些神被描绘成太阳本身或引导太阳穿过天空的战车御者。另一些人则是不知疲倦的哨兵，他们的眼睛能穿透每一个阴影，看穿每一个欺骗。有些是美丽和艺术之神，他们教导说艺术是改善灵魂的工具。光明之神的牧师是开明的灵魂，充满了光辉和神明洞察力的力量，肩负着赶走谎言和燃烧黑暗的责任。

在每個指示的牧師級別，你將列出的法術添加到你準備的法術中。

|牧師等級 |法術|
| --- | --- |
|第一名 |燃燒的手，精靈之火|
|第三 |火球，灼熱射線|
|第五 |日光，火球|
|第七 |信仰守護者，火牆|
| 9日 |火焰攻擊，占卜|

額外戲法

当你在第一级选择这个领域时，如果你还不知道的话，你就会获得光咒术。

警戒照明彈

同样在第一级，你可以在自己和攻击的敌人之间插入神圣之光。當你受到你能看到的 30 呎範圍內的生物攻擊時，你可以利用你的反應對攻擊檢定施加不利影響，在攻擊者擊中或未擊中之前導致光線在攻擊者面前閃爍。无法被蒙蔽的攻击者不会受到此特性的影响。

你可以使用该特性的次数等于你的感知调整值（至少一次）。完成長休後，你將恢復所有消耗的用途。

自然神域

自然之神與自然世界本身一樣多種多樣，從深林中神秘的神（如西爾瓦努斯、奧吟遊海、奇斯萊夫、巴里諾和潘）到與特定泉水和樹林相關的友好神（如埃爾達斯）。德魯伊崇拜整個自然，可能會侍奉其中一位神靈，舉行神秘的儀式，並用他們自己的秘密語言背誦幾乎被遺忘的祈禱文。但這些神中有許多也有牧師，他們是在促進特定自然神的利益方面發揮更積極作用的捍衛者。這些牧師可能會獵殺那些掠奪林地的邪惡怪物，祝福信徒的豐收，或者讓那些觸怒神靈的人的莊稼枯萎。

在每個指示的牧師級別，你將列出的法術添加到你準備的法術中。

|牧師等級 |法術|
| --- | --- |
|第一 |動物友誼，與動物對話|
|第三 |樹皮，穗狀生長|
|第五 |植物生長，風牆|
|第七 |稱霸猛獸，抓藤|
|9日 |昆蟲瘟疫，樹跨步|

自然侍僧

在第一級，你可以學習一種你選擇的德魯伊戲法。你還可以熟練以下你選擇的技能之一：動物處理、自然或生存。

加值熟練度

同樣在第一級，你可以熟練使用重甲。

風暴神域

神職包括暴風雨領域，包括塔洛斯、安博裡、科爾德、澤博伊姆、吞噬者、宙斯和托爾，掌管風暴、海洋和天空。他們包括閃電和雷神、地震之神、一些火神以及某些暴力、體力和勇氣之神。在某些萬神殿中，該領域的神統治著其他神，並以雷電迅速伸張正義而聞名。在航海民族的萬神殿中，這個領域的神是海洋神和水手的守護神。暴風雨之神派遣他們的牧師去激發普通民眾的恐懼，要么讓這些民眾走上正義之路，要么鼓勵他們獻上安撫祭品來抵禦神聖的憤怒。

在每個指示的牧師級別，你將列出的法術添加到你準備的法術中。

|牧師等級 |法術|
| --- | --- |
|第一 |霧雲、雷電|
|第三 |一陣風，粉碎|
|第五 |召喚閃電，雨夾雪風暴|
|第七 |控制水、冰暴|
|9日 |破壞性浪潮、蟲瘟|

加值熟練程度

在第一級，你可以熟練使用軍用武器和重甲。

風暴之怒

同樣在第一級，你可以雷霆般地斥責攻擊者。當你能看到的距離你 5 呎以內的生物攻擊你時，你可以利用你的反應來讓生物進行敏捷豁免。豁免失敗時，該生物會受到 2d8 閃電或雷霆傷害（由你選擇），豁免成功時則受到一半傷害。

你可以使用該特性的次數等於你的感知調整值（至少一次）。完成長休後，你將恢復所有消耗的用途。

詭術神域

詭計之神——例如泰莫拉、貝沙巴、奧利達瑪拉、旅行者、加爾·閃金和洛基——都是惡作劇製造者和煽動者，他們不斷挑戰神和凡人之間公認的秩序。他們是小偷、惡棍、賭徒、叛亂者和解放者的贊助者。他們的牧師是世界上的破壞性力量，刺破驕傲，嘲笑暴君，偷竊富人，釋放俘虜，蔑視空洞的傳統。他們更喜歡詭計、惡作劇、欺騙和偷竊，而不是直接對抗。

在每個指示的牧師級別，你將列出的法術添加到你準備的法術中。

|牧師等級 |法術|
| --- | --- |
|第一 |迷惑人，偽裝自我|
|第三 |鏡像，傳遞無痕|
|第五 |眨眼，驅散魔法|
|第七 |次元門，變形|
| 9日 |支配人，修改記憶|

騙子的祝福

當你在第一級選擇這個領域時開始，你可以用你的動作去觸摸除你自己之外的自願生物，以使其在敏捷（潛行）檢定上獲得優勢。此祝福持續1小時或直到你再次使用此特性。

戰爭神域

戰爭有多種表現形式。它可以使普通人成為英雄。它可能是絕望和可怕的，殘忍和怯懦的行為掩蓋了卓越和勇氣的實例。無論哪種情況，戰神都會守護戰士並加值他們的偉大成就。這些神的牧師在戰鬥中表現出色，激勵其他人進行正義的戰鬥或提供暴力行為作為祈禱。戰爭之神包括榮譽和騎士精神的冠軍（如托姆、海羅尼斯和基里-喬利斯），以及破壞和掠奪之神（如埃里斯努、憤怒、格烏什和阿瑞斯）以及征服和統治之神（如貝恩、海克斯托和馬格魯比耶）。其他戰神（如坦帕斯、耐吉和努阿達）則採取更中立的立場，提倡一切形式的戰爭，並在任何情況下支持戰士。

在每個指示的牧師級別，將列出的法術添加到你準備的法術中。

|牧師等級 |法術|
| --- | --- |
|第一 |神聖的恩惠，信仰的盾牌|
|第三 |法寶、靈器|
|第五 |十字軍的斗篷，精神守護者|
|第七 |行動自由，石皮|
|9日 |火焰打擊，壓制怪物|

加值熟練程度

在第一級，你可以熟練使用軍用武器和重甲。

戰爭牧師

從第一級開始，當你投入戰鬥時，你的神會帶給你靈感。當你使用攻擊動作時，你可以將一次武器攻擊作為附贈動作。你可以使用該特性的次數等於你的感知調整值（至少一次）。完成長休後，你將恢復所有消耗的用途。
note.lvl01_details_en:
Proficiencies

• Armor: Light armor, medium armor, and shields
• Weapons: Simple weapons
• Skills: Choose two from History, Insight, Medicine, Persuasion, and Religion

Starting Equipment

• A mace or a warhammer, if proficient
• Scale mail, leather armor, or chain mail, if proficient
• A light crossbow and 20 bolts, or any simple weapon
• A priest's pack or explorer's pack
• A shield and holy symbol

Spellcasting

• Spellcasting Ability: Wisdom
• Spell Save DC: 8 + proficiency bonus + Wisdom modifier
• Spell Attack Modifier: proficiency bonus + Wisdom modifier
• Cantrips: Choose three from the cleric spell list
• At 1st level, you have two 1st-level spell slots
• You prepare Wisdom modifier + cleric level cleric spells each day, with a minimum of one. You can prepare only spells for which you have spell slots
• You can use a holy symbol as a spellcasting focus

Divine Domain

Choose a domain associated with your deity: Knowledge, Life, Light, Nature, Tempest, Trickery, or War. Domain spells are always prepared and do not count against the number you prepare each day. Your domain also grants additional features as you gain levels.

Divine Domain Options

Knowledge Domain

The gods of knowledge—including Oghma, Boccob, Gilean, Aureon, and Thoth—value learning and understanding above all. Some teach that knowledge is to be gathered and shared in libraries and universities, or promote the practical knowledge of craft and invention. Some deities hoard knowledge and keep its secrets to themselves. And some promise their followers that they will gain tremendous power if they unlock the secrets of the multiverse. Followers of these gods study esoteric lore, collect old tomes, delve into the secret places of the earth, and learn all they can. Some gods of knowledge promote the practical knowledge of craft and invention, including smith deities like Gond, Reorx, Onatar, Moradin, Hephaestus, and Goibhniu.

At each indicated cleric level, you add the listed spells to your spells prepared.

| Cleric Level | Spells |
| --- | --- |
| 1st | command, identify |
| 3rd | augury, suggestion |
| 5th | nondetection, speak with dead |
| 7th | arcane eye, confusion |
| 9th | legend lore, scrying |

Blessings of Knowledge

At 1st level, you learn two languages of your choice. You also become proficient in your choice of two of the following skills: Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion.

Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of those skills.

Life Domain

The Life domain focuses on the vibrant positive energy—one of the fundamental forces of the universe—that sustains all life. The gods of life promote vitality and health through healing the sick and wounded, caring for those in need, and driving away the forces of death and undeath. Almost any non-evil deity can claim influence over this domain, particularly agricultural deities (such as Chauntea, Arawai, and Demeter), sun gods (such as Lathander, Pelor, and Re-Horakhty), gods of healing or endurance (such as Ilmater, Mishakal, Apollo, and Diancecht), and gods of home and community (such as Hestia, Hathor, and Boldrei).

At each indicated cleric level, you add the listed spells to your spells prepared.

| Cleric Level | Spells |
| --- | --- |
| 1st | bless, cure wounds |
| 3rd | lesser restoration, spiritual weapon |
| 5th | beacon of hope, revivify |
| 7th | death ward, guardian of faith |
| 9th | mass cure wounds, raise dead |

Bonus Proficiency

When you choose this domain at 1st level, you gain proficiency with heavy armor.

Disciple of Life

Also starting at 1st level, your healing spells are more effective. Whenever you use a spell of 1st level or higher to restore hit points to a creature, the creature regains additional hit points equal to 2 + the spell's level.

Light Domain

Gods of light—including Helm, Lathander, Pholtus, Branchala, the Silver Flame, Belenus, Apollo, and Re-Horakhty—promote the ideals of rebirth and renewal, truth, vigilance, and beauty, often using the symbol of the sun. Some of these gods are portrayed as the sun itself or as a charioteer who guides the sun across the sky. Others are tireless sentinels whose eyes pierce every shadow and see through every deception. Some are deities of beauty and artistry, who teach that art is a vehicle for the soul's improvement. Clerics of a god of light are enlightened souls infused with radiance and the power of their gods' discerning vision, charged with chasing away lies and burning away darkness.

At each indicated cleric level, you add the listed spells to your spells prepared.

| Cleric Level | Spells |
| --- | --- |
| 1st | burning hands, faerie fire |
| 3rd | flaming sphere, scorching ray |
| 5th | daylight, fireball |
| 7th | guardian of faith, wall of fire |
| 9th | flame strike, scrying |

Bonus Cantrip

When you choose this domain at 1st level, you gain the light cantrip if you don't already know it.

Warding Flare

Also at 1st level, you can interpose divine light between yourself and an attacking enemy. When you are attacked by a creature within 30 feet of you that you can see, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll, causing light to flare before the attacker before it hits or misses. An attacker that can't be blinded is immune to this feature.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

Nature Domain

Gods of nature are as varied as the natural world itself, from inscrutable gods of the deep forests (such as Silvanus, Obad-Hai, Chislev, Balinor, and Pan) to friendly deities associated with particular springs and groves (such as Eldath). Druids revere nature as a whole and might serve one of these deities, practicing mysterious rites and reciting all-but-forgotten prayers in their own secret tongue. But many of these gods have clerics as well, champions who take a more active role in advancing the interests of a particular nature god. These clerics might hunt the evil monstrosities that despoil the woodlands, bless the harvest of the faithful, or wither the crops of those who anger their gods.

At each indicated cleric level, you add the listed spells to your spells prepared.

| Cleric Level | Spells |
| --- | --- |
| 1st | animal friendship, speak with animals |
| 3rd | barkskin, spike growth |
| 5th | plant growth, wind wall |
| 7th | dominate beast, grasping vine |
| 9th | insect plague, tree stride |

Acolyte of Nature

At 1st level, you learn one druid cantrip of your choice. You also gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Animal Handling, Nature, or Survival.

Bonus Proficiency

Also at 1st level, you gain proficiency with heavy armor.

Tempest Domain

Gods whose portfolios include the Tempest domain—including Talos, Umberlee, Kord, Zeboim, the Devourer, Zeus, and Thor—govern storms, sea, and sky. They include gods of lightning and thunder, gods of earthquakes, some fire gods, and certain gods of violence, physical strength, and courage. In some pantheons, a god of this domain rules over other deities and is known for swift justice delivered by thunderbolts. In the pantheons of seafaring people, gods of this domain are ocean deities and the patrons of sailors. Tempest gods send their clerics to inspire fear in the common folk, either to keep those folk on the path of righteousness or to encourage them to offer sacrifices of propitiation to ward off divine wrath.

At each indicated cleric level, you add the listed spells to your spells prepared.

| Cleric Level | Spells |
| --- | --- |
| 1st | fog cloud, thunderwave |
| 3rd | gust of wind, shatter |
| 5th | call lightning, sleet storm |
| 7th | control water, ice storm |
| 9th | destructive wave, insect plague |

Bonus Proficiencies

At 1st level, you gain proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.

Wrath of the Storm

Also at 1st level, you can thunderously rebuke attackers. When a creature within 5 feet of you that you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to cause the creature to make a Dexterity saving throw. The creature takes 2d8 lightning or thunder damage (your choice) on a failed saving throw, and half as much damage on a successful one.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

Trickery Domain

Gods of trickery—such as Tymora, Beshaba, Olidammara, the Traveler, Garl Glittergold, and Loki—are mischief-makers and instigators who stand as a constant challenge to the accepted order among both gods and mortals. They're patrons of thieves, scoundrels, gamblers, rebels, and liberators. Their clerics are a disruptive force in the world, puncturing pride, mocking tyrants, stealing from the rich, freeing captives, and flouting hollow traditions. They prefer subterfuge, pranks, deception, and theft rather than direct confrontation.

At each indicated cleric level, you add the listed spells to your spells prepared.

| Cleric Level | Spells |
| --- | --- |
| 1st | charm person, disguise self |
| 3rd | mirror image, pass without trace |
| 5th | blink, dispel magic |
| 7th | dimension door, polymorph |
| 9th | dominate person, modify memory |

Blessing of the Trickster

Starting when you choose this domain at 1st level, you can use your action to touch a willing creature other than yourself to give it advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. This blessing lasts for 1 hour or until you use this feature again.

War Domain

War has many manifestations. It can make heroes of ordinary people. It can be desperate and horrific, with acts of cruelty and cowardice eclipsing instances of excellence and courage. In either case, the gods of war watch over warriors and reward them for their great deeds. The clerics of such gods excel in battle, inspiring others to fight the good fight or offering acts of violence as prayers. Gods of war include champions of honor and chivalry (such as Torm, Heironeous, and Kiri-Jolith) as well as gods of destruction and pillage (such as Erythnul, the Fury, Gruumsh, and Ares) and gods of conquest and domination (such as Bane, Hextor, and Maglubiyet). Other war gods (such as Tempus, Nike, and Nuada) take a more neutral stance, promoting war in all its manifestations and supporting warriors in any circumstance.

At each indicated cleric level, add the listed spells to your spells prepared.

| Cleric Level | Spells |
| --- | --- |
| 1st | divine favor, shield of faith |
| 3rd | magic weapon, spiritual weapon |
| 5th | crusader's mantle, spirit guardians |
| 7th | freedom of movement, stoneskin |
| 9th | flame strike, hold monster |

Bonus Proficiencies

At 1st level, you gain proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.

War Priest

From 1st level, your god delivers bolts of inspiration to you while you are engaged in battle. When you use the Attack action, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
note.lvl02_details_zh:
引導神性（1/休息）

在第2級，你獲得直接從你的神靈引導神聖能量的能力，使用該能量來增強魔法效果。你從兩個這樣的效果開始：驅散不死和由你的領域決定的效果。某些領域會隨著你等級的提升而授予你額外的效果，如領域描述中所述。

當你使用通道神性時，你可以選擇要建立的效果。然後，你必須完成短休或長休才能再次使用你的通道神性。

某些引導神性效果需要豁免檢定。當你使用此類效果時，DC 等於你的牧師法術豁免 DC。

從 6 級開始，你可以在休息之間使用神通兩次，從 18 級開始，你可以在休息之間使用 3 次。當你完成短休或長休後，你將恢復消耗的使用量。

驅散不死

作為一個動作，你展示你的聖徽並說出譴責不死生物的祈禱文。每個在你周圍 30 呎內能看到或聽到你的不死生物都必須進行一次感知豁免。如果生物未能通過豁免檢定，它將被翻轉 1 分鐘或直到受到任何傷害。

一個變身的生物必須花很多時間嘗試移動到離你盡可能遠的地方，而且它不能自願移動到距離你 30 呎以內的空間。它也無法做出反應。對於其動作，它只能使用衝刺動作或嘗試逃離阻止其移動的效果。如果無處可移動，則該生物可以使用閃避動作。

神域特色

在第 2 級，你獲得了神域的一項特性。

神域選項

知識神域

神性管道：時代知識

從第 2 級開始，你可以使用你的神性通道來挖掘神聖的知識之井。作為一項行動，你選擇一項技能或工具。在 10 分鐘內，你可以熟練所選的技能或工具。

生命神域

引導神性：保護生命

從 2 級開始，你可以使用神通來治癒重傷者。

作為一個動作，你展示你的聖徽並喚起治療能量，可以恢復相當於你牧師等級五倍的生命值。選擇任何距離你 30 呎以內的生物，並將這些生命值分配給它們。此特性可以將生物恢復到不超過其最大生命值的一半。你不能在不死生物或構造體上使用此特性。

光明神域

引導神性：黎明之光

從 2 級開始，你可以使用你的神力引導陽光，驅逐黑暗並對你的敵人造成輻射傷害。

作為一個動作，你展示你的聖徽，你周圍 30 呎內的任何魔法黑暗都會被驅散。此外，距離你 30 呎內的每個敵對生物都必須進行一次體質豁免。豁免失敗時，生物會受到等於 2d10 + 你的牧師等級的光輝傷害，成功時則受到一半傷害。受到你完全掩護的生物不受影響。

自然神域

通神：迷惑動植物

從第 2 級開始，你可以使用你的神通來迷惑動物和植物。

作為一個動作，你展示你的聖徽並呼喚你神的名字。每個在你周圍 30 呎內能看到你的野獸或植物生物都必須進行一次感知豁免。如果生物未能通過豁免檢定，它會被你魅惑 1 分鐘或直到它受到傷害。當它被你魅惑時，它對你和你指定的其他生物很友好。

風暴神域

引導神性：毀滅性憤怒

從等級 2 開始，你可以使用你的引導神性來肆無忌憚地運用風暴的力量。

當你滾動閃電或雷霆傷害時，你可以使用你的引導神力來造成最大傷害，而不是滾動。

詭術神域

引導神性：喚起口是心非

從第 2 級開始，你可以使用你的通道神性來創造你自己的虛幻複製品。

作為一個動作，你創造了一個完美的自我幻象，持續一分鐘，或直到你失去注意力（就好像你正在專注於一個法術）。幻像出現在你周圍 30 呎內可見的無人空間。作為你回合的附贈動作，你可以將幻象移動到 30 呎之外的你能看到的空間，但它必須保持在距離你 120 呎的範圍內。

在此期間，你可以像在幻象空間中一樣施展法術，但你必須使用自己的感官。此外，當你和你的幻像都在距離能看到幻象的生物 5 呎以內時，考慮到幻象對目標的干擾程度，你在針對該生物的攻擊檢定上具有優勢。

戰爭神域

引導神性：引導打擊

從第 2 級開始，你可以使用你的通道神性以超自然的準確性進行攻擊。當你進行攻擊檢定時，你可以使用你的引導神性來獲得+10的檢定加值。你可以在看到擲骰後、DM 說出攻擊是否命中或未命中之前做出選擇。
note.lvl02_details_en:
Channel Divinity (1/rest)

At 2nd level, you gain the ability to channel divine energy directly from your deity, using that energy to fuel magical effects. You start with two such effects: Turn Undead and an effect determined by your domain. Some domains grant you additional effects as you advance in levels, as noted in the domain description.

When you use your Channel Divinity, you choose which effect to create. You must then finish a short or long rest to use your Channel Divinity again.

Some Channel Divinity effects require saving throws. When you use such an effect from this class, the DC equals your cleric spell save DC.

Beginning at 6th level, you can use your Channel Divinity twice between rests, and beginning at 18th level, you can use it three times between rests. When you finish a short or long rest, you regain your expended uses.

Turn Undead

As an action, you present your holy symbol and speak a prayer censuring the undead. Each undead that can see or hear you within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw. If the creature fails its saving throw, it is turned for 1 minute or until it takes any damage.

A turned creature must spend its turns trying to move as far away from you as it can, and it can't willingly move to a space within 30 feet of you. It also can't take reactions. For its action, it can use only the Dash action or try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving. If there's nowhere to move, the creature can use the Dodge action.

Divine Domain feature

At 2nd level, you gain a feature from your Divine Domain.

Divine Domain Options

Knowledge Domain

Channel Divinity: Knowledge of the Ages

Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to tap into a divine well of knowledge. As an action, you choose one skill or tool. For 10 minutes, you have proficiency with the chosen skill or tool.

Life Domain

Channel Divinity: Preserve Life

Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to heal the badly injured.

As an action, you present your holy symbol and evoke healing energy that can restore a number of hit points equal to five times your cleric level. Choose any creatures within 30 feet of you, and divide those hit points among them. This feature can restore a creature to no more than half of its hit point maximum. You can't use this feature on an undead or a construct.

Light Domain

Channel Divinity: Radiance of the Dawn

Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to harness sunlight, banishing darkness and dealing radiant damage to your foes.

As an action, you present your holy symbol, and any magical darkness within 30 feet of you is dispelled. Additionally, each hostile creature within 30 feet of you must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes radiant damage equal to 2d10 + your cleric level on a failed saving throw, and half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that has total cover from you is not affected.

Nature Domain

Channel Divinity: Charm Animals and Plants

Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to charm animals and plants.

As an action, you present your holy symbol and invoke the name of your deity. Each beast or plant creature that can see you within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw. If the creature fails its saving throw, it is charmed by you for 1 minute or until it takes damage. While it is charmed by you, it is friendly to you and other creatures you designate.

Tempest Domain

Channel Divinity: Destructive Wrath

Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to wield the power of the storm with unchecked ferocity.

When you roll lightning or thunder damage, you can use your Channel Divinity to deal maximum damage, instead of rolling.

Trickery Domain

Channel Divinity: Invoke Duplicity

Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to create an illusory duplicate of yourself.

As an action, you create a perfect illusion of yourself that lasts for 1 minute, or until you lose your concentration (as if you were concentrating on a spell). The illusion appears in an unoccupied space that you can see within 30 feet of you. As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the illusion up to 30 feet to a space you can see, but it must remain within 120 feet of you.

For the duration, you can cast spells as though you were in the illusion's space, but you must use your own senses. Additionally, when both you and your illusion are within 5 feet of a creature that can see the illusion, you have advantage on attack rolls against that creature, given how distracting the illusion is to the target.

War Domain

Channel Divinity: Guided Strike

Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to strike with supernatural accuracy. When you make an attack roll, you can use your Channel Divinity to gain a +10 bonus to the roll. You make this choice after you see the roll, but before the DM says whether the attack hits or misses.
note.lvl04_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到4級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl04_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 4th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl05_details_zh:
消滅不死 (CR 1/2)

從第 5 級開始，當 CR 1/2 或更低的不死生物通過你的驅散不死特性的豁免檢定失敗時，該生物會立即被消滅。
note.lvl05_details_en:
Destroy Undead (CR 1/2)

Starting at 5th level, when an undead of CR 1/2 or lower fails its saving throw against your Turn Undead feature, the creature is instantly destroyed.
note.lvl06_details_zh:
引導神性（2/休息）

從第 6 級開始，你可以在休息期間使用你的引導神力兩次。

神域特色

第六級時，你獲得神域的一項特性。

神域選項

知識神域

頻道神性：閱讀思想

在第 6 級，你可以使用你的神性引導來讀取生物的想法。然後你可以使用你對生物思想的存取來命令它。

作為一個動作，選擇一個你在 60 呎範圍內可以看到的生物。該生物必須進行一次感知豁免。如果生物成功通過豁免檢定，則在完成長休之前，你無法再次對其使用此特性。

如果該生物的豁免失敗，當它在距離你 60 呎以內時，你可以讀取它表面的想法（那些最重要的思想，反映它當前的情緒和它正在積極思考的事情）。此效果持續1分鐘。

在此期間，你可以用你的動作結束這個效果，並向該生物施放暗示法術，而無需消耗法術位。目標對該法術的豁免檢定自動失敗。

生命神域

受祝福的治療師

從 6 級開始，你對其他人施展的治療法術也會治癒你。當你施展 1 級或更高等級的法術為你以外的生物恢復生命值時，你恢復的生命值等於 2 + 法術等級。

光明神域

改進的耀斑

從第 6 級開始，當你在 30 呎內可以看到的生物攻擊除你以外的生物時，你還可以使用你的防護耀斑特性。

自然神域

阻尼元件

從第 6 級開始，當你或周圍 30 呎內的生物受到酸、冷、火、閃電或雷霆傷害時，你可以使用你的反應來賦予該生物抵抗該傷害的能力。

風暴神域

雷霆一擊

在第 6 級，當你對大型或小型生物造成閃電傷害時，你也可以將其推離你 10 呎。

詭術神域

引導神性：暗影斗篷

從 6 級開始，你可以使用你的引導神力來消失。

作為一個動作，你將變得隱身，直到下一回合結束。如果你攻擊或施展法術，你就會變得可見。

戰爭神域

神性通道：戰神的祝福

6級時，當你周圍30呎內的生物進行攻擊檢定時，你可以使用你的引導神力，利用你的反應為生物提供+10的檢定加值。你可以在看到擲骰後、DM 說出攻擊是否命中或未命中之前做出選擇。
note.lvl06_details_en:
Channel Divinity (2/rest)

Beginning at 6th level, you can use your Channel Divinity twice between rests.

Divine Domain feature

At 6th level, you gain a feature from your Divine Domain.

Divine Domain Options

Knowledge Domain

Channel Divinity: Read Thoughts

At 6th level, you can use your Channel Divinity to read a creature's thoughts. You can then use your access to the creature's mind to command it.

As an action, choose one creature that you can see within 60 feet of you. That creature must make a Wisdom saving throw. If the creature succeeds on the saving throw, you can't use this feature on it again until you finish a long rest.

If the creature fails its save, you can read its surface thoughts (those foremost in its mind, reflecting its current emotions and what it is actively thinking about) when it is within 60 feet of you. This effect lasts for 1 minute.

During that time, you can use your action to end this effect and cast the suggestion spell on the creature without expending a spell slot. The target automatically fails its saving throw against the spell.

Life Domain

Blessed Healer

Beginning at 6th level, the healing spells you cast on others heal you as well. When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher that restores hit points to a creature other than you, you regain hit points equal to 2 + the spell's level.

Light Domain

Improved Flare

Starting at 6th level, you can also use your Warding Flare feature when a creature that you can see within 30 feet of you attacks a creature other than you.

Nature Domain

Dampen Elements

Starting at 6th level, when you or a creature within 30 feet of you takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, you can use your reaction to grant resistance to the creature against that instance of the damage.

Tempest Domain

Thunderbolt Strike

At 6th level, when you deal lightning damage to a Large or smaller creature, you can also push it up to 10 feet away from you.

Trickery Domain

Channel Divinity: Cloak of Shadows

Starting at 6th level, you can use your Channel Divinity to vanish.

As an action, you become invisible until the end of your next turn. You become visible if you attack or cast a spell.

War Domain

Channel Divinity: War God's Blessing

At 6th level, when a creature within 30 feet of you makes an attack roll, you can use your reaction to grant that creature a +10 bonus to the roll, using your Channel Divinity. You make this choice after you see the roll, but before the DM says whether the attack hits or misses.
note.lvl08_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到8級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。正常情況下，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。

消滅不死 (CR 1)

從第 8 級開始，當 CR 1 或更低的不死生物通過你的驅散不死特性的豁免檢定失敗時，該生物會立即被消滅。

神域特色

8級時，你獲得神域的一項特性。

神域選項

知識神域

強力施法

從等級 8 開始，你將你的感知調整值加到你對任何牧師戲法造成的傷害上。

生命神域

神擊

在第 8 級，你獲得了為你的武器攻擊注入神聖能量的能力。在你的每個回合中，當你用武器攻擊擊中生物時，你可以使該攻擊對目標造成額外的 1d8 光輝傷害。當你達到 14 級時，額外傷害增加到 2d8。

光明神域

強力施法

從等級 8 開始，你將你的感知調整值加到你對任何牧師戲法造成的傷害上。

自然神域

神擊

在第 8 級，你獲得了為你的武器攻擊注入神聖能量的能力。在你的每個回合中，當你用武器攻擊擊中生物時，你可以使該攻擊對目標造成額外的 1d8 寒冷、火焰或閃電傷害（由你選擇）。當你達到 14 級時，額外傷害增加到 2d8。

風暴神域

神擊

在第 8 級，你獲得了為你的武器攻擊注入神聖能量的能力。每個回合一次，當你用武器攻擊擊中生物時，你可以使該攻擊對目標造成額外 1d8 雷霆傷害。當你達到 14 級時，額外傷害增加到 2d8。

詭術神域

神擊

在第 8 級，你獲得了為你的武器攻擊注入毒液的能力——這是你神的禮物。在你的每個回合中，當你用武器攻擊擊中生物時，你可以使該攻擊對目標造成額外的 1d8 毒害傷害。當你達到 14 級時，額外傷害增加到 2d8。

戰爭神域

神擊

在第 8 級，你獲得了為你的武器攻擊注入神聖能量的能力。在你的每個回合中，當你用武器攻擊擊中一個生物時，你可以使該攻擊對目標造成額外的 1d8 點傷害，傷害類型與武器所造成的傷害相同。當你達到 14 級時，額外傷害增加到 2d8。
note.lvl08_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 8th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.

Destroy Undead (CR 1)

Starting at 8th level, when an undead of CR 1 or lower fails its saving throw against your Turn Undead feature, the creature is instantly destroyed.

Divine Domain feature

At 8th level, you gain a feature from your Divine Domain.

Divine Domain Options

Knowledge Domain

Potent Spellcasting

Starting at 8th level, you add your Wisdom modifier to the damage you deal with any cleric cantrip.

Life Domain

Divine Strike

At 8th level, you gain the ability to infuse your weapon strikes with divine energy. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can cause the attack to deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage to the target. When you reach 14th level, the extra damage increases to 2d8.

Light Domain

Potent Spellcasting

Starting at 8th level, you add your Wisdom modifier to the damage you deal with any cleric cantrip.

Nature Domain

Divine Strike

At 8th level, you gain the ability to infuse your weapon strikes with divine energy. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can cause the attack to deal an extra 1d8 cold, fire, or lightning damage (your choice) to the target. When you reach 14th level, the extra damage increases to 2d8.

Tempest Domain

Divine Strike

At 8th level, you gain the ability to infuse your weapon strikes with divine energy. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can cause the attack to deal an extra 1d8 thunder damage to the target. When you reach 14th level, the extra damage increases to 2d8.

Trickery Domain

Divine Strike

At 8th level, you gain the ability to infuse your weapon strikes with poison—a gift from your deity. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can cause the attack to deal an extra 1d8 poison damage to the target. When you reach 14th level, the extra damage increases to 2d8.

War Domain

Divine Strike

At 8th level, you gain the ability to infuse your weapon strikes with divine energy. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can cause the attack to deal an extra 1d8 damage of the same type dealt by the weapon to the target. When you reach 14th level, the extra damage increases to 2d8.
note.lvl10_details_zh:
神聖干預

從 10 級開始，當你有很大需要時，你可以召喚你的神來介入。

祈求神的幫助需要你採取行動。描述你尋求的幫助，並擲百分骰子。如果你擲出的數字等於或低於你的牧師等級，你的神就會介入。 DM 選擇介入的性質；任何牧師法術或牧師領域法術的效果都是適當的。如果你的神明干預，你將在 7 天內無法再次使用此特性。否則，你可以在完成長休後再次使用它。

在 20 級時，你的介入請求會自動成功，無需擲骰。
note.lvl10_details_en:
Divine Intervention

Beginning at 10th level, you can call on your deity to intervene on your behalf when your need is great.

Imploring your deity's aid requires you to use your action. Describe the assistance you seek, and roll percentile dice. If you roll a number equal to or lower than your cleric level, your deity intervenes. The DM chooses the nature of the intervention; the effect of any cleric spell or cleric domain spell would be appropriate. If your deity intervenes, you can't use this feature again for 7 days. Otherwise, you can use it again after you finish a long rest.

At 20th level, your call for intervention succeeds automatically, no roll required.
note.lvl11_details_zh:
消滅不死 (CR 2)

從第 11 級開始，當 CR 2 或更低的不死生物通過你的驅散不死特性的豁免檢定失敗時，該生物會立即被消滅。
note.lvl11_details_en:
Destroy Undead (CR 2)

Starting at 11th level, when an undead of CR 2 or lower fails its saving throw against your Turn Undead feature, the creature is instantly destroyed.
note.lvl12_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到12級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl12_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 12th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.

Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 16th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

note.lvl17_details_zh:
消滅不死 (CR 4)

從 17 級開始，當 CR 4 或更低的不死生物通過你的驅散不死特性的豁免檢定失敗時，該生物會立即被消滅。

神域特色

17級時，你從神域中獲得一項特性。

神域選項

知識神域

過去的願景

從第 17 級開始，你可以喚起與你所持有的物體或周圍環境有關的過去的幻象。你至少花一分鐘的時間進行冥想和祈禱，然後你會看到最近發生的事情的夢幻般、朦朧的一瞥。你可以用這種方式冥想幾分鐘，時間等於你的智慧值，並且在這段時間內必須保持專注，就像你在施展法術一樣。

一旦你使用此特性，你就無法再次使用它，直到你完成短休或長休。

物件讀取

當你在冥想時拿著一個物體，你可以看到該物體前主人的幻象。冥想 1 分鐘後，你將了解所有者如何獲得和丟失該物品，以及最近涉及該物品和該所有者的重大事件。如果該物體最近被另一個生物擁有（在等於你的感知值的天數內），你可以為每個擁有者額外花費 1 分鐘來了解有關該生物的相同資訊。

區域閱讀

當你冥想時，你會看到你附近最近發生的事件的景象（房間、街道、隧道、空地等，最大50呎的立方體），回溯到等於你的智慧分數的天數。冥想的每一分鐘，你都會了解一個重要事件，從最近的事件開始。重大事件通常涉及強烈的情感，例如戰鬥和背叛、婚姻和謀殺、出生和葬禮。然而，它們也可能包括更平凡的事件，但這些事件對你目前的情況來說很重要。

生命神域

至高療癒

從 17 級開始，當你通常會擲一個或多個骰子來用法術恢復生命值時，你會為每個骰子使用盡可能高的數字。例如，你不是為生物恢復 2d6 點生命值，而是恢復 12 點。

光明神域

光之日冕

從 17 級開始，你可以使用你的動作激活持續 1 分鐘的陽光光環，或者直到你使用另一個動作將其消除。你可以在 60 呎半徑範圍內發出明亮的光線，並在半徑 30 呎之外發出昏暗的光線。在明亮的光線下，你的敵人在對抗任何造成火焰或輻射傷害的法術的豁免檢定中處於劣勢。

自然神域

自然大師

17級時，你獲得了指揮動物和植物生物的能力。當生物被你的魅力動物和植物特性迷惑時，你可以在你的回合中採取加值行動，口頭命令每個生物在下一個回合要做什麼。

風暴神域

風暴之子

17級時，只要你不在地下或室內，你的飛行速度就等於你目前的步行速度。

詭術神域

改進口是心非

在 17 級，當你使用「呼叫口是心非」時，你最多可以創造四個自己的複製品，而不是一個。作為輪到你的附贈動作，你可以將任意數量的它們移動到 30 呎，最大範圍為 120 呎。

戰爭神域

戰鬥頭像

17級時，你獲得對非魔法武器的鈍擊、穿刺和砍擊傷害的抗性。
note.lvl17_details_en:
Destroy Undead (CR 4)

Starting at 17th level, when an undead of CR 4 or lower fails its saving throw against your Turn Undead feature, the creature is instantly destroyed.

Divine Domain feature

At 17th level, you gain a feature from your Divine Domain.

Divine Domain Options

Knowledge Domain

Visions of the Past

Starting at 17th level, you can call up visions of the past that relate to an object you hold or your immediate surroundings. You spend at least 1 minute in meditation and prayer, then receive dreamlike, shadowy glimpses of recent events. You can meditate in this way for a number of minutes equal to your Wisdom score and must maintain concentration during that time, as if you were casting a spell.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

Object Reading

Holding an object as you meditate, you can see visions of the object's previous owner. After meditating for 1 minute, you learn how the owner acquired and lost the object, as well as the most recent significant event involving the object and that owner. If the object was owned by another creature in the recent past (within a number of days equal to your Wisdom score), you can spend 1 additional minute for each owner to learn the same information about that creature.

Area Reading

As you meditate, you see visions of recent events in your immediate vicinity (a room, street, tunnel, clearing, or the like, up to a 50-foot cube), going back a number of days equal to your Wisdom score. For each minute you meditate, you learn about one significant event, beginning with the most recent. Significant events typically involve powerful emotions, such as battles and betrayals, marriages and murders, births and funerals. However, they might also include more mundane events that are nevertheless important in your current situation.

Life Domain

Supreme Healing

Starting at 17th level, when you would normally roll one or more dice to restore hit points with a spell, you instead use the highest number possible for each die. For example, instead of restoring 2d6 hit points to a creature, you restore 12.

Light Domain

Corona of Light

Starting at 17th level, you can use your action to activate an aura of sunlight that lasts for 1 minute or until you dismiss it using another action. You emit bright light in a 60-foot radius and dim light 30 feet beyond that. Your enemies in the bright light have disadvantage on saving throws against any spell that deals fire or radiant damage.

Nature Domain

Master of Nature

At 17th level, you gain the ability to command animals and plant creatures. While creatures are charmed by your Charm Animals and Plants feature, you can take a bonus action on your turn to verbally command what each of those creatures will do on its next turn.

Tempest Domain

Stormborn

At 17th level, you have a flying speed equal to your current walking speed whenever you are not underground or indoors.

Trickery Domain

Improved Duplicity

At 17th level, you can create up to four duplicates of yourself, instead of one, when you use Invoke Duplicity. As a bonus action on your turn, you can move any number of them up to 30 feet, to a maximum range of 120 feet.

War Domain

Avatar of Battle

At 17th level, you gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons.

note.basic_zh:
生命骰：1d8
豁免：智力、感知
note.basic_en:
Hit Dice: 1d8
Saving Throw: INT, WIS
note.lvl01_details_zh:
熟練

• 護甲：輕甲、中甲、盾牌；德魯伊不會穿著金屬護甲或使用金屬盾牌
• 武器：短棍、匕首、飛鏢、標槍、錘矛、長棍、彎刀、鐮刀、投石索、長矛
• 工具：草藥工具組
• 技能：從奧秘、動物馴養、察言觀色、醫藥、自然、觀察、宗教、生存中選擇兩項

起始裝備

• 木盾或任一簡易武器
• 彎刀或任一簡易近戰武器
• 皮甲、探險者套組與德魯伊法器

德魯伊語

你懂德魯伊語（Druidic），可用它交談或留下秘密訊息。懂德魯伊語的人會自動發現這類訊息；其他生物必須通過 DC 15 感知（觀察）檢定才能發現，但若無魔法協助仍無法解讀。

施法

• 施法能力：感知
• 法術豁免 DC：8 + 熟練加值 + 感知調整值
• 法術攻擊加值：熟練加值 + 感知調整值
• 戲法：從德魯伊法術表選擇兩個
• 1 級時擁有兩個 1 環法術位
• 每日準備的德魯伊法術數量為 感知調整值 + 德魯伊等級，至少一個；只能準備你擁有相應法術位環級的法術
• 可使用德魯伊法器作為施法法器
note.lvl01_details_en:
Proficiencies

• Armor: Light armor, medium armor, and shields; druids do not wear armor or use shields made of metal
• Weapons: Clubs, daggers, darts, javelins, maces, quarterstaffs, scimitars, sickles, slings, and spears
• Tools: Herbalism kit
• Skills: Choose two from Arcana, Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Nature, Perception, Religion, and Survival

Starting Equipment

• A wooden shield or any simple weapon
• A scimitar or any simple melee weapon
• Leather armor, an explorer's pack, and a druidic focus

Druidic

You know Druidic and can use it to speak or leave secret messages. Creatures that know Druidic notice such messages automatically. Others must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to notice one and cannot decipher it without magic.

Spellcasting

• Spellcasting Ability: Wisdom
• Spell Save DC: 8 + proficiency bonus + Wisdom modifier
• Spell Attack Modifier: proficiency bonus + Wisdom modifier
• Cantrips: Choose two from the druid spell list
• At 1st level, you have two 1st-level spell slots
• You prepare Wisdom modifier + druid level druid spells each day, with a minimum of one. You can prepare only spells for which you have spell slots
• You can use a druidic focus as a spellcasting focus
note.lvl02_details_zh:
野性變身

從第 2 級開始，你可以用你的行動神奇地呈現你以前見過的野獸的形狀。你可以使用此特性兩次。當你完成短休或長休後，你將恢復已消耗的用途。

你的德魯伊等級決定了你可以變身的野獸，如野獸形狀表中所示。例如，在第 2 級，你可以變身為任何挑戰等級為 1/4 或更低但沒有飛行或游泳速度的野獸。

你可以保持野獸形態的時間等於你德魯伊等級的一半（無條件捨去）。然後你將恢復到正常形式，除非你再次使用此特性。你可以透過在你的回合中使用附贈動作來提前恢復到正常狀態。如果你失去知覺、生命值降至 0 或死亡，你會自動恢復。

當你變身時，以下規則適用：

• 你的遊戲統計數據會被野獸的統計數據所取代，但你會保留你的陣營、個性以及智力、感知和魅力分數。除了獲得該生物的技能和豁免能力之外，你還保留了所有技能和豁免能力。如果該生物與你具有相同的熟練度，並且其屬性塊中的加值高於你的，則使用該生物的加值而不是你的。如果生物具有任何傳奇或巢穴動作，則你無法使用它們。
• 當你變形時，你會假設野獸的生命值和生命骰。當你恢復正常形態時，你的生命值會恢復到變身前的水準。然而，如果你因生命值降至 0 而恢復，任何多餘的傷害都會轉入你的正常形態。例如，如果你在動物形態下受到 10 點傷害並且只剩下 1 點生命值，那麼你會恢復並受到 9 點傷害。只要超額傷害不會將你正常形態的生命值降低至 0，你就不會被擊昏。
• 你不能施展法術，並且你說話或採取任何需要雙手的行動的能力都受到你野獸形態的能力的限制。然而，變形並不會破壞你對已經施展的法術的注意力，也不會阻止你採取屬於法術一部分的動作，例如你已經施展的召喚閃電。
• 你保留了來自你的職業、種族或其他來源的任何特性的好處，並且可以使用它們（如果新形態在身體上有能力這樣做的話）。然而，你不能使用任何特殊感官，例如黑暗視覺，除非你的新形態也有這種感覺。
• 你可以選擇你的裝備是掉落在你所在空間的地面上、融入你的新形態還是被它磨損。磨損的裝備可以正常工作，但 DM 根據生物的形狀和大小來決定新形態佩戴一件裝備是否實用。你的裝備不會改變尺寸或形狀來匹配新形態，並且新形態無法穿戴的任何裝備都必須掉落到地面或與其合併。與形態融合的裝備在你離開形態之前不會產生任何效果。

德魯伊結社

在第 2 級，你可以從可用結社清單中選擇認同德魯伊結社。你的選擇將授予你 2 級以及 6、10 和 14 級的特性。

德魯伊結社選項

大地結社

大地之環由神秘主義者和聖賢組成，他們透過廣泛的口頭傳統來保護古老的知識和儀式。這些德魯伊在神聖的樹木或立石圈內相遇，用德魯伊語低聲訴說原始秘密。該圈子中最聰明的成員擔任堅持舊信仰的社區的首席祭司，並擔任這些民間統治者的顧問。作為這個圈子的一員，你的魔法會受到你開始加入這個圈子神秘儀式的土地的影響。

額外戲法

你可以選擇額外學習一項德魯伊戲法。

自然恢復

從 2 級開始，你可以透過冥想和與大自然交流來恢復一些魔法能量。在短休期間，你可以選擇消耗的法術位來恢復。法術位的總等級可以等於或小於德魯伊等級的一半（無條件進位），並且沒有一個法術位可以達到 6 級或更高。在完成長休之前，你無法再次使用此特性

例如，當你是4級德魯伊時，你最多可以恢復兩級的法術位。你可以恢復一個2 環法術位或兩個1 環法術位。

結社法術

你與土地的神秘連結使你能施展特定法術。你會在德魯伊 3、5、7、9 級時，取得與加入結社時所在地形相關的結社法術。請選擇極地、海岸、沙漠、森林、草原、山地、沼澤或幽暗地域，並查閱對應的法術表。

一旦取得一個結社法術，你便會始終準備該法術，且不計入每日可準備的法術數量。若該法術不在德魯伊法術表上，對你而言仍視為德魯伊法術。

月亮結社

月亮結社德魯伊是荒野的兇猛守護者。他們的命令聚集在滿月下分享新聞和貿易警告。他們出沒於荒野的最深處，在那裡他們可能會連續幾週的時間，然後與另一個人形生物相遇，更不用說另一個德魯伊了。

這個圈子的德魯伊像月亮一樣變化無常，一晚可能會像一隻大貓一樣徘徊，第二天就會像一隻老鷹一樣翱翔在樹頂上，然後以熊的形態衝過灌木叢，趕走入侵的怪物。狂野是德魯伊的血液中。

戰鬥野性變身

你獲得在你的回合中使用野性變身的能力，作為附贈動作，而不是作為一個動作。

此外，當你被野性變身轉換時，你可以使用附贈動作消耗一個法術位，每消耗一級法術位就恢復 1d8 點生命值。

結社形態

你的圈子的儀式賦予你轉變成更危險的動物形態的能力。從第 2 級開始，你可以使用野性變身變身為挑戰等級高達 1 的野獸（你忽略野獸形狀表的最大 CR 列，但必須遵守那裡的其他限制）。

從 6 級開始，你可以變身為野獸，其挑戰等級等於你的德魯伊等級除以 3，無條件捨去。
note.lvl02_details_en:
Wild Shape

Starting at 2nd level, you can use your action to magically assume the shape of a beast that you have seen before. You can use this feature twice. You regain expended uses when you finish a short or long rest.

Your druid level determines the beasts you can transform into, as shown in the Beast Shapes table. At 2nd level, for example, you can transform into any beast that has a challenge rating of 1/4 or lower that doesn't have a flying or swimming speed.

You can stay in a beast shape for a number of hours equal to half your druid level (rounded down). You then revert to your normal form unless you expend another use of this feature. You can revert to your normal form earlier by using a bonus action on your turn. You automatically revert if you fall unconscious, drop to 0 hit points, or die.

While you are transformed, the following rules apply:

• Your game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the beast, but you retain your alignment, personality, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. You also retain all of your skill and saving throw proficiencies, in addition to gaining those of the creature. If the creature has the same proficiency as you and the bonus in its stat block is higher than yours, use the creature's bonus instead of yours. If the creature has any legendary or lair actions, you can't use them.
• When you transform, you assume the beast's hit points and Hit Dice. When you revert to your normal form, you return to the number of hit points you had before you transformed. However, if you revert as a result of dropping to 0 hit points, any excess damage carries over to your normal form. For example, if you take 10 damage in animal form and have only 1 hit point left, you revert and take 9 damage. As long as the excess damage doesn't reduce your normal form to 0 hit points, you aren't knocked unconscious.
• You can't cast spells, and your ability to speak or take any action that requires hands is limited to the capabilities of your beast form. Transforming doesn't break your concentration on a spell you've already cast, however, or prevent you from taking actions that are part of a spell, such as call lightning, that you've already cast.
• You retain the benefit of any features from your class, race, or other source and can use them if the new form is physically capable of doing so. However, you can't use any of your special senses, such as darkvision, unless your new form also has that sense.
• You choose whether your equipment falls to the ground in your space, merges into your new form, or is worn by it. Worn equipment functions as normal, but the DM decides whether it is practical for the new form to wear a piece of equipment, based on the creature's shape and size. Your equipment doesn't change size or shape to match the new form, and any equipment that the new form can't wear must either fall to the ground or merge with it. Equipment that merges with the form has no effect until you leave the form.

Druid Circle

At 2nd level, you choose to identify with a circle of druids from the list of available circles. Your choice grants you features at 2nd level and again at 6th, 10th, and 14th level.

Druid Circle Options

Circle of the Land

The Circle of the Land is made up of mystics and sages who safeguard ancient knowledge and rites through a vast oral tradition. These druids meet within sacred circles of trees or standing stones to whisper primal secrets in Druidic. The circle's wisest members preside as the chief priests of communities that hold to the Old Faith and serve as advisors to the rulers of those folk. As a member of this circle, your magic is influenced by the land where you were initiated into the circle's mysterious rites.

Bonus Cantrip

You learn one additional druid cantrip of your choice.

Natural Recovery

Starting at 2nd level, you can regain some of your magical energy by sitting in meditation and communing with nature. During a short rest, you choose expended spell slots to recover. The spell slots can have a combined level that is equal to or less than half your druid level (rounded up), and none of the slots can be 6th level or higher. You can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest

For example, when you are a 4th-level druid, you can recover up to two levels worth of spell slots. You can recover either a 2nd-level slot or two 1st-level slots.

Circle Spells

Your mystical connection to the land infuses you with the ability to cast certain spells. At 3rd, 5th, 7th, and 9th level you gain access to circle spells connected to the land where you became a druid. Choose that land - arctic, coast, desert, forest, grassland, mountain, swamp, or Underdark - and consult the associated list of spells.

Once you gain access to a circle spell, you always have it prepared, and it doesn't count against the number of spells you can prepare each day. If you gain access to a spell that doesn't appear on the druid spell list, the spell is nonetheless a druid spell for you.
