Circle of the Moon

Druids of the Circle of the Moon are fierce guardians of the wilds. Their order gathers under the full moon to share news and trade warnings. They haunt the deepest parts of the wilderness, where they might go for weeks on end before crossing paths with another humanoid creature, let alone another druid.

Changeable as the moon, a druid of this circle might prowl as a great cat one night, soar over the treetops as an eagle the next day, and crash through the undergrowth in bear form to drive off a trespassing monster. The wild is in the druid's blood.

Combat Wild Shape

You gain the ability to use Wild Shape on your turn as a bonus action, rather than as an action.

Additionally, while you are transformed by Wild Shape, you can use a bonus action to expend one spell slot to regain 1d8 hit points per level of the spell slot expended.

Circle Forms

The rites of your circle grant you the ability to transform into more dangerous animal forms. Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Wild Shape to transform into a beast with a challenge rating as high as 1 (you ignore the Max. CR column of the Beast Shapes table, but must abide by the other limitations there).

Starting at 6th level, you can transform into a beast with a challenge rating as high as your druid level divided by 3, rounded down.
note.lvl04_details_zh:
狂野體型改善

在第 4 級，你的野性變身會得到改善，如野獸形態表所示。

能力值提升

當你達到4級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl04_details_en:
Wild Shape Improvement

At 4th level, your Wild Shape improves as shown on the Beast Shapes table.

Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 4th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl06_details_zh:
德魯伊結社特性

在第 6 級，你獲得了德魯伊結社特性所授予的特性。

德魯伊結社選項

大地結社

大地的步伐

從第 6 級開始，穿越非魔法的困難地形不需要額外的移動。你也可以穿過非魔法植物，而不會被它們減慢速度，如果它們有刺、刺或類似的危險，也不會受到它們的傷害。

此外，你在對抗那些透過魔法創造或操縱來阻礙移動的植物（例如由糾纏法術創造的植物）時具有優勢。

月亮結社

原始打擊

從第 6 級開始，為了克服對非魔法攻擊和傷害的抵抗和免疫，你的野獸形態攻擊被視為魔法攻擊。
note.lvl06_details_en:
Druid Circle feature

At 6th level, you gain a feature granted by your Druid Circle feature.

Druid Circle Options

Circle of the Land

Land's Stride

Starting at 6th level, moving through nonmagical difficult terrain costs you no extra movement. You can also pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage from them if they have thorns, spines, or a similar hazard.

In addition, you have advantage on saving throws against plants that are magically created or manipulated to impede movement, such those created by the entangle spell.

Circle of the Moon

Primal Strike

Starting at 6th level, your attacks in beast form count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

元素野性變身

10級時，你可以同時使用兩次野性變身來變身為風元素、土元素、火元素或水元素。
note.lvl10_details_en:
Druid Circle feature

At 10th level, you gain a feature granted by your Druid Circle feature.

Druid Circle Options

Circle of the Land

Nature's Ward

When you reach 10th level, you can't be charmed or frightened by elementals or fey, and you are immune to poison and disease.

Circle of the Moon

Elemental Wild Shape

At 10th level, you can expend two uses of Wild Shape at the same time to transform into an air elemental, an earth elemental, a fire elemental, or a water elemental.

德魯伊結社選項

大地結社

自然保護區

當你達到 14 級時，自然世界的生物會感覺到你與大自然的聯繫，並會猶豫是否要攻擊你。當野獸或植物生物攻擊你時，生物必須針對你的德魯伊法術豁免 DC 進行感知豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，該生物必須選擇不同的目標，否則攻擊會自動失敗。豁免成功後，生物將在 24 小時內免疫此效果。

該生物在攻擊你之前就意識到了這種效果。

月亮結社

千種形式

到了 14 級，你已經學會了使用魔法以更微妙的方式改變你的身體形態。你可以隨意施放改變自我法術。
note.lvl14_details_en:
Druid Circle feature

At 14th level, you gain a feature granted by your Druid Circle feature.

Druid Circle Options

Circle of the Land

Nature's Sanctuary

When you reach 14th level, creatures of the natural world sense your connection to nature and become hesitant to attack you. When a beast or plant creature attacks you, that creature must make a Wisdom saving throw against your druid spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature must choose a different target, or the attack automatically misses. On a successful save, the creature is immune to this effect for 24 hours.

The creature is aware of this effect before it makes its attack against you.

Circle of the Moon

Thousand Forms

By 14th level, you have learned to use magic to alter your physical form in more subtle ways. You can cast the alter self spell at will.
note.lvl16_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到16級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

note.lvl18_details_zh:
永恆的身體

從 18 級開始，你所使用的原始魔法會讓你老得更慢。每過去 10 年，你的身體僅衰老 1 年。

野獸法術

從 18 級開始，你可以使用野性變身將許多德魯伊法術施展成你所呈現的任何形態。你可以在處於野獸形態時執行德魯伊法術的軀體和言語成分，但你無法提供物質成分。
note.lvl18_details_en:
Timeless Body

Starting at 18th level, the primal magic that you wield causes you to age more slowly. For every 10 years that pass, your body ages only 1 year.

Beast Spells

Beginning at 18th level, you can cast many of your druid spells in any shape you assume using Wild Shape. You can perform the somatic and verbal components of a druid spell while in a beast shape, but you aren't able to provide material components.
note.lvl19_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到19級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

note.lvl20_details_zh:
大德魯伊

20 級時，你可以無限次使用野性變身。

此外，你可以忽略德魯伊法術的語言和軀體成分，以及任何缺乏成本且不被法術消耗的材料成分。你可以在正常形態和野性變身的野獸形態中獲得這種好處。
note.lvl20_details_en:
Archdruid

At 20th level, you can use your Wild Shape an unlimited number of times.

Additionally, you can ignore the verbal and somatic components of your druid spells, as well as any material components that lack a cost and aren't consumed by a spell. You gain this benefit in both your normal shape and your beast shape from Wild Shape.

豁免：力量、體魄
note.basic_en:
Hit Dice: 1d10
Saving Throw: STR, CON
note.lvl01_details_zh:
熟練

• 護甲：所有護甲、盾牌
• 武器：簡易武器、軍用武器
• 技能：從體操、動物馴養、運動、歷史、察言觀色、威嚇、觀察、生存中選擇兩項

起始裝備

• 鎖子甲，或皮甲、長弓與 20 支箭
• 一把軍用武器與一面盾牌，或兩把軍用武器
• 輕弩與 20 支弩矢，或兩把手斧
• 地城探索者套組或探險者套組

戰鬥風格

選擇一種戰鬥風格；日後再次取得此特性時，不能重複選擇。

箭術

使用遠程武器進行攻擊檢定時獲得 +2 加值。

防禦

穿著護甲時，護甲等級 +1。

決鬥

單手持用一把近戰武器，且另一手未持武器時，該武器的傷害擲骰獲得 +2 加值。

巨武器戰鬥

雙手持用近戰武器進行攻擊，傷害骰擲出 1 或 2 時，可重擲一次並必須採用新結果。武器必須具有雙手或兩用屬性。

守護

持有盾牌時，若可見生物攻擊你 5 呎內的其他目標，可使用反應使該次攻擊檢定具有劣勢。

雙武器戰鬥

進行雙武器戰鬥時，可將能力調整值加到第二次攻擊的傷害。

回氣

可用附贈動作恢復 1d10 + 戰士等級 點生命值。完成短休或長休後可再次使用。
note.lvl01_details_en:
Proficiencies

• Armor: All armor and shields
• Weapons: Simple and martial weapons
• Skills: Choose two from Acrobatics, Animal Handling, Athletics, History, Insight, Intimidation, Perception, and Survival

Starting Equipment

• Chain mail, or leather armor, a longbow, and 20 arrows
• One martial weapon and a shield, or two martial weapons
• A light crossbow and 20 bolts, or two handaxes
• A dungeoneer's pack or explorer's pack

Fighting Style

Choose one fighting style. If you gain this feature again, you cannot choose the same style twice.

Archery

Gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls made with ranged weapons.

Defense

While wearing armor, gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class.

Dueling

When holding one melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

Great Weapon Fighting

When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for a melee weapon held in two hands, reroll that die once and use the new result. The weapon must have the two-handed or versatile property.

Protection

While wielding a shield, when a creature you can see attacks another target within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll.

Two-Weapon Fighting

When fighting with two weapons, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of the second attack.

Second Wind

As a bonus action, regain 1d10 + fighter level hit points. You regain this ability after a short or long rest.
note.lvl02_details_zh:
動作如潮

從第 2 級開始，你可以暫時超越自己的正常極限。輪到你時，除了主要動作和可能的額外動作之外，你還可以採取額外動作。

一旦你使用此特性，你必須完成短休或長休才能再次使用它。從 17 級開始，你可以在休息前使用它兩次，但同一回合只能使用一次。
note.lvl02_details_en:
Action Surge

Starting at 2nd level, you can push yourself beyond your normal limits for a moment. On your turn, you can take one additional action on top of your regular action and a possible bonus action.

Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again. Starting at 17th level, you can use it twice before a rest, but only once on the same turn.
note.lvl03_details_zh:
武術風範

在第 3 級，你可以從可用清單中選擇一個原型，並努力在戰鬥風格和技術中模仿該原型。你選擇的原型會授予你第 3 級以及第 7、10、15 和 18 級的特性。

武術風範選項

冠軍勇士

典型的冠軍專注於發展原始的體力，磨練到致命的完美。那些以這種原型為榜樣的人將嚴格的訓練與卓越的身體素質相結合，以應對毀滅性的打擊。

改進的關鍵

從你在第 3 級選擇此原型開始，你的武器攻擊在擲骰數為 19 或 20 時會獲得致命一擊。

戰鬥大師

那些模仿原型戰鬥大師的人使用代代相傳的武術技術。對於戰鬥大師來說，戰鬥是一個學術領域，有時還包括戰鬥以外的學科，例如武器鍛造和書法。並不是每個戰士都會吸收戰鬥大師原型中所反映的歷史、理論和藝術的教訓，但那些吸收的人都是擁有高超技能和知識的全面戰士。

戰爭學生

在第 3 級，你可以熟練使用你選擇的一種工匠工具。

戰鬥優勢

當你在第三級選擇這個原型時，你會學習由稱為優勢骰子的特殊骰子所推動的動作。

演習

你可以學習三種你選擇的動作，這些動作在下面的“動作”下列出。許多機動都以某種方式增強攻擊。每次攻擊只能使用一種動作。

你可以在第 7、10 和 15 級學習兩種你選擇的額外動作。每次學習新動作時，你都可以用不同的動作取代你所知道的一種動作。

優勢骰子

你有四個優勢骰子，都是 d8。當你使用優勢骰子時，它會被消耗。當你完成短休或長休後，你會重新獲得所有消耗的優勢骰子。

你在 7 級時獲得另一個優勢骰子，在 15 級時又獲得一個優勢骰子。

豁免檢定

你的一些動作需要你的目標進行一次豁免檢定來抵抗動作的效果。豁免DC計算如下：

保存DC：8+熟練加值+力量和敏捷調整值

從以下選項中進行選擇：

指揮官的打擊

當你在回合中採取攻擊動作時，你可以放棄一次攻擊並使用附贈動作來指揮你的一個同伴進行攻擊。當你這樣做時，選擇一個可以看到或聽到你的友好生物並消耗一個優勢骰子。該生物可以立即使用其反應進行一次武器攻擊，將優勢骰子加到攻擊的傷害檢定中。

解除攻擊

當你用武器攻擊擊中一個生物時，你可以花費一個優勢骰子來嘗試解除目標的武裝，迫使它掉落你選擇的一件它所持有的物品。你將優勢骰子加到攻擊的傷害檢定中，並且目標必須進行一次力量豁免檢定。儲存失敗時，它會刪除你選擇的物件。該物體落在它的腳下。

分散攻擊

當你用武器攻擊擊中一個生物時，你可以花費一個優勢骰子來分散生物的注意力，為你的盟友提供一個空當。你將優勢骰子加入攻擊的傷害檢定。如果攻擊是在你的下一回合開始之前進行的，則除你之外的攻擊者對目標進行的下一次攻擊檢定具有優勢。

迴避步法

當你移動時，你可以消耗一個優勢骰子，滾動骰子並將滾動的數字加到你的AC中，直到你停止移動。

佯攻

你可以花費一個優勢骰子，並在你的回合中使用一個附贈動作進行佯攻，選擇一個距離你 5 呎以內的生物作為你的目標。你在本回合對抗該生物的下一次攻擊檢定中具有優勢。如果該攻擊命中，則將優勢骰子加到該攻擊的傷害檢定中。

如果在獲得優勢的回合中不使用該優勢，該優勢就會消失。

刺激攻擊

當你用武器攻擊擊中一個生物時，你可以花費一個優勢骰子來嘗試刺激目標攻擊你。你將優勢骰子加到攻擊的傷害骰中，並且目標必須進行感知豁免。如果豁免失敗，則目標在對除你之外的目標的所有攻擊檢定中都處於劣勢，直到你的下一回合結束。

猛攻

當你在你的回合進行近戰武器攻擊時，你可以花費一個優勢骰子來增加你的攻擊範圍 5 呎。如果你擊中了，你就會將優勢骰子加到攻擊的傷害檢定中。

機動攻擊

當你用武器攻擊擊中一個生物時，你可以花費一個優勢骰子來將你的一位戰友轉移到更有利的位置。你將優勢骰子加到攻擊的傷害檢定中，然後選擇一個可以看到或聽到你的友方生物。該生物可以利用其反應將速度移動到其一半的速度，而不會引發你的攻擊目標的藉機攻擊。

來勢洶洶的攻擊

當你用武器攻擊擊中生物時，你可以花費一個優勢骰子來嘗試嚇唬目標。你將優勢骰子加到攻擊的傷害骰中，並且目標必須進行感知豁免。如果豁免失敗，它會害怕你，直到你的下一個回合結束。

招架

當另一個生物透過近戰攻擊對你造成傷害時，你可以使用你的反應並花費一個優勢骰子來減少傷害，減少的數值是你在優勢骰子上投出的數字+你的敏捷調整值。

精準攻擊

當你對一個生物進行武器攻擊檢定時，你可以花費一個優勢骰子將其加到檢定中。你可以在進行攻擊檢定之前或之後、但在攻擊的任何效果生效之前使用此機動。

推擊

當你用武器攻擊擊中一個生物時，你可以花費一個優勢骰子來嘗試將目標擊退。你將優勢骰子加到攻擊的傷害檢定中，如果目標較大或更小，則必須進行一次力量豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，你會將目標推到距離你 15 呎的地方。

拉力賽

在你的回合中，你可以使用附贈動作並花費一個優勢骰子來增強你的一位同伴的決心。當你這樣做時，選擇一個可以看到或聽到你的友善生物。該生物獲得的臨時生命值等於優勢擲骰+你的魅力調整值。

還擊

當生物的近戰攻擊沒有擊中你時，你可以利用你的反應並花費一個優勢骰子來對該生物進行近戰武器攻擊。如果你擊中了，你就會將優勢骰子加到攻擊的傷害檢定中。

橫掃進攻

當你用近戰武器攻擊擊中一個生物時，你可以花費一個優勢骰子來嘗試用相同的攻擊傷害另一個生物。選擇在原始目標 5 呎以內且在你的攻擊範圍內的另一個生物。如果最初的攻擊檢定擊中了第二個生物，它所受到的傷害等於你在優勢骰子上檢定的數值。傷害與原始攻擊造成的傷害類型相同。

絆倒攻擊

當你用武器攻擊擊中一個生物時，你可以花費一個優勢骰子來嘗試擊倒目標。你將優勢骰子加到攻擊的傷害檢定中，如果目標較大或更小，則必須進行一次力量豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，你會將目標擊倒。

奧法騎士

典型的恐怖騎士將所有戰士共有的武術掌握與對魔法的仔細研究結合在一起。恐怖騎士使用與巫師類似的魔法技巧。他們的研究重點是八個魔法流派中的兩個——防護術和召喚術。防護法術可以在戰鬥中為恐怖騎士提供額外的保護，召喚法術可以同時對許多敵人造成傷害，從而擴大戰士在戰鬥中的攻擊範圍。這些騎士學習的法術數量相對較少，將它們牢記在心，而不是保存在法術書中。

施法

當你達到第三級時，你可以透過施展法術的能力來增強你的軍事實力。有關施法的一般規則，請參閱第 10 章；有關巫師法術表，請參閱第 11 章。

戲法

你可以從巫師法術表中學習兩種你選擇的戲法。在第 10 級，​​你可以學習一個你選擇的額外巫師戲法。

法術位

恐怖騎士施法表顯示了你需要施放 1 級及更高等級法術的法術位。要施展其中一個法術，你必須消耗該法術等級或更高的槽位。當你完成長休後，你會重新獲得所有消耗的法術位。

例如，如果你知道 1 級法術護盾並且有 1 級和 2 級法術位可用，則可以使用任一插槽施放護盾。

1級以上的已知法術

你知道三個你選擇的一級巫師法術，其中兩個你必須從巫師法術表上的防護和召喚法術中選擇。

當你學習更多 1 級或更高級別的巫師法術時，邪術騎士施法表的已知法術列會顯示。這些法術中的每一個都必須是你選擇的防護或召喚法術，並且必須是你有法術位的等級。例如，當你在本課程中達到7級時，你可以學習一個1級或2級的新法術。

你在 8 級、14 級和 20 級學習的法術可以來自任何魔法學校。

每當你獲得該等級的等級時，你可以用你從巫師法術表中選擇的另一個法術替換你所知道的巫師法術之一。新法術必須屬於你有法術位的等級，而且它必須是防護法術或召喚法術，除非你要替換你在任何魔法學校的第3級、第8級、第14級或第20級獲得的法術。

施法能力

智力是你施展巫師法術的能力，因為你透過學習和記憶來學習法術。每當法術涉及你的施法能力時，你就使用你的智力。此外，在為你施放的法師法術設定豁免 DC 以及使用該法術進行攻擊檢定時，你會使用你的智力修正值。

豁免DC：8+熟練加值+智力調整值

法術

武器債券

在第 3 級，你學習一種儀式，在你和一件武器之間建立一種神奇的連結。整個儀式需要 1 小時，可以在短休期間完成。在整個儀式中，武器必須在你觸手可及的範圍內，儀式結束時，你觸摸武器並建立聯繫。

一旦你將武器與自己綁在一起，除非你喪失行為能力，否則你將無法解除該武器的武裝。如果它位於同一存在位面，你可以在你的回合中以附贈動作召喚該武器，使其立即傳送到你的手上。

你最多可以擁有兩把綁定武器，但透過附贈動作一次只能召喚一把。如果你嘗試與第三件武器建立聯繫，則必須打破與其他兩件武器之一的聯繫。
note.lvl03_details_en:
Martial Archetype

At 3rd level, you choose an archetype from the list available that you strive to emulate in your combat styles and techniques. The archetype you choose grants you features at 3rd level and again at 7th, 10th, 15th, and 18th level.

Martial Archetype Options

Champion

The archetypal Champion focuses on the development of raw physical power honed to deadly perfection. Those who model themselves on this archetype combine rigorous training with physical excellence to deal devastating blows.

Improved Critical

Beginning when you choose this archetype at 3rd level, your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

Battle Master

Those who emulate the archetypal Battle Master employ martial techniques passed down through generations. To a Battle Master, combat is an academic field, sometimes including subjects beyond battle such as weaponsmithing and calligraphy. Not every fighter absorbs the lessons of history, theory, and artistry that are reflected in the Battle Master archetype, but those who do are well-rounded fighters of great skill and knowledge.

Student of War

At 3rd level, you gain proficiency with one type of artisan's tools of your choice.

Combat Superiority

When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you learn maneuvers that are fueled by special dice called superiority dice.

Maneuvers

You learn three maneuvers of your choice, which are listed under "Maneuvers" below. Many maneuvers enhance an attack in some way. You can use only one maneuver per attack.

You learn two additional maneuvers of your choice at 7th, 10th, and 15th level. Each time you learn new maneuvers, you can also replace one maneuver you know with a different one.

Superiority Dice

You have four superiority dice, which are d8s. A superiority die is expended when you use it. You regain all of your expended superiority dice when you finish a short or long rest.

You gain another superiority die at 7th level and one more at 15th level.

Saving Throws

Some of your maneuvers require your target to make a saving throw to resist the maneuver's effects. The saving throw DC is calculated as follows:

Save DC: 8 + proficiency bonus + str and dex modifier

Choose from the following options:

Commander's Strike

When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can forgo one of your attacks and use a bonus action to direct one of your companions to strike. When you do so, choose a friendly creature who can see or hear you and expend one superiority die. That creature can immediately use its reaction to make one weapon attack, adding the superiority die to the attack's damage roll.

Disarming Attack

When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one superiority die to attempt to disarm the target, forcing it to drop one item of your choice that it's holding. You add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll, and the target must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it drops the object you choose. The object lands at its feet.

Distracting Strike

When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one superiority die to distract the creature, giving your allies an opening. You add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll. The next attack roll against the target by an attacker other than you has advantage if the attack is made before the start of your next turn.

Evasive Footwork

When you move, you can expend one superiority die, rolling the die and adding the number rolled to your AC until you stop moving.

Feinting Attack

You can expend one superiority die and use a bonus action on your turn to feint, choosing one creature within 5 feet of you as your target. You have advantage on your next attack roll this turn against that creature. If that attack hits, add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll.

The advantage is lost if not used on the turn you gain it.

Goading Attack

When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one superiority die to attempt to goad the target into attacking you. You add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll, and the target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target has disadvantage on all attack rolls against targets other than you until the end of your next turn.

Lunging Attack

When you make a melee weapon attack on your turn, you can expend one superiority die to increase your reach for that attack by 5 feet. If you hit, you add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll.

Maneuvering Attack

When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one superiority die to maneuver one of your comrades into a more advantageous position. You add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll, and you choose a friendly creature who can see or hear you. That creature can use its reaction to move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks from the target of your attack.

Menacing Attack

When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one superiority die to attempt to frighten the target. You add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll, and the target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is frightened of you until the end of your next turn.

Parry

When another creature damages you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction and expend one superiority die to reduce the damage by the number you roll on your superiority die + your Dexterity modifier.

Precision Attack

When you make a weapon attack roll against a creature, you can expend one superiority die to add it to the roll. You can use this maneuver before or after making the attack roll, but before any effects of the attack are applied.

Pushing Attack

When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one superiority die to attempt to drive the target back. You add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll, and if the target is Large or smaller, it must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, you push the target up to 15 feet away from you.

Rally

On your turn, you can use a bonus action and expend one superiority die to bolster the resolve of one of your companions. When you do so, choose a friendly creature who can see or hear you. That creature gains temporary hit points equal to the superiority die roll + your Charisma modifier.

Riposte

When a creature misses you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction and expend one superiority die to make a melee weapon attack against the creature. If you hit, you add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll.

Sweeping Attack

When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend one superiority die to attempt to damage another creature with the same attack. Choose another creature within 5 feet of the original target and within your reach. If the original attack roll would hit the second creature, it takes damage equal to the number you roll on your superiority die. The damage is of the same type dealt by the original attack.

Trip Attack

When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one superiority die to attempt to knock the target down. You add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll, and if the target is Large or smaller, it must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, you knock the target prone.

Eldritch Knight

The archetypal Eldritch Knight combines the martial mastery common to all fighters with a careful study of magic. Eldritch Knights use magical techniques similar to those practiced by wizards. They focus their study on two of the eight schools of magic—abjuration and evocation. Abjuration spells grant an Eldritch Knight additional protection in battle, and evocation spells deal damage to many foes at once, extending the fighter's reach in combat. These knights learn a comparatively small number of spells, committing them to memory instead of keeping them in a spellbook.

Spellcasting

When you reach 3rd level, you augment your martial prowess with the ability to cast spells. See chapter 10 for the general rules of spellcasting and chapter 11 for the wizard spell list.

Cantrips

You learn two cantrips of your choice from the wizard spell list. You learn an additional wizard cantrip of your choice at 10th level.

Spell Slots

The Eldritch Knight Spellcasting table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your spells of 1st level and higher. To cast one of these spells, you must expend a slot of the spell's level or higher. You regain all expended spell slots when you finish a long rest.

For example, if you know the 1st-level spell shield and have a 1st-level and a 2nd-level spell slot available, you can cast shield using either slot.

Spells Known of 1st-Level and Higher

You know three 1st-level wizard spells of your choice, two of which you must choose from the abjuration and evocation spells on the wizard spell list.

The Spells Known column of the Eldritch Knight Spellcasting table shows when you learn more wizard spells of 1st level or higher. Each of these spells must be an abjuration or evocation spell of your choice, and must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For instance, when you reach 7th level in this class, you can learn one new spell of 1st or 2nd level.

The spells you learn at 8th, 14th, and 20th level can come from any school of magic.

Whenever you gain a level in this class, you can replace one of the wizard spells you know with another spell of your choice from the wizard spell list. The new spell must be of a level for which you have spell slots, and it must be an abjuration or evocation spell, unless you're replacing the spell you gained at 3rd, 8th, 14th, or 20th level from any school of magic.

Spellcasting Ability

Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for your wizard spells, since you learn your spells through study and memorization. You use your Intelligence whenever a spell refers to your spellcasting ability. In addition, you use your Intelligence modifier when setting the saving throw DC for a wizard spell you cast and when making an attack roll with one.

Save DC: 8 + proficiency bonus + Intelligence modifier

Spell

Weapon Bond

At 3rd level, you learn a ritual that creates a magical bond between yourself and one weapon. You perform the ritual over the course of 1 hour, which can be done during a short rest. The weapon must be within your reach throughout the ritual, at the conclusion of which you touch the weapon and forge the bond.

Once you have bonded a weapon to yourself, you can't be disarmed of that weapon unless you are incapacitated. If it is on the same plane of existence, you can summon that weapon as a bonus action on your turn, causing it to teleport instantly to your hand.

You can have up to two bonded weapons, but can summon only one at a time with your bonus action. If you attempt to bond with a third weapon, you must break the bond with one of the other two.
note.lvl04_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到4級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl04_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 4th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl05_details_zh:
額外攻擊

從第 5 級開始，每當你在自己的回合中採取攻擊行動時，你可以攻擊兩次，而不是一次。

當你在這個職業中達到 11 級時，攻擊次數會增加到 3 次；當你在這個職業中達到 20 級時，攻擊次數會增加到 4 次。
note.lvl05_details_en:
Extra Attack

Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

The number of attacks increases to three when you reach 11th level in this class and to four when you reach 20th level in this class.
note.lvl06_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到6級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl06_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 6th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl07_details_zh:
武術風範特徵

在第 7 級，你獲得了你的武術風範所賦予的特性。

武術風範選項

冠軍勇士

傑出運動員

從 7 級開始，你可以將一半的熟練加值（無條件進位）加到你進行的任何尚未使用熟練加值的力量、敏捷或體質檢定中。

此外，当你进行奔跑跳远时，你可以移动的距离会增加等于你的力量调整值的呎数。

戰鬥大師

額外的演習

在第 7 級，你可以選擇學習兩種額外的動作。

額外的優勢模具

你在第 7 級獲得另一個優勢骰子。

了解你的敵人

如果你在戰鬥之外花至少 1 分鐘觀察或與另一個生物互動，你可以了解其與你自己的能力相比的某些資訊。 DM 會告訴你生物在你選擇的以下兩個特徵方面與你同等、優越或劣等：

• 力量得分
• 敏捷得分
• 體質分數
• 護甲等級
• 目前生命值
• 班級總水準（如果有）
• 戰鬥機等級（如果有）

奧法騎士

戰爭魔法

從 7 級開始，當你使用動作施展戲法時，你可以進行一次武器攻擊作為附贈動作。
note.lvl07_details_en:
Martial Archetype feature

At 7th level, you gain a feature granted by your Martial Archetype.

Martial Archetype Options

Champion

Remarkable Athlete

Starting at 7th level, you can add half your proficiency bonus (round up) to any Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution check you make that doesn't already use your proficiency bonus.

In addition, when you make a running long jump, the distance you can cover increases by a number of feet equal to your Strength modifier.

Battle Master

Additional Maneuvers

At 7th level, you learn two additional maneuvers of your choice.

Additional Superiority Die

You gain another superiority die at 7th level.

Know Your Enemy

If you spend at least 1 minute observing or interacting with another creature outside combat, you can learn certain information about its capabilities compared to your own. The DM tells you if the creature is your equal, superior, or inferior in regard to two of the following characteristics of your choice:

• Strength score
• Dexterity score
• Constitution score
• Armor Class
• Current hit points
• Total class levels (if any)
• Fighter class levels (if any)

Eldritch Knight

War Magic

Beginning at 7th level, when you use your action to cast a cantrip, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.
note.lvl08_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到8級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。正常情況下，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl08_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 8th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl09_details_zh:
不屈

從第 9 級開始，你可以重投失敗的豁免檢定。如果這樣做，則必須使用新的骰子，並且在完成長休之前不能再次使用此特性。

從 13 級開始，你可以在長休息之間使用此特性兩次，從 17 級開始，在長休息之間可以使用該特性 3 次。
note.lvl09_details_en:
Indomitable

Beginning at 9th level, you can reroll a saving throw that you fail. If you do so, you must use the new roll, and you can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest.

You can use this feature twice between long rests starting at 13th level and three times between long rests starting at 17th level.
note.lvl10_details_zh:
武術風範特徵

在第 10 級時，你獲得了你的武術風範所賦予的特性。

武術風範選項

冠軍勇士

額外的戰鬥風格

在第 10 級，你可以從戰鬥風格職業特性中選擇第二個選項。

戰鬥大師

額外的演習

在第 10 級，你可以選擇學習兩種額外的動作。

提高戰鬥優勢（d10）

在第 10 級，你的優勢骰子變成 d10。

奧法騎士

額外的戲法

在第 10 級，你可以學習一個你選擇的額外巫師戲法。

驚異打擊

在第 10 級，你學會如何讓你的武器攻擊削弱生物對你法術的抵抗力。當你用武器攻擊擊中一個生物時，該生物在下一次對抗你在下一個回合結束前施放的法術時會處於劣勢。
note.lvl10_details_en:
Martial Archetype feature

At 10th level, you gain a feature granted by your Martial Archetype.

Martial Archetype Options

Champion

Additional Fighting Style

At 10th level, you can choose a second option from the Fighting Style class feature.

Battle Master

Additional Maneuvers

At 10th level, you learn two additional maneuvers of your choice.

Improved Combat Superiority (d10)

At 10th level, your superiority dice turn into d10s.

Eldritch Knight

Additional Cantrip

You learn an additional wizard cantrip of your choice at 10th level.

Eldritch Strike

At 10th level, you learn how to make your weapon strikes undercut a creature's resistance to your spells. When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, that creature has disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.
note.lvl11_details_zh:
額外攻擊 (2)

11級時，每當你在回合中採取攻擊行動時，你可以攻擊3次。
note.lvl11_details_en:
Extra Attack (2)

At 11th level, you can attack three times whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
note.lvl12_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到12級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl12_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 12th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl13_details_zh:
不屈（兩種用途）

在 13 級，你可以在長休之間使用不屈兩次。
note.lvl13_details_en:
Indomitable (two uses)

At 13th level, you can use Indomitable twice between long rests.
note.lvl14_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到14級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl14_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 14th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl15_details_zh:
武術風範特徵

在第 15 級，你獲得了你的武術風範所賦予的特性。

武術風範選項

冠軍勇士

進階關鍵

從 15 級開始，你的武器攻擊在擲骰中獲得致命一擊，擲骰數為 18-20。

戰鬥大師

額外的演習

在第 15 級，你可以選擇學習兩種額外的動作。

額外的優勢模具

你在第 15 級獲得另一個優勢骰子。

無情

從 15 級開始，當你投出主動權並且沒有剩餘優勢骰子時，你將重新獲得 1 個優勢骰子。

奧法騎士

奧術衝鋒

在 15 級時，你可以傳送至 30 呎遠的未佔據空間，當你使用行動湧動時，你可以看到該空間。你可以在附加操作之前或之後傳送。
note.lvl15_details_en:
Martial Archetype feature

At 15th level, you gain a feature granted by your Martial Archetype.

Martial Archetype Options

Champion

Superior Critical

Starting at 15th level, your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18-20.

Battle Master

Additional Maneuvers

At 15th level, you learn two additional maneuvers of your choice.

Additional Superiority Die

You gain another superiority die at 15th level.

Relentless

Starting at 15th level, when you roll initiative and have no superiority dice remaining, you regain 1 superiority die.

Eldritch Knight

Arcane Charge

At 15th level, you gain the ability to teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see when you use your Action Surge. You can teleport before or after the additional action.
note.lvl16_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到16級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl16_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 16th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl17_details_zh:
動作如潮（兩種用途）

17級時，你可以在休息前使用動作如潮兩次，但同一回合只能使用一次。

不屈（三用）

17級時，你可以在長休之間使用不屈3次。
note.lvl17_details_en:
Action Surge (two uses)

At 17th level, you can use Action Surge twice before a rest, but only once on the same turn.

Indomitable (three uses)

At 17th level, you can use Indomitable three times between long rests.
note.lvl18_details_zh:
武術風範特徵

在 18 級時，你獲得了你的武術風範所賦予的特性。

武術風範選項

冠軍勇士

倖存者

18級時，你在戰鬥中達到了巔峰的韌性。在你的每個回合開始時，如果你剩餘的生命值不超過一半，你將恢復等於 5 + 你的體質調整值的生命值。如果你的生命值為 0，你就不會獲得此好處。

戰鬥大師

提高戰鬥優勢（d12）

在 18 級，你的優勢骰子變成 d12。

奧法騎士

強化戰爭魔法

從 18 級開始，當你使用動作施展法術時，你可以進行一次武器攻擊作為附贈動作。
note.lvl18_details_en:
Martial Archetype feature

At 18th level, you gain a feature granted by your Martial Archetype.

Martial Archetype Options

Champion

Survivor

At 18th level, you attain the pinnacle of resilience in battle. At the start of each of your turns, you regain hit points equal to 5 + your Constitution modifier if you have no more than half of your hit points left. You don't gain this benefit if you have 0 hit points.

Battle Master

Improved Combat Superiority (d12)

At 18th level, your superiority dice turn into d12s.

Eldritch Knight

Improved War Magic

Starting at 18th level, when you use your action to cast a spell, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.
note.lvl19_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到19級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl19_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 19th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl20_details_zh:
額外攻擊 (3)

在20級時，每當你在回合中採取攻擊行動時，你可以攻擊四次。
note.lvl20_details_en:
Extra Attack (3)

At 20th level, you can attack four times whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

note.basic_zh:
生命骰：1d8
豁免：力量、敏捷
note.basic_en:
Hit Dice: 1d8
Saving Throw: STR, DEX
note.lvl01_details_zh:
熟練

• 武器：簡易武器、短劍
• 工具：任一工匠工具或樂器
• 技能：從體操、運動、歷史、察言觀色、宗教、隱匿中選擇兩項

起始裝備

• 短劍，或任一簡易武器
• 地城探索者套組或探險者套組
• 10 枚飛鏢

無甲防禦

未穿著護甲且未持盾牌時，護甲等級為 10 + 敏捷調整值 + 感知調整值。

武術

未穿著護甲、未持盾牌，且僅空手或持用武僧武器時：

• 可用敏捷取代力量進行空手與武僧武器的攻擊及傷害擲骰
• 可用 d4 取代空手與武僧武器的原始傷害骰；此骰會隨等級提高
• 在攻擊動作中使用空手或武僧武器後，可用附贈動作再進行一次空手攻擊

武僧武器包括短劍，以及不具雙手或重型屬性的簡易近戰武器。
note.lvl01_details_en:
Proficiencies

• Weapons: Simple weapons and shortswords
• Tools: One artisan's tool or musical instrument of your choice
• Skills: Choose two from Acrobatics, Athletics, History, Insight, Religion, and Stealth

Starting Equipment

• A shortsword or any simple weapon
• A dungeoneer's pack or explorer's pack
• 10 darts

Unarmored Defense

While not wearing armor or wielding a shield, your Armor Class equals 10 + Dexterity modifier + Wisdom modifier.

Martial Arts

While unarmored, not wielding a shield, and using only unarmed strikes or monk weapons:

• You can use Dexterity instead of Strength for attack and damage rolls with unarmed strikes and monk weapons
• You can use a d4 in place of the normal damage die for unarmed strikes and monk weapons; this die increases with level
• After using an unarmed strike or monk weapon as part of the Attack action, you can make one unarmed strike as a bonus action

Monk weapons are shortswords and simple melee weapons without the two-handed or heavy property.
note.lvl02_details_zh:
氣

從第二級開始，你的訓練可以讓你利用氣的神秘能量。你對這種能量的獲取由 ki 點的數量表示。你的武僧等級決定了你擁有的點數，如武僧表的 Ki 點數 列所示。

你可以使用這些積分來增強各種 ki 特性。你開始了解三個這樣的特性：連擊、耐心防禦和飛簷走壁。當你在本課程中獲得等級時，你會學到更多的 ki 特性。

當你消耗氣點時，只有在完成短休或長休後才能使用，休息結束後，你將所有消耗的氣重新吸回體內。剩下的時間你必須花至少 30 分鐘冥想才能恢復你的氣點。

你的一些氣特性要求你的目標進行一次豁免檢定來抵抗該特性的效果。豁免DC計算如下：

能力DC：8+熟練加值+感知調整值

連續打擊

在你的回合中採取攻擊行動後，你可以立即花費 1 點氣進行兩次徒手攻擊作為附贈動作。

堅強防禦

你可以花費 1 點氣來採取閃避動作，作為你回合的附贈動作。

飛簷走壁

你可以花費 1 點氣來採取脫離或衝刺動作作為你回合的附贈動作，並且你的跳躍距離在該回合加倍。

無甲移動

從 2 級開始，當你不穿著盔甲或揮舞盾牌時，你的速度會增加 10 呎。當你達到一定的武僧等級時，此加值會增加，如武僧表中所示。

在第 9 級，你能夠在輪流中沿著垂直表面移動並穿過液體，而不會在移動過程中跌倒。
note.lvl02_details_en:
Ki

Starting at 2nd level, your training allows you to harness the mystic energy of ki. Your access to this energy is represented by a number of ki points. Your monk level determines the number of points you have, as shown in the Ki Points column of the Monk table.

You can spend these points to fuel various ki features. You start knowing three such features: Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, and Step of the Wind. You learn more ki features as you gain levels in this class.

When you spend a ki point, it is unavailable until you finish a short or long rest, at the end of which you draw all of your expended ki back into yourself. You must spend at least 30 minutes of the rest meditating to regain your ki points.

Some of your ki features require your target to make a saving throw to resist the feature's effects. The saving throw DC is calculated as follows:

Ability DC: 8 + proficiency bonus + wis modifier

Flurry of Blows

Immediately after you take the Attack action on your turn, you can spend 1 ki point to make two unarmed strikes as a bonus action.

Patient Defense

You can spend 1 ki point to take the Dodge action as a bonus action on your turn.

Step of the Wind

You can spend 1 ki point to take the Disengage or Dash action as a bonus action on your turn, and your jump distance is doubled for the turn.

Unarmored Movement

Starting at 2nd level, your speed increases by 10 feet while you are not wearing armor or wielding a shield. This bonus increases when you reach certain monk levels, as shown in the Monk table.

At 9th level, you gain the ability to move along vertical surfaces and across liquids on your turn without falling during the move.
note.lvl03_details_zh:
撥擋飛彈

從第 3 級開始，當你被遠程武器攻擊擊中時，你可以利用你的反應來偏轉或捕獲導彈。當你這樣做時，你受到的攻擊傷害會減少 1d10 + 你的敏捷調整值 + 你的武僧等級。

如果將傷害降低到 0，並且導彈足夠小，可以用一隻手握住，並且你至少有一隻手空閒，那麼你就可以抓住導彈。如果你以這種方式捕獲導彈，你可以花費 1 ki 點使用你剛剛捕獲的武器或彈藥進行遠程攻擊（範圍 20/60 呎），作為同一反應的一部分。無論你的武器熟練程度如何，你都會熟練地進行這次攻擊，並且導彈算作這次攻擊的武僧武器。

宗派

當你達到第三級時，你將致力於從可用宗派清單中選擇的宗派。你的傳統賦予你第 3 級以及第 6、11 和 17 級的特性。
note.lvl03_details_en:
Deflect Missiles

Starting at 3rd level, you can use your reaction to deflect or catch the missile when you are hit by a ranged weapon attack. When you do so, the damage you take from the attack is reduced by 1d10 + your Dexterity modifier + your monk level.

If you reduce the damage to 0, you can catch the missile if it is small enough for you to hold in one hand and you have at least one hand free. If you catch a missile in this way, you can spend 1 ki point to make a ranged attack (range 20/60 feet) with the weapon or piece of ammunition you just caught, as part of the same reaction. You make this attack with proficiency, regardless of your weapon proficiencies, and the missile counts as a monk weapon for the attack.

Monastic Tradition

When you reach 3rd level, you commit yourself to a monastic tradition, chosen from the list of available traditions. Your tradition grants you features at 3rd level and again at 6th, 11th, and 17th level.
note.lvl04_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到4級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。

輕身墜

從 4 級開始，你可以在跌倒時使用你的反應來減少你受到的跌倒傷害，傷害值相當於你武僧等級的五倍。
note.lvl04_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 4th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.

Slow Fall

Beginning at 4th level, you can use your reaction when you fall to reduce any falling damage you take by an amount equal to five times your monk level.
note.lvl05_details_zh:
額外攻擊

從第 5 級開始，每當你在自己的回合中採取攻擊行動時，你可以攻擊兩次，而不是一次。

震懾拳

從第 5 級開始，你可以乾擾對手體內的氣流。當你用近戰武器攻擊擊中另一個生物時，你可以花費 1 點氣來嘗試一次驚人的攻擊。目標必須成功通過體質豁免，否則將被眩暈直到你的下一個回合結束。
note.lvl05_details_en:
Extra Attack

Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

Stunning Strike

Starting at 5th level, you can interfere with the flow of ki in an opponent's body. When you hit another creature with a melee weapon attack, you can spend 1 ki point to attempt a stunning strike. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of your next turn.
note.lvl06_details_zh:
真氣駐拳

從等級 6 開始，為了克服對非魔法攻擊和傷害的抵抗和免疫，你的徒手攻擊算作魔法攻擊。

宗派能力

在第 6 級，你獲得了宗派所授予的一項特性。
note.lvl06_details_en:
Ki-Empowered Strikes

Starting at 6th level, your unarmed strikes count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

Monastic Tradition feature

At 6th level, you gain one feature granted by your Monastic Tradition.
note.lvl07_details_zh:
反射閃避

在 7 級時，你本能的敏捷性可以讓你躲避某些區域效果，例如藍龍的閃電吐息或火球術。當你受到允許你進行敏捷豁免檢定僅受到一半傷害的效果時，如果你豁免檢定成功，你將不會受到任何傷害，如果你失敗，你只會受到一半傷害。

心頭滅卻

從第 7 級開始，你可以用你的行動來結束對你自己造成的一種導致你被魅惑或恐懼的效果。
note.lvl07_details_en:
Evasion

At 7th level, your instinctive agility lets you dodge out of the way of certain area effects, such as a blue dragon's lightning breath or a fireball spell. When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if you fail.

Stillness of Mind

Starting at 7th level, you can use your action to end one effect on yourself that is causing you to be charmed or frightened.
note.lvl08_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到8級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。正常情況下，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl08_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 8th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl09_details_zh:
無甲移動進階

在第 9 級，你能夠在輪流中沿著垂直表面移動並穿過液體，而不會在移動過程中跌倒。
note.lvl09_details_en:
Unarmored Movement improvement

At 9th level, you gain the ability to move along vertical surfaces and across liquids on your turn without falling during the move.
note.lvl10_details_zh:
百病不侵

10級時，你對流經體內的氣的掌握使你免疫疾病和毒藥。
note.lvl10_details_en:
Purity of Body

At 10th level, your mastery of the ki flowing through you makes you immune to disease and poison.
note.lvl11_details_zh:
宗派能力

在第 11 級，你獲得了一項由你的宗派授予的特性。
note.lvl11_details_en:
Monastic Tradition feature

At 11th level, you gain one feature granted by your Monastic Tradition.
note.lvl12_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到12級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl12_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 12th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl13_details_zh:
天語通

從第 13 級開始，你學習接觸他人心靈的“氣”，以便理解所有口語。此外，任何能夠理解語言的生物都可以理解你所說的話。
note.lvl13_details_en:
Tongue of the Sun and Moon

Starting at 13th level, you learn to touch the ki of other minds so that you understand all spoken languages. Moreover, any creature that can understand a language can understand what you say.
note.lvl14_details_zh:
金剛魂

從 14 級開始，你對氣的掌握使你精通所有豁免檢定。

此外，每當你進行豁免檢定並失敗時，你可以花費 1 點氣重新投擲並獲得第二個結果。
note.lvl14_details_en:
Diamond Soul

Beginning at 14th level, your mastery of ki grants you proficiency in all saving throws.

Additionally, whenever you make a saving throw and fail, you can spend 1 ki point to reroll it and take the second result.
note.lvl15_details_zh:
不朽身

在15級時，你的氣會支撐你，這樣你就不會遭受年老時的虛弱之苦，而且你也不會神奇地變老。然而，你仍然可能因年老而死亡。此外，你不再需要食物或水。
note.lvl15_details_en:
Timeless Body

At 15th level, your ki sustains you so that you suffer none of the frailty of old age, and you can't be aged magically. You can still die of old age, however. In addition, you no longer need food or water.
note.lvl16_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到16級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl16_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 16th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl17_details_zh:
宗派能力

在第 17 級，你獲得了一項由你的宗派授予的特性。
note.lvl17_details_en:
Monastic Tradition feature

At 17th level, you gain one feature granted by your Monastic Tradition.
note.lvl18_details_zh:
空靈體

從 18 級開始，你可以用你的行動花費 4 點氣來隱形 1 分鐘。在此期間，你還可以抵抗除力力傷害之外的所有傷害。

此外，你可以花費8點氣來施放星體投射法術，而不需要材料成分。當你這樣做時，你不能帶走任何其他生物。
note.lvl18_details_en:
Empty Body

Beginning at 18th level, you can use your action to spend 4 ki points to become invisible for 1 minute. During that time, you also have resistance to all damage but force damage.

Additionally, you can spend 8 ki points to cast the astral projection spell, without needing material components. When you do so, you can't take any other creatures with you.
note.lvl19_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到19級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl19_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 19th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl20_details_zh:
超凡體

在20級，當你投出主動權並且沒有剩餘氣點時，你會恢復4點氣。
note.lvl20_details_en:
Perfect Soul

At 20th level, when you roll for initiative and have no ki points remaining, you regain 4 ki points.

note.basic_zh:
生命骰：1d10
豁免：感知、魅力
note.basic_en:
Hit Dice: 1d10
Saving Throw: WIS, CHA
note.lvl01_details_zh:
熟練

• 護甲：所有護甲、盾牌
• 武器：簡易武器、軍用武器
• 技能：從運動、察言觀色、威嚇、醫藥、遊說、宗教中選擇兩項

起始裝備

• 一把軍用武器與一面盾牌，或兩把軍用武器
• 五把標槍，或任一簡易近戰武器
• 祭司套組或探險者套組
• 鎖子甲與聖徽

神聖感知

使用動作後，直到下回合結束前，你會知道 60 呎內未受全身掩蔽的天界生物、邪魔與不死生物的位置及類型，但無法得知個體身分。你也能感知範圍內受聖化或褻瀆的地點或物品。每次長休前可使用 1 + 魅力調整值 次，至少一次。

聖療

你擁有等於 聖騎士等級 × 5 的治療池。可用動作觸碰生物並消耗池中點數，恢復等量生命值；也可消耗 5 點治癒一種疾病或中和一種毒素。此能力對不死生物與構裝生物無效，完成長休後恢復治療池。
note.lvl01_details_en:
Proficiencies

• Armor: All armor and shields
• Weapons: Simple and martial weapons
• Skills: Choose two from Athletics, Insight, Intimidation, Medicine, Persuasion, and Religion

Starting Equipment

• One martial weapon and a shield, or two martial weapons
• Five javelins or any simple melee weapon
• A priest's pack or explorer's pack
• Chain mail and a holy symbol

Divine Sense

As an action, until the end of your next turn, you know the location and type of any celestial, fiend, or undead within 60 feet that is not behind total cover, but not its identity. You also detect consecrated or desecrated places or objects in range. You can use this feature 1 + Charisma modifier times per long rest, with a minimum of once.

Lay on Hands

You have a healing pool equal to paladin level × 5. As an action, touch a creature and spend points from the pool to restore that many hit points. You can instead spend 5 points to cure one disease or neutralize one poison. This feature has no effect on undead or constructs, and the pool replenishes after a long rest.
note.lvl02_details_zh:
神聖之擊

從第 2 級開始，當你用近戰武器攻擊擊中生物時，除了武器傷害之外，你還可以花費一個法術位對目標造成光輝傷害。 1級法術位的額外傷害為2d8，每高於1級的法術位額外傷害1d8，最多為5d8。如果目標是不死族或惡魔，則傷害增加 1d8。

戰鬥風格

你採用特定的戰鬥風格作為你的專長。從選用特性清單中選擇一種戰鬥風格。即使你可以再次選擇，你也不能多次選擇相同的戰鬥風格選項。

選擇以下選項之一：

近距離射擊

當你在敵對生物 5 呎範圍內進行遠程攻擊時，你在攻擊檢定上不會處於劣勢。你的遠程攻擊會忽略對你 30 呎內目標的半掩護和四分之三掩護。你在遠程攻擊時的攻擊檢定有+1加值。

防禦

當你穿著盔甲時，你的AC獲得+1加值。

決鬥

當你一手揮舞近戰武器而沒有其他武器時，你使用該武器的傷害檢定獲得+2加值。

巨型武器戰鬥

當你使用兩隻手揮舞的近戰武器進行攻擊時，在傷害骰子上擲出 1 或 2 時，你可以重新擲骰子，並且必須使用新的骰子。該武器必須具有雙手或多用途屬性才能獲得此好處。

水手

只要你沒有穿著重甲或使用盾牌，你的游泳速度和攀爬速度就等於你的正常速度，而且你的AC獲得+1加值。

保護

當你能看到的生物攻擊距離你 5 呎內除你之外的目標時，你可以利用你的反應對攻擊檢定施加不利影響。你一定拿著盾牌。

隧道戰士

作為附贈動作，你可以進入防禦姿態，持續到你的下一個回合開始。當處於防禦姿態時，你可以在不使用反應的情況下進行藉機攻擊，並且可以使用你的反應對在你的攻擊範圍內移動超過 5 呎的生物進行近戰攻擊。

施法

到了第二級，你已經學會了透過冥想和祈禱來利用神聖魔法來像牧師一樣施展法術。有關施法的一般規則，請參閱第 10 章；有關聖騎士法術表，請參閱第 11 章。

準備和施法

聖騎士表格顯示了你必須施展法術的法術位數量。要施展你的一個 1 級或更高等級的聖騎士法術，你必須消耗該法術等級或更高的一個槽位。當你完成長休後，你會重新獲得所有消耗的法術位。

你準備可供你施展的聖騎士法術表，從聖騎士法術表中進行選擇。當你這樣做時，選擇一定數量的聖騎士法術，數量等於你的魅力調整值+你的聖騎士等級的一半，無條件捨去（至少一個法術）。這些法術必須屬於你有法術位的等級。

例如，如果你是 5 級聖騎士，則你有 4 個 1 級法術位和 2 個 2 級法術位。當魅力為 14 時，你準備的法術表可以包括 4 個 1 級或 2 級法術的任意組合。如果你準備了 1 級法術來治療傷口，則可以使用 1 級或 2 級插槽來施放它。施展該法術並不會將其從你準備好的法術表中刪除。

當你完成長休後，你可以改變你準備好的法術表。準備一份新的聖騎士法術表需要花費時間進行祈禱和冥想：清單中的每個法術每個法術等級至少需要 1 分鐘。

施法能力

魅力是你對聖騎士法術的施法能力，因為它們的力量源自於你堅定的信念。每當法術涉及你的施法能力時，你就使用你的魅力。此外，在為你施放的聖騎士法術設定豁免 DC 以及使用該法術進行攻擊檢定時，你可以使用你的魅力調整值。

能力DC：8+熟練加值+魅力調整值

法術

施法焦點

你可以使用聖徽作為聖騎士法術的施法焦點。
note.lvl02_details_en:
Divine Smite

Starting at 2nd level, when you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend one spell slot to deal radiant damage to the target, in addition to the weapon's damage. The extra damage is 2d8 for a 1st-level spell slot, plus 1d8 for each spell level higher than 1st, to a maximum of 5d8. The damage increases by 1d8 if the target is an undead or a fiend.

Fighting Style

You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. Choose a fighting style from the list of optional features. You can't take the same Fighting Style option more than once, even if you get to choose again.

Choose one of the following:

Close Quarters Shooter

When making a ranged attack while you are within 5 feet of a hostile creature, you do not have disadvantage on the attack roll. Your ranged attacks ignore half cover and three-quarters cover against targets within 30 feet of you. You have a +1 bonus to attack rolls on ranged attacks.

Defense

While you are wearing armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

Dueling

When you are wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

Great Weapon Fighting

When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for an attack you make with a melee weapon that you are wielding with two hands, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll. The weapon must have the two-handed or versatile property for you to gain this benefit.

Mariner

As long as you are not wearing heavy armor or using a shield, you have a swimming speed and a climbing speed equal to your normal speed, and you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

Protection

When a creature you can see attacks a target other than you that is within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll. You must be wielding a shield.

Tunnel Fighter

As a bonus action, you can enter a defensive stance that lasts until the start of your next turn. While in your defensive stance, you can make opportunity attacks without using your reaction, and you can use your reaction to make a melee attack against a creature that moves more than 5 feet while within your reach.

Spellcasting

By 2nd level, you have learned to draw on divine magic through meditation and prayer to cast spells as a cleric does. See chapter 10 for the general rules of spellcasting and chapter 11 for the paladin spell list.

Preparing and Casting Spells

The Paladin table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your spells. To cast one of your paladin spells of 1st level or higher, you must expend a slot of the spell's level or higher. You regain all expended spell slots when you finish a long rest.

You prepare the list of paladin spells that are available for you to cast, choosing from the paladin spell list. When you do so, choose a number of paladin spells equal to your Charisma modifier + half your paladin level, rounded down (minimum of one spell). The spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots.

For example, if you are a 5th-level paladin, you have four 1st-level and two 2nd-level spell slots. With a Charisma of 14, your list of prepared spells can include four spells of 1st or 2nd-level, in any combination. If you prepare the 1st-level spell cure wounds, you can cast it using a 1st-level or a 2nd-level slot. Casting the spell doesn't remove it from your list of prepared spells.

You can change your list of prepared spells when you finish a long rest. Preparing a new list of paladin spells requires time spent in prayer and meditation: at least 1 minute per spell level for each spell on your list.

Spellcasting Ability

Charisma is your spellcasting ability for your paladin spells, since their power derives from the strength of your convictions. You use your Charisma whenever a spell refers to your spellcasting ability. In addition, you use your Charisma modifier when setting the saving throw DC for a paladin spell you cast and when making an attack roll with one.

Ability DC: 8 + proficiency bonus + cha modifier

Spell

Spellcasting Focus

You can use a holy symbol as a spellcasting focus for your paladin spells.
note.lvl03_details_zh:
神聖健康

到了第三級，流經你體內的神聖魔法使你對疾病免疫。

神聖誓言

當你達到第 3 級時，你就立下了永遠成為聖騎士的誓言。到目前為止，你一直處於準備階段，致力於修道，但尚未發誓。現在你可以從可用的誓言清單中進行選擇。

你的選擇將授予你第 3 級以及第 7、15 和 20 級的特性。這些特性包括誓言法術和通道神性特性。

誓言法術

每個誓言都有一個相關法術表。你可以在誓言描述中指定的等級使用這些法術。一旦你獲得了誓言法術，你就必須做好準備。誓言法術不計入你每天可以準備的法術數量。

如果你獲得的誓言法術沒有出現在聖騎士法術表中，那麼法術仍然是適合你的聖騎士法術。

引導神力

你的誓言可以讓你引導神聖能量來激發魔法效果。你的誓言提供的每個通道神性選項都解釋瞭如何使用它。

當你使用引導神力時，你可以選擇要使用的選項。然後，你必須完成短休或長休才能再次使用你的通道神性。

某些引導神性效果需要豁免檢定。當你使用此類效果時，DC 等於你的聖騎士法術豁免 DC。

違背誓言

聖騎士努力遵守最高的行為標準，但即使是最有道德的聖騎士也難免犯錯。有時，正確的道路要求太高，有時，情況需要兩害相權取其輕，有時，情緒的熾熱會導致聖騎士違背他或她的誓言。

違背誓言的聖騎士通常會尋求與他或她有共同信仰的牧師或同階聖騎士的赦免。聖騎士可能會整夜守夜祈禱，以示懺悔，或採取快速或類似的自我否定行為。在懺悔和寬恕的儀式之後，聖騎士重新開始。

如果聖騎士故意違背自己的誓言並且沒有任何悔改的跡象，那麼後果可能會更加嚴重。根據 DM 的判斷，不知悔改的聖騎士可能會被迫放棄這個職業並採用另一個職業，或者可能選擇《地下城主指南》中出現的破誓者聖騎士選項。

神聖誓言選項

遠古誓言

古老誓言與精靈種族和德魯伊儀式一樣古老。有時被稱為精類騎士、綠騎士或有角騎士的聖騎士們，發誓在宇宙與黑暗的鬥爭中站在光明一邊，因為他們熱愛世界上美麗和賦予生命的事物，不一定是因為他們相信榮譽、勇氣和正義的原則。他們在盔甲和衣服上裝飾有正在生長的事物——樹葉、鹿角或花朵——的圖案，以反映他們對保護世界生命和光明的承諾。

古人的信條

上古誓言的信條已經被保存了無數個世紀。這個誓言強調善良的原則高於任何法律或混亂的擔憂。它的四個核心原則很簡單。

點燃光

透過你的仁慈、仁慈和寬恕的行為，點燃世界的希望之光，擊退絕望。

庇護光

世界上哪裡有善、美、愛和歡笑，哪裡就有吞噬它們的惡。在生命繁榮的地方，要對抗那些使它變得貧瘠的力量。

保護自己的光

享受歌聲和笑聲、美麗和藝術。如果你讓自己心中的光熄滅，你就無法將它保存在世界上。

成為光

成為所有生活在絕望中的人的光榮燈塔。讓你的喜悅和勇氣之光在你的所有行為中閃耀。

誓言法術

你在列出的聖武士等級中獲得誓言法術。

|聖騎士等級 |法術|
| --- | --- |
|第三 |誘捕打擊，與動物對話|
|第五 |月光，迷濛步|
|9日 |植物生長，免受能量影響|
| 13日 |冰風暴，石膚|
| 17日 |與大自然交流，樹大步走|

引導神性：自然之怒

你可以使用你的通道神性來召喚原始力量來誘捕敵人。作為一個動作，你可以使幽靈藤蔓彈出並到達你能看到的 10 呎範圍內的生物。該生物必須成功通過力量或敏捷豁免檢定（由其選擇），否則就會被束縛。當被藤蔓束縛時，該生物會在每個回合結束時重複豁免檢定。一旦成功，它就會釋放自己，藤蔓就會消失。

引導神性：扭轉失信者

你可以使用你的神性通道說出讓精類和惡魔聽到會感到痛苦的古老話語。作為一個動作，你展示你的聖徽，距離你 30 呎內的每一個能聽到你聲音的精類或惡魔都必須進行一次感知豁免。如果豁免失敗，該生物會翻轉 1 分鐘或直到受到傷害。

一個變身的生物必須花很多時間嘗試移動到離你盡可能遠的地方，而且它不能自願移動到距離你 30 呎以內的空間。它也無法做出反應。對於其動作，它只能使用衝刺動作或嘗試逃離阻止其移動的效果。如果無處可移動，則該生物可以使用閃避動作。

如果該生物的真實形態被幻象、變形或其他效果隱藏，那麼該生物的形態會在其轉身時顯露出來。

奉獻誓言

忠誠誓言將聖武士與正義、美德和秩序的崇高理想聯繫在一起。這些聖騎士有時被稱為騎士、白騎士或聖武士，他們符合穿著閃亮盔甲的騎士的理想，以榮譽行事，追求正義和更大的利益。他們要求自己遵守最高的行為標準，而有些人，無論好壞，也要求世界其他地方遵守同樣的標準。許多發下此誓言的人都虔誠地信仰法律和善良之神，並用他們神的信條來衡量他們的忠誠度。他們將天使——完美的善僕——視為自己的理想，並將天使翅膀的圖案融入他們的頭盔或紋章中。

奉獻信條

儘管忠誠誓言的確切用詞和限制各不相同，但該誓言的聖武士們都遵循這些原則。

誠實

不要說謊或欺騙。讓你的話成為你的承諾。

勇氣

永遠不要害怕採取行動，儘管謹慎是明智的。

同情心

幫助他人，保護弱者，懲罰威脅他們的人。對你的敵人表現出憐憫，但要用智慧來緩和它。

榮譽資質

公平對待他人，讓你的光榮行為成為他人的榜樣。盡可能多行善，同時造成最少的傷害。

職責

對你的行為及其後果負責，保護那些託付給你照顧的人，並服從那些對你有公正權威的人。

誓言法術

你在列出的聖武士等級中獲得誓言法術。

|聖騎士等級 |法術|
| --- | --- |
|第三 |免受邪惡和善良的保護，庇護所|
|第五 |較小的恢復，真理區|
| 9日 |希望的燈塔，驅散魔法|
| 13日 |行動自由，信仰守護者|
| 17日 |公社，火焰襲擊|

引導神性：神聖武器

作為一個動作，你可以使用你的神性通道為你所持有的一件武器注入正能量。在 1 分鐘內，你將你的魅力調整值加到使用該武器進行的攻擊檢定中（最低加值+1）。該武器還在 20 呎半徑內發出明亮的光線，並在半徑 20 呎之外發出昏暗的光線。如果該武器尚未具有魔法，則會在持續時間內變得具有魔法。

作為任何其他行動的一部分，你可以在你的回合結束此效果。如果你不再持有或攜帶該武器，或者你失去知覺，效果就會結束。

引導神性：扭轉邪惡

作為一個動作，你展示你的聖徽，並使用你的通道神性進行譴責惡魔和不死生物的祈禱。每個在你周圍 30 呎內能看到或聽到你的惡魔或不死生物都必須進行一次感知豁免。如果生物未能通過豁免檢定，它將被翻轉 1 分鐘或直到受到傷害。

一個變身的生物必須花很多時間嘗試移動到離你盡可能遠的地方，而且它不能自願移動到距離你 30 呎以內的空間。它也無法做出反應。對於其動作，它只能使用衝刺動作或嘗試逃離阻止其移動的效果。如果無處可移動，則該生物可以使用閃避動作。

復仇誓言

復仇誓言是懲罰那些犯下嚴重罪行的人的莊嚴承諾。當邪惡勢力屠殺無助的村民時，當整個民族違背神的意志時，當盜賊行會變得過於暴力和強大時，當巨龍橫行鄉村時——在這樣的時刻，聖武士們就會站出來發誓復仇，以糾正錯誤。對於這些有時被稱為復仇者或黑闇騎士的聖騎士來說，他們自己的純潔性並不像伸張正義那麼重要。

復仇的信條

復仇誓言的信條因聖武士而異，但所有信條都圍繞著以任何必要手段懲罰不法之徒。秉持這些信條的聖武士甚至願意犧牲自己的正義來為那些作惡的人伸張正義，因此聖武士通常是中立或守序中立的陣營。這些原則的核心原則非常簡單。

與更大的邪惡作鬥爭

面臨著與我的死敵戰鬥或與較小的邪惡戰鬥的選擇。我選擇更大的邪惡。

對惡人毫不憐憫

普通的敵人可能會贏得我的憐憫，但我的不共戴天的敵人卻不會。

採取任何必要的手段

我的疑慮無法阻止我消滅敵人。

恢復原狀

如果我的敵人毀滅了世界，那是因為我沒能阻止他們。我必須幫助那些因自己的不當行為而受到傷害的人。

誓言法術

|第三 |禍根，獵人標記|
|第五 |牽人，飄渺步|
|9日 |匆忙，能量防護|
| 13日 |放逐，次元門|
| 17日 |抓住怪物，探知|

引導神性：赦免敵人

作為一個行動，你展示你的聖徽，並使用你的通道神性說出譴責的祈禱。選擇一個距離你 60 呎內你能看到的生物。該生物必須進行感知豁免檢定，除非它免疫恐懼。惡魔和不死生物在此豁免檢定上處於劣勢。

如果豁免失敗，該生物會受到恐懼 1 分鐘或直到任何傷害。當受到驚嚇時，該生物的速度為 0，並且無法獲得任何速度加成。

豁免成功後，生物的速度減半 1 分鐘或直到生物受到任何傷害。

引導神性：敵意誓言

作為附贈動作，你可以使用你的引導神性，對你在 10 呎內看到的生物發出敵意誓言。你在對抗該生物的攻擊檢定上獲得優勢，持續 1 分鐘或直到其生命值降至 0 或失去知覺。
note.lvl03_details_en:
Divine Health

By 3rd level, the divine magic flowing through you makes you immune to disease.

Sacred Oath

When you reach 3rd level, you swear the oath that binds you as a paladin forever. Up to this time you have been in a preparatory stage, committed to the path but not yet sworn to it. Now you choose from the list of available oaths.

Your choice grants you features at 3rd level and again at 7th, 15th, and 20th level. Those features include oath spells and the Channel Divinity feature.

Oath Spells

Each oath has a list of associated spells. You gain access to these spells at the leves specified in the oath description. Once you gain access to an oath spell, you always have it prepared. Oath spells don't count against the number of spells you can prepare each day.

If you gain an oath spell that doesn't appear on the paladin spell list, the spell is nonetheless a paladin spell for you.

Channel Divinity

Your oath allows you to channel divine energy to fuel magical effects. Each Channel Divinity option provided by your oath explains how to use it.

When you use your Channel Divinity, you choose which option to use. You must then finish a short or long rest to use your Channel Divinity again.

Some Channel Divinity effects require saving throws. When you use such an effect from this class, the DC equals your paladin spell save DC.

Breaking Your Oath

A paladin tries to hold to the highest standards of conduct, but even the most virtuous paladin is fallible. Sometimes the right path proves too demanding, sometimes a situation calls for the lesser of two evils, and sometimes the heat of emotion causes a paladin to transgress his or her oath.

A paladin who has broken a vow typically seeks absolution from a cleric who shares his or her faith or from another paladin of the same order. The paladin might spend an all-night vigil in prayer as a sign of penitence, or undertake a fast or similar act of self-denial. After a rite of confession and forgiveness, the paladin starts fresh.

If a paladin willfully violates his or her oath and shows no sign of repentance, the consequences can be more serious. At the DM's discretion, an impenitent paladin might be forced to abandon this class and adopt another, or perhaps to take the Oathbreaker paladin option that appears in the Dungeon Master's Guide.

Sacred Oath Options

Oath of the Ancients

The Oath of the Ancients is as old as the race of elves and the rituals of the druids. Sometimes called fey knights, green knights, or horned knights, paladins who swear this oath cast their lot with the side of the light in the cosmic struggle against darkness because they love the beautiful and life-giving things of the world, not necessarily because they believe in principles of honor, courage, and justice. They adorn their armor and clothing with images of growing things—leaves, antlers, or flowers—to reflect their commitment to preserving life and light in the world.

Tenets of the Ancients

The tenets of the Oath of the Ancients have been preserved for uncounted centuries. This oath emphasizes the principles of good above any concerns of law or chaos. Its four central principles are simple.

Kindle the Light

Through your acts of mercy, kindness, and forgiveness, kindle the light of hope in the world, beating back despair.

Shelter the Light

Where there is good, beauty, love, and laughter in the world, stand against the wickedness that would swallow it. Where life flourishes, stand against the forces that would render it barren.

Preserve Your Own Light

Delight in song and laughter, in beauty and art. If you allow the light to die in your own heart, you can't preserve it in the world.

Be the Light

Be a glorious beacon for all who live in despair. Let the light of your joy and courage shine forth in all your deeds.

Oath Spells

You gain oath spells at the paladin levels listed.

| Paladin Level | Spells |
| --- | --- |
| 3rd | ensnaring strike, speak with animals |
| 5th | moonbeam, misty step |
| 9th | plant growth, protection from energy |
| 13th | ice storm, stoneskin |
| 17th | commune with nature, tree stride |

Channel Divinity: Nature's Wrath

You can use your Channel Divinity to invoke primeval forces to ensnare a foe. As an action, you can cause spectral vines to spring up and reach for a creature within 10 feet of you that you can see. The creature must succeed on a Strength or Dexterity saving throw (its choice) or be restrained. While restrained by the vines, the creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a success, it frees itself and the vines vanish.

Channel Divinity: Turn the Faithless

You can use your Channel Divinity to utter ancient words that are painful for fey and fiends to hear. As an action, you present your holy symbol, and each fey or fiend within 30 feet of you that can hear you must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is turned for 1 minute or until it takes damage.

A turned creature must spend its turns trying to move as far away from you as it can, and it can't willingly move to a space within 30 feet of you. It also can't take reactions. For its action, it can use only the Dash action or try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving. If there's nowhere to move, the creature can use the Dodge action.

If the creature's true form is concealed by an illusion, shapeshifting, or other effect, that form is revealed while it is turned.

Oath of Devotion

The Oath of Devotion binds a paladin to the loftiest ideals of justice, virtue, and order. Sometimes called cavaliers, white knights, or holy warriors, these paladins meet the ideal of the knight in shining armor, acting with honor in pursuit of justice and the greater good. They hold themselves to the highest standards of conduct, and some, for better or worse, hold the rest of the world to the same standards. Many who swear this oath are devoted to gods of law and good and use their gods' tenets as the measure of their devotion. They hold angels—the perfect servants of good—as their ideals, and incorporate images of angelic wings into their helmets or coats of arms.

Tenets of Devotion

Though the exact words and strictures of the Oath of Devotion vary, paladins of this oath share these tenets.

Honesty

Don't lie or cheat. Let your word be your promise.

Courage

Never fear to act, though caution is wise.

Compassion

Aid others, protect the weak, and punish those who threaten them. Show mercy to your foes, but temper it with wisdom.

Honor

Treat others with fairness, and let your honorable deeds be an example to them. Do as much good as possible while causing the least amount of harm.

Duty

Be responsible for your actions and their consequences, protect those entrusted to your care, and obey those who have just authority over you.

Oath Spells

You gain oath spells at the paladin levels listed.

| Paladin Level | Spells |
| --- | --- |
| 3rd | protection from evil and good, sanctuary |
| 5th | lesser restoration, zone of truth |
| 9th | beacon of hope, dispel magic |
| 13th | freedom of movement, guardian of faith |
| 17th | commune, flame strike |

Channel Divinity: Sacred Weapon

As an action, you can imbue one weapon that you are holding with positive energy, using your Channel Divinity. For 1 minute, you add your Charisma modifier to attack rolls made with that weapon (with a minimum bonus of +1). The weapon also emits bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light 20 feet beyond that. If the weapon is not already magical, it becomes magical for the duration.

You can end this effect on your turn as part of any other action. If you are no longer holding or carrying this weapon, or if you fall unconscious, this effect ends.

Channel Divinity: Turn the Unholy

As an action, you present your holy symbol and speak a prayer censuring fiends and undead, using your Channel Divinity. Each fiend or undead that can see or hear you within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw. If the creature fails its saving throw, it is turned for 1 minute or until it takes damage.

A turned creature must spend its turns trying to move as far away from you as it can, and it can't willingly move to a space within 30 feet of you. It also can't take reactions. For its action, it can use only the Dash action or try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving. If there's nowhere to move, the creature can use the Dodge action.

Oath of Vengeance

The Oath of Vengeance is a solemn commitment to punish those who have committed a grievous sin. When evil forces slaughter helpless villagers, when an entire people turns against the will of the gods, when a thieves' guild grows too violent and powerful, when a dragon rampages through the countryside - at times like these, paladins arise and swear an Oath of Vengeance to set right that which has gone wrong. To these paladins—sometimes called avengers or dark knights—their own purity is not as important as delivering justice.

Tenets of Vengeance

The tenets of the Oath of Vengeance vary by paladin, but all the tenets revolve around punishing wrongdoers by any means necessary. Paladins who uphold these tenets are willing to sacrifice even their own righteousness to mete out justice upon those who do evil, so the paladins are often neutral or lawful neutral in alignment. The core principles of the tenets are brutally simple.

Fight the Greater Evil

Faced with a choice of fighting my sworn foes or combating a lesser evil. I choose the greater evil.

No Mercy for the Wicked

Ordinary foes might win my mercy, but my sworn enemies do not.

By Any Means Necessary

My qualms can't get in the way of exterminating my foes.

Restitution

If my foes wreak ruin on the world, it is because I failed to stop them. I must help those harmed by their misdeeds.

Oath Spells

You gain oath spells at the paladin levels listed.

| Paladin Level | Spells |
| --- | --- |
| 3rd | bane, hunter's mark |
| 5th | hold person, misty step |
| 9th | haste, protection from energy |
| 13th | banishment, dimension door |
| 17th | hold monster, scrying |

Channel Divinity: Abjure Enemy

As an action, you present your holy symbol and speak a prayer of denunciation, using your Channel Divinity. Choose one creature within 60 feet of you that you can see. That creature must make a Wisdom saving throw, unless it is immune to being frightened. Fiends and undead have disadvantage on this saving throw.

On a failed save, the creature is frightened for 1 minute or until it takes any damage. While frightened, the creature's speed is 0, and it can't benefit from any bonus to its speed.

On a successful save, the creature's speed is halved for 1 minute or until the creature takes any damage.

Channel Divinity: Vow of Enmity

As a bonus action, you can utter a vow of enmity against a creature you can see within 10 feet of you, using your Channel Divinity. You gain advantage on attack rolls against the creature for 1 minute or until it drops to 0 hit points or falls unconscious.

能力值提升

當你達到4級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 4th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl05_details_zh:
額外攻擊

從第 5 級開始，每當你在自己的回合中採取攻擊行動時，你可以攻擊兩次，而不是一次。
note.lvl05_details_en:
Extra Attack

Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
note.lvl06_details_zh:
保護光環

從第 6 級開始，每當你或你周圍 10 呎內的友方生物必須進行豁免檢定時，該生物將在豁免檢定上獲得等於你的魅力調整值的加值（加值最低為+1）。你必須有意識地授予此額外。

在 18 級時，該光環的範圍增加到 30 呎。
note.lvl06_details_en:
Aura of Protection

Starting at 6th level, whenever you or a friendly creature within 10 feet of you must make a saving throw, the creature gains a bonus to the saving throw equal to your Charisma modifier (with a minimum bonus of +1). You must be conscious to grant this bonus.

At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.
note.lvl07_details_zh:
神聖誓言特性

在第 7 級，你獲得了神聖誓言賦予你的一項特性。

神聖誓言選項

遠古誓言

守護光環

從第 7 級開始，遠古魔法對你的影響如此之大，以至於形成了一個可怕的結界。你和你周圍 10 呎內的友方生物對法術傷害具有抵抗力。

在 18 級時，該光環的範圍增加到 30 呎。

奉獻誓言

虔誠光環

從第 7 級開始，當你有意識時，你和你周圍 10 呎內的友方生物無法被魅惑。

在 18 級時，該光環的範圍增加到 30 呎。

復仇誓言

無情復仇者

到了 7 級，你的超自然專注可以幫助你封鎖敵人的退路。當你藉機攻擊擊中生物時，你可以在攻擊後立即將速度提高一半，並且作為同一反應的一部分。此移動不會引發藉機攻擊。
note.lvl07_details_en:
Sacred Oath feature

At 7th level, you gain a feature granted to you by your Sacred Oath.

Sacred Oath Options

Oath of the Ancients

Aura of Warding

Beginning at 7th level, ancient magic lies so heavily upon you that it forms an eldritch ward. You and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you have resistance to damage from spells.

At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.

Oath of Devotion

Aura of Devotion

Starting at 7th level, you and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you can't be charmed while you are conscious.

At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.

Oath of Vengeance

Relentless Avenger

By 7th level, your supernatural focus helps you close off a foe's retreat. When you hit a creature with an opportunity attack, you can move up to half your speed immediately after the attack and as part of the same reaction. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

Ability Score Improvement

note.lvl10_details_zh:
勇氣光環

從第 10 級開始，當你有意識時，你和你周圍 10 呎內的友方生物不會被嚇到。

note.lvl10_details_en:
Aura of Courage

Starting at 10th level, you and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you can't be frightened while you are conscious.

At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.
note.lvl11_details_zh:
強化神聖打擊

到了11級，你已經充滿了正義的力量，你所有的近戰武器攻擊都帶有神聖的力量。每當你用近戰武器擊中生物時，生物會受到額外的 1d8 光輝傷害。如果你在攻擊中還使用了神聖重擊，則將此傷害添加到神聖重擊的額外傷害中。
note.lvl11_details_en:
Improved Divine Smite

By 11th level, you are so suffused with righteous might that all your melee weapon strikes carry divine power with them. Whenever you hit a creature with a melee weapon, the creature takes an extra 1d8 radiant damage. If you also use your Divine Smite with an attack, you add this damage to the extra damage of your Divine Smite.
note.lvl12_details_zh:
能力值提升
