如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl12_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 12th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl14_details_zh:
清潔觸感

從14級開始，你可以用你的動作結束對你自己或你觸摸的一個自願生物的一個法術。

你可以使用此特性的次數等於你的魅力調整值（至少一次）。當你完成長休後，你將恢復已消耗的用途。
note.lvl14_details_en:
Cleansing Touch

Beginning at 14th level, you can use your action to end one spell on yourself or on one willing creature that you touch.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (a minimum of once). You regain expended uses when you finish a long rest.
note.lvl15_details_zh:
神聖誓言特性

15級時，你獲得了神聖誓言賦予你的一項特性。

神聖誓言選項

遠古誓言

不朽哨兵

從15級開始，當你的生命值降低到0並且沒有被直接殺死時，你可以選擇將生命值降低到1。一旦你使用了這個能力，你就不能再使用它，直到你完成長休。

此外，你不會遭受年老帶來的任何弊端，也不會神奇地變老。

奉獻誓言

精神的純潔

從 15 級開始，你始終受到邪惡和善良法術的保護。

復仇誓言

復仇之魂

從 15 級開始，你說出敵意誓言的權威賦予你對敵人更大的力量。當受到你的敵意誓言影響的生物進行攻擊時，如果該生物在攻擊範圍內，你可以使用你的反應對該生物進行近戰武器攻擊。
note.lvl15_details_en:
Sacred Oath feature

At 15th level, you gain a feature granted to you by your Sacred Oath.

Sacred Oath Options

Oath of the Ancients

Undying Sentinel

Starting at 15th level, when you are reduced to 0 hit points and are not killed outright, you can choose to drop to 1 hit point instead. Once you use this ability, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

Additionally, you suffer none of the drawbacks of old age, and you can't be aged magically.

Oath of Devotion

Purity of Spirit

Beginning at 15th level, you are always under the effects of a protection from evil and good spell.

Oath of Vengeance

Soul of Vengeance

Starting at 15th level, the authority with which you speak your Vow of Enmity gives you greater power over your foe. When a creature under the effect of your Vow of Enmity makes an attack, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against that creature if it is within range.
note.lvl16_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到16級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl16_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 16th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl18_details_zh:
光環改進

18 級時，你的防護光環範圍增加至 30 呎。
note.lvl18_details_en:
Aura improvements

At 18th level, the range of your Aura of Protection increases to 30 feet.
note.lvl19_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到19級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl19_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 19th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl20_details_zh:
神聖誓言特性

在 20 級時，你獲得了神聖誓言賦予你的一項特性。

神聖誓言選項

遠古誓言

長老冠軍

在20級時，你可以呈現出一種古老的自然力量的形態，呈現出你選擇的外觀。例如，你的皮膚可能會變綠或呈現樹皮狀紋理，你的頭髮可能會變得綠葉狀或苔蘚狀，或者你可能會長出鹿角或獅子狀的鬃毛。

透過你的行動，你會經歷轉變。 1 分鐘，你將獲得以下好處：

• 在你的每個回合開始時，你會恢復 10 點生命值。
• 每當你施放一個施法時間為1個動作的聖騎士法術時，你可以使用你的附贈動作來施放它。
• 距離你 10 呎內的敵方生物在對抗你的聖武士法術和引導神力選項的豁免檢定中處於劣勢。

一旦使用此特性，在完成長休之前將無法再次使用。

奉獻誓言

神聖雨雲

20級時，作為一個動作，你可以散發出陽光的光環。在 1 分鐘內，明亮的光線會照射到你周圍 30 呎的半徑範圍內，而昏暗的光線則會照射到半徑 30 呎以外的地方。

每當敵方生物在強光下開始回合時，該生物就會受到 10 點光輝傷害。

此外，在持續時間內，你在對抗惡魔或不死生物施展的法術時擁有豁免檢定優勢。

一旦使用此特性，在完成長休之前將無法再次使用。

復仇誓言

復仇天使

20級時，你可以化身為天使復仇者。透過你的行動，你會經歷轉變。 1小時內，你可以獲得以下好處：

• 翅膀從你的背後長出，賦予你60呎的飛行速度。
• 你在30呎半徑範圍內散發出威脅的氣息。當任何敵方生物第一次進入光環或在戰鬥中開始其回合時，該生物必須成功通過感知豁免檢定，否則就會對你感到恐懼，持續 1 分鐘或直到它受到任何傷害。對受驚生物的攻擊檢定具有優勢。

一旦使用此特性，在完成長休之前將無法再次使用。
note.lvl20_details_en:
Sacred Oath feature

At 20th level, you gain a feature granted to you by your Sacred Oath.

Sacred Oath Options

Oath of the Ancients

Elder Champion

At 20th level, you can assume the form of an ancient force of nature, taking on an appearance you choose. For example, your skin might turn green or take on a bark-like texture, your hair might become leafy or mosslike, or you might sprout antlers or a lion-like mane.

Using your action, you undergo a transformation. For 1 minute, you gain the following benefits:

• At the start of each of your turns, you regain 10 hit points.
• Whenever you cast a paladin spell that has a casting time of 1 action, you can cast it using your bonus action instead.
• Enemy creatures within 10 feet of you have disadvantage on saving throws against your paladin spells and Channel Divinity options.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

Oath of Devotion

Holy Nimbus

At 20th level, as an action, you can emanate an aura of sunlight. For 1 minute, bright light shines from you in a 30-foot radius, and dim light shines 30 feet beyond that.

Whenever an enemy creature starts its turn in the bright light, the creature takes 10 radiant damage.

In addition, for the duration, you have advantage on saving throws against spells cast by fiends or undead.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

Oath of Vengeance

Avenging Angel

At 20th level, you can assume the form of an angelic avenger. Using your action, you undergo a transformation. For 1 hour, you gain the following benefits:

• Wings sprout from your back and grant you a flying speed of 60 feet.
• You emanate an aura of menace in a 30-foot radius. The first time any enemy creature enters the aura or starts its turn there during a battle, the creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of you for 1 minute or until it takes any damage. Attack rolls against the frightened creature have advantage.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

note.basic_zh:
生命骰：1d10
豁免：力量、敏捷
note.basic_en:
Hit Dice: 1d10
Saving Throw: STR, DEX
note.lvl01_details_zh:
熟練

• 護甲：輕甲、中甲、盾牌
• 武器：簡易武器、軍用武器
• 技能：從動物馴養、運動、察言觀色、調查、自然、觀察、隱匿、生存中選擇三項

起始裝備

• 鱗甲或皮甲
• 兩把短劍，或兩把簡易近戰武器
• 地城探索者套組或探險者套組
• 長弓與裝有 20 支箭的箭袋

宿敵

選擇一類宿敵：異怪、野獸、天界生物、構裝生物、龍、元素生物、精類、邪魔、巨人、怪獸、泥怪、植物或不死生物；也可改選兩類類人生物。

追蹤宿敵的感知（生存）檢定，以及回想其相關資訊的智力檢定具有優勢。若宿敵會說話，還可學會其使用的一種語言。

自然探索者

選擇一種偏好地形：極地、海岸、沙漠、森林、草原、山地、沼澤或幽暗地域。進行與該地形有關的智力或感知檢定時，若使用熟練技能，熟練加值加倍。

在偏好地形旅行一小時以上時：

• 困難地形不會減緩團隊的旅行速度
• 除非受到魔法影響，團隊不會迷路
• 即使從事覓食、導航或追蹤等其他活動，仍會對危險保持警戒
• 獨自行動時，可用正常速度隱匿移動
• 覓食時可找到兩倍食物
• 追蹤生物時，可得知其確切數量、體型，以及經過此處多久
note.lvl01_details_en:
Proficiencies

• Armor: Light armor, medium armor, and shields
• Weapons: Simple and martial weapons
• Skills: Choose three from Animal Handling, Athletics, Insight, Investigation, Nature, Perception, Stealth, and Survival

Starting Equipment

• Scale mail or leather armor
• Two shortswords or two simple melee weapons
• A dungeoneer's pack or explorer's pack
• A longbow and a quiver of 20 arrows

Favored Enemy

Choose one favored enemy type: aberrations, beasts, celestials, constructs, dragons, elementals, fey, fiends, giants, monstrosities, oozes, plants, or undead. Alternatively, choose two types of humanoids.

You have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track favored enemies and on Intelligence checks to recall information about them. If your favored enemies speak a language, you also learn one language they use.

Natural Explorer

Choose one favored terrain: arctic, coast, desert, forest, grassland, mountain, swamp, or the Underdark. On Intelligence or Wisdom checks related to that terrain, double your proficiency bonus if you use a proficient skill.

When traveling through favored terrain for at least 1 hour:

• Difficult terrain does not slow your group's travel
• Your group cannot become lost except by magical means
• You remain alert to danger while performing another activity, such as foraging, navigating, or tracking
• When traveling alone, you can move stealthily at a normal pace
• You find twice as much food while foraging
• While tracking, you learn the creatures' exact number, sizes, and how long ago they passed through the area
note.lvl02_details_zh:
戰鬥風格

在第二級，你將採用一種特定的戰鬥風格作為你的專長。選擇以下選項之一：射箭、防禦、決鬥、水手或雙武器格鬥。即使你稍後可以再次選擇，你也不能多次選擇戰鬥風格選項。

選擇以下選項之一：

射箭

你使用遠程武器進行的攻擊檢定獲得+2加值。

近距離射擊

當你在敵對生物 5 呎範圍內進行遠程攻擊時，你在攻擊檢定上不會處於劣勢。你的遠程攻擊會忽略對你 30 呎內目標的半掩護和四分之三掩護。你在遠程攻擊時的攻擊檢定有+1加值。

防禦

當你穿著盔甲時，你的AC獲得+1加值。

決鬥

當你一手揮舞近戰武器而沒有其他武器時，你使用該武器的傷害檢定獲得+2加值。

水手

只要你沒有穿著重甲或使用盾牌，你的游泳速度和攀爬速度就等於你的正常速度，而且你的AC獲得+1加值。

隧道戰士

作為附贈動作，你可以進入防禦姿態，持續到你的下一個回合開始。當處於防禦姿態時，你可以在不使用反應的情況下進行藉機攻擊，並且可以使用你的反應對在你的攻擊範圍內移動超過 5 呎的生物進行近戰攻擊。

雙武器戰鬥

當你進行雙武器戰鬥時，你可以將你的能力調整值加到第二次攻擊的傷害上。

施法

當你達到第二級時，你已經學會了使用自然的魔法本質來施展法術，就像德魯伊一樣。

法術位

遊俠表顯示了你需要多少個法術位來施放 1 級及更高級別的法術。要施展其中一個法術，你必須消耗該法術等級或更高的槽位。當你完成長休後，你會重新獲得所有消耗的法術位。

例如，如果你知道 1 級法術「動物友誼」並且有可用的 1 級和 2 級法術插槽，則可以使用任一插槽施放動物友誼。

1級以上的已知法術

你知道遊俠法術表中你選擇的兩個 1 級法術。

遊俠表的已知法術列顯示你何時學習了更多你選擇的遊俠法術。這些法術中的每一個都必須屬於你有法術位的等級。例如，當你在本課程中達到5級時，你可以學習一個1級或2級的新法術。

此外，當你獲得該等級的等級時，你可以選擇你所知道的遊俠法術之一，並將其替換為遊俠法術表中的另一個法術，該法術也必須屬於你擁有法術位的等級。

施法能力

智慧是你對遊俠法術的施法能力，因為你的魔法依賴你對大自然的協調。每當法術涉及到你的施法能力時，你就使用你的智慧。此外，在為你施放的遊俠法術設定豁免 DC 以及使用遊俠法術進行攻擊檢定時，你可以使用你的感知調整值。

能力DC：8+熟練加值+感知調整值
note.lvl02_details_en:
Fighting Style

At 2nd level, you adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. Choose one of the following options: Archery, Defense, Dueling, Mariner, or Two-Weapon Fighting. You can't take a Fighting Style option more than once, even if you later get to choose again.

Choose one of the following:

Archery

You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with ranged weapons.

Close Quarters Shooter

When making a ranged attack while you are within 5 feet of a hostile creature, you do not have disadvantage on the attack roll. Your ranged attacks ignore half cover and three-quarters cover against targets within 30 feet of you. You have a +1 bonus to attack rolls on ranged attacks.

Defense

While you are wearing armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

Dueling

When you are wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

Mariner

As long as you are not wearing heavy armor or using a shield, you have a swimming speed and a climbing speed equal to your normal speed, and you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

Tunnel Fighter

As a bonus action, you can enter a defensive stance that lasts until the start of your next turn. While in your defensive stance, you can make opportunity attacks without using your reaction, and you can use your reaction to make a melee attack against a creature that moves more than 5 feet while within your reach.

Two-Weapon Fighting

When you engage in two-weapon fighting, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of the second attack.

Spellcasting

By the time you reach 2nd level, you have learned to use the magical essence of nature to cast spells, much as a druid does.

Spell Slots

The Ranger table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your spells of 1st level and higher. To cast one of these spells, you must expend a slot of the spell's level or higher. You regain all expended spell slots when you finish a long rest.

For example, if you know the 1st-level spell animal friendship and have a 1st-level and a 2nd-level spell slot available, you can cast animal friendship using either slot.

Spells Known of 1st Level and Higher

You know two 1st-level spells of your choice from the ranger spell list.

The Spells Known column of the Ranger table shows when you learn more ranger spells of your choice. Each of these spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For instance, when you reach 5th level in this class, you can learn one new spell of 1st or 2nd level.

Additionally, when you gain a level in this class, you can choose one of the ranger spells you know and replace it with another spell from the ranger spell list, which also must be of a level for which you have spell slots.

Spellcasting Ability

Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for your ranger spells, since your magic draws on your attunement to nature. You use your Wisdom whenever a spell refers to your spellcasting ability. In addition, you use your Wisdom modifier when setting the saving throw DC for a ranger spell you cast and when making an attack roll with one.

Ability DC: 8 + proficiency bonus + wis modifier
note.lvl03_details_zh:
遊俠原型

在第三級，你從可用原型清單中選擇一個你努力模仿的原型。你的選擇授予第 3 級的特性，以及第 7、11 和 15 級的特性。

原始意識

從第 3 級開始，你可以使用你的動作並消耗一個遊俠法術位來將你的意識集中在你周圍的區域。在你花費的每級法術位1分鐘內，你可以感知以下類型的生物是否存在於你的1英里範圍內（如果你在你喜歡的地形中，則在最多6英里範圍內）：異獸、天體、龍、元素、精類、惡魔和不死生物。此特性不會透露生物的位置或數量。

遊俠原型選項

獵人

效法獵人原型意味著接受自己作為文明與荒野恐怖之間的堡壘的地位。當你走在獵人的道路上時，你會學習專門的技術來對抗你所面臨的威脅，從狂暴的食人魔和成群的獸人到高聳的巨人和可怕的龍。

獵人的獵物

在第 3 級，你可以選擇以下特性之一：巨像殺手、巨人殺手或部落破壞者。

巨像殺手

你的堅韌可以打敗最強大的敵人。當你用武器攻擊擊中生物時，如果生物的生命值低於其最大生命值，則該生物會受到額外的 1d8 點傷害。你每回合只能造成一次額外傷害。

巨人殺手

當你 5 呎內的大型或更大的生物攻擊擊中或錯過你時，你可以在攻擊後立即使用你的反應來攻擊該生物，前提是你可以看到生物。

部落破壞者

在你進行武器攻擊的每個回合中，你可以使用相同的武器對原始目標 5 呎內且在你的武器射程內的不同生物進行另一次攻擊。

獸王

獸王原型體現了文明種族與世界野獸之間的友誼。野獸和遊俠齊心協力，共同對抗威脅文明和荒野的可怕敵人。效仿野獸大師原型意味著致力於這一理想，與動物作為夥伴和朋友合作。

遊俠的同伴

你將獲得一個野獸夥伴，它會陪伴你冒險，並接受訓練與你並肩作戰。選擇不大於中型且挑戰等級為 1/4 或更低的野獸。將你的熟練加值加到野獸的AC、攻擊檢定和傷害檢定上，以及它擅長的任何豁免檢定和技能上。它的最大生命值等於它的正常最大生命值或你的遊俠等級的四倍，以較高者為準。

野獸會盡可能地服從你的命令。它會根據你的主動性採取行動，但除非你命令它，否則它不會採取任何行動。輪到你的時候，你可以口頭命令野獸移動到哪裡（不需要你採取任何行動）。你可以使用你的動作口頭命令它採取攻擊、衝刺、脫離、閃避或幫助動作。一旦你擁有額外攻擊特性，當你命令野獸採取攻擊行動時，你可以自己進行一次武器攻擊。

如果你喪失行為能力或缺席，你的野獸夥伴會自行行動，專注於保護你和它自己。它從來不需要你的命令來使用它的反應，例如在進行藉機攻擊時。

與任何生物一樣，野獸可以在短休期間消耗生命骰子。

當只與野獸一起穿越你喜歡的地形時，你可以以正常的速度悄悄移動。

如果該野獸死亡，你可以通過花費 8 小時與另一隻對你沒有敵意的野獸（無論是與之前相同類型的野獸還是不同類型的野獸）神奇地結合來獲得另一隻野獸。
note.lvl03_details_en:
Ranger Archetype

At 3rd level, you choose an archetype that you strive to emulate from the list of available archetypes. Your choice grants features at 3rd level, and again at 7th, 11th, and 15th level.

Primeval Awareness

Beginning at 3rd level, you can use your action and expend one ranger spell slot to focus your awareness on the region around you. For 1 minute per level of the spell slot you expend, you can sense whether the following types of creatures are present within 1 mile of you (or within up to 6 miles if you are in your favored terrain): aberrations, celestials, dragons, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead. This feature doesn't reveal the creatures' location or number.

Ranger Archetype Options

Hunter

Emulating the Hunter archetype means accepting your place as a bulwark between civilization and the terrors of the wilderness. As you walk the Hunter's path, you learn specialized techniques for fighting the threats you face, from rampaging ogres and hordes of orcs to towering giants and terrifying dragons.

Hunter's Prey

At 3rd level, you gain one of the following features of your choice: Colossus Slayer, Giant Killer, or Horde Breaker.

Colossus Slayer

Your tenacity can wear down the most potent foes. When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, the creature takes an extra 1d8 damage if it's below its hit point maximum. You can deal this extra damage only once per turn.

Giant Killer

When a Large or larger creature within 5 feet of you hits or misses you with an attack, you can use your reaction to attack that creature immediately after its attack, provided that you can see the creature.

Horde Breaker

Once on each of your turns when you make a weapon attack, you can make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature that is within 5 feet of the original target and within range of your weapon.

Beast Master

The Beast Master archetype embodies a friendship between the civilized races and the beasts of the world. United in focus, beast and ranger work as one to fight the monstrous foes that threaten civilization and the wilderness alike. Emulating the Beast Master archetype means committing yourself to this ideal, working in partnership with an animal as its companion and friend.

Ranger's Companion

You gain a beast companion that accompanies you on your adventures and is trained to fight alongside you. Choose a beast that is no larger than Medium and that has a challenge rating of 1/4 or lower. Add your proficiency bonus to the beast's AC, attack rolls, and damage rolls, as well as to any saving throws and skills it is proficient in. Its hit point maximum equals its normal maximum or four times your ranger level, whichever is higher.

The beast obeys your commands as best as it can. It takes its turn on your initiative, though it doesn't take an action unless you command it to. On your turn, you can verbally command the beast where to move (no action required by you). You can use your action to verbally command it to take the Attack, Dash, Disengage, Dodge, or Help action. Once you have the Extra Attack feature, you can make one weapon attack yourself when you command the beast to take the Attack action.

If you are incapacitated or absent, your beast companion acts on its own, focusing on protecting you and itself. It never requires your command to use its reaction, such as when making an opportunity attack.

Like any creature, the beast can spend hit dice during a short rest.

While traveling through your favored terrain with only the beast, you can move stealthily at a normal pace.

If the beast dies, you can obtain another one by spending 8 hours magically bonding with another beast that isn't hostile to you, either the same type of beast as before or a different one.
note.lvl04_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到4級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl04_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 4th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl05_details_zh:
額外攻擊

從第 5 級開始，每當你在自己的回合中採取攻擊行動時，你可以攻擊兩次，而不是一次。
note.lvl05_details_en:
Extra Attack

Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
note.lvl06_details_zh:
宿敵和自然探險家的改進

在第 6 級，你獲得了額外的偏好地形。

在第 6 級，你可以選擇一個額外的宿敵以及相關的語言。你的選擇應該反映你在冒險中遇到的怪物的類型。
note.lvl06_details_en:
Favored Enemy and Natural Explorer improvements

At 6th level, you gain an additional favored terrain.

At 6th level, you choose one additional favored enemy, as well as an associated language. Your choice should reflect the types of monsters you have encountered on your adventures.
note.lvl07_details_zh:
遊俠原型特徵

在第 7 級，你獲得了你的遊俠原型賦予你的一個特性。

遊俠原型選項

獵人

防守策略

在第 7 級，你可以選擇以下特性之一：逃離部落、多重攻擊防禦或鋼鐵意志。

逃離部落

對你的機會攻擊是在不利的情況下進行的。

多重攻擊防禦

當生物攻擊你時，你在回合剩餘時間對抗生物隨後進行的所有攻擊獲得+4的AC加值。

鋼鐵意志

你在對抗恐懼的豁免檢定方面具有優勢。

獸王

卓越的培訓

從 7 級開始，在你的任何回合中，當你的野獸夥伴沒有攻擊時，你可以使用附贈動作來命令野獸在其回合中採取衝刺、脫離、閃避或幫助動作。
note.lvl07_details_en:
Ranger Archetype feature

At 7th level, you gain a feature granted to you by your Ranger Archetype.

Ranger Archetype Options

Hunter

Defensive Tactics

At 7th level, you gain one of the following features of your choice: Escape the Horde, Multiattack Defense, or Steel Will.

Escape the Horde

Opportunity attacks against you are made with disadvantage.

Multiattack Defense

When a creature hits you with an attack, you gain a +4 bonus to AC against all subsequent attacks made by that creature for the rest of the turn.

Steel Will

You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

Beast Master

Exceptional Training

Beginning at 7th level, on any of your turns when your beast companion doesn't attack, you can use a bonus action to command the beast to take the Dash, Disengage, Dodge, or Help action on its turn.
note.lvl08_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到8級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。正常情況下，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。

大地的步伐

從第 8 級開始，穿越非魔法的困難地形不需要額外的移動。你也可以穿過非魔法植物，而不會被它們減慢速度，如果它們有刺、刺或類似的危險，也不會受到它們的傷害。

此外，你在對抗那些透過魔法創造或操縱來阻礙移動的植物（例如由糾纏法術創造的植物）時具有優勢。
note.lvl08_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 8th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.

Land's Stride

Starting at 8th level, moving through nonmagical difficult terrain costs you no extra movement. You can also pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage from them if they have thorns, spines, or a similar hazard.

In addition, you have advantage on saving throws against plants that are magically created or manipulated to impede movement, such those created by the entangle spell.
note.lvl10_details_zh:
隱藏在眾目睽睽之下

從第 10 級開始，你可以花 1 分鐘為自己創建偽裝。你必須能夠接觸到新鮮的泥土、污垢、植物、煙灰和其他天然材料來製作你的偽裝。

一旦你以這種方式偽裝，你可以透過將自己壓在至少與你一樣高和寬的堅固表面上來隱藏，例如樹或牆。只要你待在那裡不移動或採取行動，你的敏捷（潛行）檢定就會獲得+10加值。一旦你移動或採取行動或反應，你必須再次偽裝自己才能獲得這種好處。

自然探索者改進

你獲得了額外的有利地形。
note.lvl10_details_en:
Hide in Plain Sight

Starting at 10th level, you can spend 1 minute creating camouflage for yourself. You must have access to fresh mud, dirt, plants, soot, and other naturally occurring materials with which to create your camouflage.

Once you are camouflaged in this way, you can try to hide by pressing yourself up against a solid surface, such as a tree or wall, that is at least as tall and wide as you are. You gain a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks as long as you remain there without moving or taking actions. Once you move or take an action or a reaction, you must camouflage yourself again to gain this benefit.

Natural Explorer improvement

You gain an additional favored terrain.
note.lvl11_details_zh:
遊俠原型特徵

在第 11 級，你獲得了遊俠原型賦予你的一項特性。

遊俠原型選項

獵人

多重攻擊

11級時，你可以選擇以下特性之一：齊射或旋風攻擊。

截擊

你可以使用你的動作對你在武器射程內可以看到的點 10 呎內的任意數量的生物進行遠程攻擊。像平常一樣，你必須為每個目標準備彈藥，並且你為每個目標進行單獨的攻擊檢定。

旋風攻擊

你可以使用你的動作對你 5 呎內任意數量的生物進行近戰攻擊，每個目標都有一個單獨的攻擊檢定。

獸王

野獸之怒

當你命令野獸採取攻擊行動時，野獸可以攻擊兩次或採取多重攻擊行動（如果它有該行動）。
note.lvl11_details_en:
Ranger Archetype feature

At 11th level, you gain a feature granted to you by your Ranger Archetype.

Ranger Archetype Options

Hunter

Multiattack

At 11th level, you gain one of the following features of your choice: Volley or Whirlwind Attack.

Volley

You can use your action to make a ranged attack against any number of creatures within 10 feet of a point you can see within your weapon's range. You must have ammunition for each target, as normal, and you make a separate attack roll for each target.

Whirlwind Attack

You can use your action to make a melee attack against any number of creatures within 5 feet of you, with a separate attack roll for each target.

Beast Master

Bestial Fury

When you command the beast to take the Attack action, the beast can attack twice or take the Multiattack action if it has that action.
note.lvl12_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到12級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl12_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 12th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl14_details_zh:
消失

從 14 級開始，你可以在你的回合中使用隱藏動作作為附贈動作。此外，除非你選擇留下蹤跡，否則你無法透過非魔法手段被追蹤。

宿敵改進

在第 14 級，你可以選擇一個額外的宿敵以及相關的語言。你的選擇應該反映你在冒險中遇到的怪物的類型。
note.lvl14_details_en:
Vanish

Starting at 14th level, you can use the Hide action as a bonus action on your turn. Also, you can't be tracked by nonmagical means, unless you choose to leave a trail.

Favored Enemy improvement

At 14th level, you choose one additional favored enemy, as well as an associated language. Your choice should reflect the types of monsters you have encountered on your adventures.
note.lvl15_details_zh:
遊俠原型特徵

在第 15 級，你獲得了遊俠原型賦予你的特性。

遊俠原型選項

獵人

高級獵人防禦

在 15 級時，你可以選擇以下特性之一：閃避、逆流而上或不可思議閃避。

閃避

你可以靈活地躲避某些區域效果，例如紅龍的火焰吐息或閃電法術。當你受到允許你進行敏捷豁免檢定僅受到一半傷害的效果時，如果你豁免檢定成功，你將不會受到任何傷害，如果你失敗，你只會受到一半傷害。

逆流而上

當敵對生物的近戰攻擊錯過你時，你可以使用你的反應迫使生物對你選擇的另一個生物（除了它自己）重複相同的攻擊。

不可思議的閃避

當你看到的攻擊者攻擊你時，你可以利用你的反應將攻擊對你造成的傷害減半。

獸王

分享法術

從 15 級開始，當你施展針對自己的法術時，如果你的野獸同伴距離你 30 呎以內，你也可以用該法術影響你的野獸夥伴。
note.lvl15_details_en:
Ranger Archetype feature

At 15th level, you gain a feature granted to you by your Ranger Archetype.

Ranger Archetype Options

Hunter

Superior Hunter's Defense

At 15th level, you gain one of the following features of your choice: Evasion, Stand Against the Tide, or Uncanny Dodge.

Evasion

You can nimbly dodge out of the way of certain area effects, such as a red dragon's fiery breath or a lightning bolt spell. When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if you fail.

Stand Against the Tide

When a hostile creature misses you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to force that creature to repeat the same attack against another creature (other than itself) of your choice.

Uncanny Dodge

When an attacker that you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to halve the attack's damage against you.

Beast Master

Share Spells

Beginning at 15th level, when you cast a spell targeting yourself, you can also affect your beast companion with the spell if the beast is within 30 feet of you.
note.lvl16_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到16級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl16_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 16th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl18_details_zh:
野性感官

18級時，你獲得了超自然的感官，可以幫助你對抗看不見的生物。當你攻擊一個你看不到的生物時，你看不到它不會為你的攻擊檢定帶來不利。你也知道你周圍 30 呎內任何隱形生物的位置，前提是該生物沒有對你隱藏，而且你沒有失明或失聰。
note.lvl18_details_en:
Feral Senses

At 18th level, you gain preternatural senses that help you fight creatures you can't see. When you attack a creature you can't see, your inability to see it doesn't impose disadvantage on your attack rolls against it. You are also aware of the location of any invisible creature within 30 feet of you, provided that the creature isn't hidden from you and you aren't blinded or deafened.
note.lvl19_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到19級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl19_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 19th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl20_details_zh:
殺敵者

20級時，你將成為無與倫比的敵人獵人。在你的每個回合中，你可以將你的感知調整值加到你對你最喜歡的敵人之一的攻擊檢定或傷害檢定。你可以選擇在擲骰之前或之後、但在應用擲骰的任何效果之前使用此特性。
note.lvl20_details_en:
Foe Slayer

At 20th level, you become an unparalleled hunter of your enemies. Once on each of your turns, you can add your Wisdom modifier to the attack roll or the damage roll of an attack you make against one of your favored enemies. You can choose to use this feature before or after the roll, but before any effects of the roll are applied.

note.basic_zh:
生命骰：1d8
豁免：敏捷、智力
note.basic_en:
Hit Dice: 1d8
Saving Throw: DEX, INT
note.lvl01_details_zh:
簡介

浪客可能是盜賊、刺客，也可能有其他各式各樣的身分。他們擅長拆除陷阱與竊取財物，往往能在神不知鬼不覺間取走珠寶與錢幣。

熟練

• 護甲：輕甲
• 武器：簡易武器、手弩、長劍、細劍、短劍
• 工具：盜賊工具
• 技能：從體操、運動、欺瞞、察言觀色、威嚇、調查、觀察、表演、遊說、巧手、隱匿中選擇四項

起始裝備

• 細劍或短劍
• 短弓與裝有 20 支箭的箭袋，或短劍
• 竊賊套組、地城探索者套組或探險者套組
• 皮甲、兩把匕首與盜賊工具

專精

選擇兩項已熟練的技能，或一項已熟練的技能與盜賊工具。使用所選技能或工具進行檢定時，熟練加值加倍。

偷襲

每回合一次，當你使用靈巧武器或遠程武器命中，且該次攻擊檢定具有優勢時，可額外造成 1d6 傷害。如果目標 5 呎內有另一名未陷入失能狀態的敵人，且你的攻擊檢定不具有劣勢，則無須具有優勢也能使用偷襲。額外傷害會隨浪客等級提高。

賊話

你理解並能使用賊話。以賊話傳遞訊息所需的時間是一般對話的四倍；你也能理解用來傳達簡短訊息的秘密標記與符號。
note.lvl01_details_en:
Overview

Rogues may be thieves, assassins, or known by any number of other names. They excel at disabling traps and stealing valuables, often making off with jewels and coins without anyone noticing.

Proficiencies

• Armor: Light armor
• Weapons: Simple weapons, hand crossbows, longswords, rapiers, and shortswords
• Tools: Thieves' tools
• Skills: Choose four from Acrobatics, Athletics, Deception, Insight, Intimidation, Investigation, Perception, Performance, Persuasion, Sleight of Hand, and Stealth

Starting Equipment

• A rapier or shortsword
• A shortbow and a quiver of 20 arrows, or a shortsword
• A burglar's pack, dungeoneer's pack, or explorer's pack
• Leather armor, two daggers, and thieves' tools

Expertise

Choose two proficient skills, or one proficient skill and your thieves' tools. Double your proficiency bonus for checks made with the chosen skills or tool.

Sneak Attack

Once per turn, when you hit with a finesse or ranged weapon and have advantage on the attack roll, you can deal an extra 1d6 damage. You do not need advantage if another enemy of the target is within 5 feet of it, that enemy is not incapacitated, and your attack roll does not have disadvantage. The extra damage increases with your rogue level.

Thieves' Cant

You understand and can use Thieves' Cant. Conveying a message in Thieves' Cant takes four times as long as ordinary speech. You also understand secret signs and symbols used to communicate short messages.
note.lvl02_details_zh:
狡詐動作

從第 2 級開始，你的快速思維和敏捷性使你能夠快速行動和行動。你可以在戰鬥的每個回合中採取額外動作。此操作只能用於執行「衝刺」、「脫離」或「隱藏」操作。
note.lvl02_details_en:
Cunning Action

Starting at 2nd level, your quick thinking and agility allow you to move and act quickly. You can take a bonus action on each of your turns in combat. This action can be used only to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.
note.lvl03_details_zh:
浪客原型

在第 3 級，你可以從可用原型清單中選擇一個在練習盜賊能力時效仿的原型。你的原型選擇將授予你第 3 級的特性，然後再授予你第 9、13 和 17 級的特性。

浪客原型選項

奧法詭術師

有些盜賊透過魔法、學習結界和幻術技巧來增強他們精巧的潛行和敏捷技能。這些流氓包括扒手和竊賊，但也包括惡作劇者、惡作劇者和大量的冒險家。

法師之手戲法

從第3級開始，當你施放法師之手時，你可以使幽靈之手隱形，並且你可以用它執行以下附加任務：

• 你可以將手上拿著的一個物體存放在另一個生物所穿戴或攜帶的容器中。
• 你可以取回另一個生物所穿戴或所攜帶的容器中的物體。
• 你可以使用盜賊的工具在一定範圍內開鎖並解除陷阱。

如果你成功通過了與生物的感知（感知）檢定相對抗的敏捷（功夫）檢定，你就可以在不被生物注意到的情況下執行其中一項任務。

此外，你也可以使用狡猾行動所賦予的加值行動來控製手牌。

施法

當你達到第三級時，你就獲得了施展法術的能力。有關施法的一般規則，請參閱第 10 章；有關巫師法術表，請參閱第 11 章。

戲法

在第一級，你學習三個戲法：法師之手和你從巫師法術表中選擇的另外兩個戲法。你可以在第 10 級學習另一個你選擇的巫師戲法。

法術位

奧術騙子施法表顯示了你必須施展 1 級及更高等級法術的法術位數量。要施展其中一個法術，你必須消耗該法術等級或更高的槽位。當你完成長休後，你會重新獲得所有消耗的法術位。

例如，如果你認識 1 級法術魅惑人物，並且有 1 級和 2 級法術位可用，則可以使用任一法術位施展魅惑人物。

1級以上的已知法術

你知道三個你選擇的1級巫師法術，其中兩個你必須從巫師法術表上的結界和幻像法術中選擇。

奧術騙子施法表的已知法術列會顯示你何時學習更多 1 級或更高級別的巫師法術。這些法術中的每一個都必須是你選擇的結界或幻像法術，而且必須是你擁有法術位的等級。例如，當你在本課程中達到7級時，你可以學習一個1級或2級的新法術。

你在 8 級、14 級和 20 級學習的法術可以來自任何魔法學校。

每當你獲得該等級的等級時，你可以用你從巫師法術表中選擇的另一個法術替換你所知道的巫師法術之一。新法術必須屬於你有法術位的等級，而且必須是結界或幻像法術，除非你要替換你在8級、14級或20級所獲得的法術。

施法能力

智力是你對巫師法術的施法能力，因為你透過專門的學習和記憶來學習法術。每當法術涉及你的施法能力時，你就使用你的智力。此外，在為你施放的法師法術設定豁免 DC 以及使用該法術進行攻擊檢定時，你會使用你的智力修正值。

豁免DC：8+熟練加值+智力調整值

法術

刺客

你的訓練重點是死亡的殘酷藝術。信奉這原型的人多種多樣——僱用殺手、間諜、賞金獵人，甚至是受過專門訓練以消滅其神的敵人的受膏牧師。潛行、毒藥和偽裝可以幫助你以致命的效率消滅敵人。

你的原型授予你第 3 級的特性，然後再授予你第 9、13 和 17 級的特性。

暗殺

從第 3 級開始，當你落在敵人身上時，你就處於最致命的狀態。對於任何尚未在戰鬥中回合的生物，你在攻擊檢定上具有優勢。此外，你對受到驚訝的生物所獲得的任何命中都是致命一擊。

加值熟練程度

當你在第3級選擇這個原型時，你將獲得偽裝套件和投毒者套件的熟練程度。

盜賊

你磨練了偷竊藝術的技能。竊賊、強盜、小偷和其他罪犯通常遵循這種原型，但更喜歡將自己視為專業尋寶者、探險家、探索者和調查員的盜賊也是如此。除了提高你的敏捷性和隱密性之外，你還可以學習一些有用的技能，例如深入古代遺跡、閱讀不熟悉的語言以及使用你通常無法使用的魔法物品。

快手

從第 3 級開始，你可以使用「狡猾行動」所授予的加值行動來進行「敏捷」（巧手）檢定，使用盜賊的工具解除陷阱或打開鎖，或採取「使用物體」行動。

二層作品

當你在第 3 級選擇這個原型時，你將獲得比平常更快的攀爬能力；攀爬不再需要你額外的運動。

此外，當你進行奔跑跳躍時，你移動的距離會增加等於你的敏捷調整值的呎數。
note.lvl03_details_en:
Roguish Archetype

At 3rd level, you choose an archetype that you emulate in the exercise of your rogue abilities from the list of available archetypes. Your archetype choice grants you features at 3rd level and then again at 9th, 13th, and 17th level.

Roguish Archetype Options

Arcane Trickster

Some rogues enhance their fine-honed skills of stealth and agility with magic, learning tricks of enchantment and illusion. These rogues include pickpockets and burglars, but also pranksters, mischief-makers, and a significant number of adventurers.

Mage Hand Legerdemain

Starting at 3rd level, when you cast mage hand, you can make the spectral hand invisible, and you can perform the following additional tasks with it:

• You can stow one object the hand is holding in a container worn or carried by another creature.
• You can retrieve an object in a container worn or carried by another creature.
• You can use thieves' tools to pick lock and disarm traps at range.

You can perform one of these tasks without being noticed by a creature if you succeed on a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check contested by the creature's Wisdom (Perception) check.

In addition, you can use the bonus action granted by your Cunning Action to control the hand.

Spellcasting

When you reach 3rd level, you gain the ability to cast spells. See chapter 10 for the general rules of spellcasting and chapter 11 for the wizard spell list.

Cantrips

At 1st level, you learn three cantrips: mage hand and two other cantrips of your choice from the wizard spell list. You learn another wizard cantrip of your choice at 10th level.

Spell Slots

The Arcane Trickster Spellcasting table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your spells of 1st level and higher. To cast one of these spells, you must expend a slot of the spell's level or higher. You regain all expended spell slots when you finish a long rest.

For example, if you know the 1st-level spell charm person and have a 1st-level and a 2nd-level spell slot available, you can cast charm person using either slot.

Spells Known of 1st-Level and Higher

You know three 1st-level wizard spells of your choice, two of which you must choose from the enchantment and illusion spells on the wizard spell list.

The Spells Known column of the Arcane Trickster Spellcasting table shows when you learn more wizard spells of 1st level or higher. Each of these spells must be an enchantment or illusion spell of your choice, and must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For instance, when you reach 7th level in this class, you can learn one new spell of 1st or 2nd level.

The spells you learn at 8th, 14th, and 20th level can come from any school of magic.

Whenever you gain a level in this class, you can replace one of the wizard spells you know with another spell of your choice from the wizard spell list. The new spell must be of a level for which you have spell slots, and it must be an enchantment or illusion spell, unless you're replacing the spell you gained at 8th, 14th, or 20th level.

Spellcasting Ability

Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for your wizard spells, since you learn your spells through dedicated study and memorization. You use your Intelligence whenever a spell refers to your spellcasting ability. In addition, you use your Intelligence modifier when setting the saving throw DC for a wizard spell you cast and when making an attack roll with one.

Save DC: 8 + proficiency bonus + Intelligence modifier

Spell

Assassin

You focus your training on the grim art of the death. Those who adhere to this archetype are diverse - hired killers, spies, bounty hunters, and even specially anointed priests trained to exterminate the enemies of their deity. Stealth, poison, and disguise help you eliminate your foes with deadly efficiency.

Your archetype grants you features at 3rd level and then again at 9th, 13th, and 17th level.

Assassinate

Starting at 3rd level, you are at your deadliest when you get the drop on your enemies. You have advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn in the combat yet. In addition, any hit you score against a creature that is surprised is a critical hit.

Bonus Proficiencies

When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with the disguise kit and the poisoner's kit.

Thief

You hone your skills in the larcenous arts. Burglars, bandits, cutpurses, and other criminals typically follow this archetype, but so do rogues who prefer to think of themselves as professional treasure seekers, explorers, delvers, and investigators. In addition to improving your agility and stealth, you learn skills useful for delving into ancient ruins, reading unfamiliar languages, and using magic items you normally couldn't employ.

Fast Hands

Starting at 3rd level, you can use the bonus action granted by your Cunning Action to make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check, use your thieves' tools to disarm a trap or open a lock, or take the Use an Object action.

Second-Story Work

When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you gain the ability to climb faster than normal; climbing no longer costs you extra movement.

In addition, when you make a running jump, the distance you cover increases by a number of feet equal to your Dexterity modifier.
note.lvl04_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到4級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl04_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 4th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl05_details_zh:
直覺閃避

從第 5 級開始，當你看到的攻擊者攻擊你時，你可以使用你的反應將攻擊對你造成的傷害減半。
note.lvl05_details_en:
Uncanny Dodge

Starting at 5th level, when an attacker that you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to halve the attack's damage against you.
note.lvl06_details_zh:
專業知識

在第 6 級，你可以選擇另外兩項你的熟練程度（技能或盜賊工具）來獲得專業知識的好處。
note.lvl06_details_en:
Expertise

At 6th level, you can choose two more of your proficiencies (in skills or with thieves' tools) to gain the benefit of Expertise.
note.lvl07_details_zh:
反射迴避

從 7 級開始，你可以靈活地躲避某些區域效果，例如紅龍的火焰吐息或冰風暴法術。當你受到允許你進行敏捷豁免檢定僅受到一半傷害的效果時，如果你豁免檢定成功，你將不會受到任何傷害，如果你失敗，你只會受到一半傷害。
note.lvl07_details_en:
Evasion

Beginning at 7th level, you can nimbly dodge out of the way of certain area effects, such as a red dragon's fiery breath or an ice storm spell. When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if you fail.
note.lvl08_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到8級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。正常情況下，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl08_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 8th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl09_details_zh:
浪客範型能力

在第 9 級，你獲得了你的盜賊原型所賦予的特性。

浪客原型選項

奧法詭術師

魔法伏擊

從第 9 級開始，如果你在對某個生物施展法術時處於隱藏狀態，則該生物在本回合針對該法術進行的任何豁免檢定中都會處於劣勢。

刺客

滲透專長

從第 9 級開始，你可以準確無誤地為自己創造虛假身分。你必須花費 7 天和 25 gp 來確定某個身分的歷史、職業和隸屬關係。你無法建立屬於他人的身分。例如，你可能會獲得合適的服裝、介紹信和看似正式的證書，以證明自己是來自偏遠城市的貿易公司的成員，這樣你就可以混入其他富商的公司。

此後，如果你採用新的身分作為偽裝，其他生物就會相信你就是那個人，除非有明顯的理由不這麼做。

盜賊

至尊潛行

從第 9 級開始，如果你在同一回合的移動速度不超過一半，你在敏捷（潛行）檢定中具有優勢。
note.lvl09_details_en:
Roguish Archetype feature

At 9th level, you gain a feature granted by your Roguish Archetype.

Roguish Archetype Options

Arcane Trickster

Magical Ambush

Starting at 9th level, if you are hidden from a creature when you cast a spell on it, the creature has disadvantage on any saving throw it makes against the spell this turn.

Assassin

Infiltration Expertise

Starting at 9th level, you can unfailingly create false identities for yourself. You must spend seven days and 25 gp to establish the history, profession, and affiliations for an identity. You can't establish an identity that belongs to someone else. For example, you might acquire appropriate clothing, letters of introduction, and official-looking certification to establish yourself as a member of a trading house from a remote city so you can insinuate yourself into the company of other wealthy merchants.

Thereafter, if you adopt the new identity as a disguise, other creatures believe you to be that person until given an obvious reason not to.

Thief

Supreme Sneak

Starting at 9th level, you have advantage on a Dexterity (Stealth) check if you move no more than half your speed on the same turn.
note.lvl10_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到10級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl10_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 10th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl11_details_zh:
可靠才能

到了 11 級，你已經完善了你所選擇的技能，直到它們接近完美。每當你進行能力檢定以增加你的熟練加值時，你可以將 9 或更低的 d20 檢定視為 10。
note.lvl11_details_en:
Reliable Talent

By 11th level, you have refined your chosen skills until they approach perfection. Whenever you make an ability check that lets you add your proficiency bonus, you can treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.
note.lvl12_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到12級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl12_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 12th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl13_details_zh:
浪客範型能力

在第 13 級，你獲得了你的盜賊原型所賦予的特性。

浪客原型選項

奧法詭術師

多才多藝的騙子

13級時，你獲得了用法師之手分散目標注意力的能力。作為你回合的附贈動作，你可以指定該法術所創造的幽靈手 5 呎範圍內的一個生物。這樣做可以讓你在對抗生物的攻擊骰上獲得優勢，直到回合結束。

刺客

冒名頂替者

在第 13 級，你獲得準確模仿他人言語、寫作和行為的能力。你必須花至少三個小時來研究這個人行為的這三個組成部分：聽演講、檢視筆跡和觀察習慣。

對不經意的觀察者來說，你的詭計是難以察覺的。如果一個警覺的生物懷疑有什麼不對勁，你在進行任何魅力（欺騙）檢定時都有優勢以避免被發現。

盜賊

使用魔法裝置

到了 13 級，你已經對魔法的運作有了足夠的了解，你可以即興使用物品，即使它們不是為你設計的。你忽略了所有使用魔法物品的職業、種族和等級要求。
note.lvl13_details_en:
Roguish Archetype feature

At 13th level, you gain a feature granted by your Roguish Archetype.

Roguish Archetype Options

Arcane Trickster

Versatile Trickster

At 13th level, you gain the ability to distract targets with your mage hand. As a bonus action on your turn, you can designate a creature within 5 feet of the spectral hand created by the spell. Doing so gives you advantage on attack rolls against that creature until the end of the turn.

Assassin

Impostor

At 13th level, you gain the ability to unerringly mimic another person's speech, writing, and behavior. You must spend at least three hours studying these three components of the person's behavior, listening to speech, examining handwriting, and observing mannerism.

Your ruse is indiscernible to the casual observer. If a wary creature suspects something is amiss, you have advantage on any Charisma (Deception) check you make to avoid detection.

Thief

Use Magic Device

By 13th level, you have learned enough about the workings of magic that you can improvise the use of items even when they are not intended for you. You ignore all class, race, and level requirements on the use of magic items.
note.lvl14_details_zh:
盲感

從 14 級開始，如果你能夠聽到，你就能知道你 10 呎內任何隱藏或隱形生物的位置。
note.lvl14_details_en:
Blindsense

Starting at 14th level, if you are able to hear, you are aware of the location of any hidden or invisible creature within 10 feet of you.
note.lvl15_details_zh:
心智靈活

到了15級，你已經獲得了更強的精神力量。你獲得智慧豁免檢定的熟練度。
note.lvl15_details_en:
Slippery Mind

By 15th level, you have acquired greater mental strength. You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws.
note.lvl16_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到16級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl16_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 16th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl17_details_zh:
浪客範型能力

在第 17 級，你獲得了你的盜賊原型所賦予的特性。

浪客原型選項

奧法詭術師

法術竊賊

17級時，你獲得了從另一個施法者那裡神奇地竊取如何施展法術的知識的能力。

在生物施展以你為目標或將你納入其效果範圍內的法術後，你可以立即使用你的反應來迫使該生物使用其施法能力調整值進行豁免檢定。 DC 等於你的法術豁免 DC。如果豁免失敗，你會否定該法術對你的效果，並且如果該法術的知識至少為 1 級並且達到你可以施展的等級（不需要是法師法術），你就會竊取該法術的知識。在接下來的 8 小時內，你知道該法術並可以使用你的法術位施展它。在 8 小時過去之前，該生物無法施展該法術。

一旦使用此特性，在完成長休之前將無法再次使用。

刺客

死亡打擊

從 17 級開始，你就成為了速死大師。當你攻擊並擊中一個受到驚訝的生物時，它必須進行一次體質豁免檢定（DC 8 + 你的敏捷調整值 + 你的熟練加值）。如果豁免失敗，你對該生物的攻擊造成的傷害加倍。

盜賊

小偷的反應

當你達到17級時，你已經擅長伏擊並快速逃離危險。在任何戰鬥的第一輪中，你可以進行兩個回合。你以正常主動度進行第一輪，以負 10 的主動度進行第二輪。當你感到驚訝時，你無法使用此特性。
note.lvl17_details_en:
Roguish Archetype feature

At 17th level, you gain a feature granted by your Roguish Archetype.

Roguish Archetype Options

Arcane Trickster

Spell Thief

At 17th level, you gain the ability to magically steal the knowledge of how to cast a spell from another spellcaster.

Immediately after a creature casts a spell that targets you or includes you in its area of effect, you can use your reaction to force the creature to make a saving throw with its spellcasting ability modifier. The DC equals your spell save DC. On a failed save, you negate the spell's effect against you, and you steal the knowledge of the spell if it is at least 1st level and of a level you can cast (it doesn't need to be a wizard spell). For the next 8 hours, you know the spell and can cast it using your spell slots. The creature can't cast that spell until the 8 hours have passed.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

Assassin

Death Strike

Starting at 17th level, you become a master of instant death. When you attack and hit a creature that is surprised, it must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + your Dexterity modifier + your proficiency bonus). On a failed save, double the damage of your attack against the creature.

Thief

Thief's Reflexes

When you reach 17th level, you have become adept at laying ambushes and quickly escaping danger. You can take two turns during the first round of any combat. You take your first turn at your normal initiative and your second turn at your initiative minus 10. You can't use this feature when you are surprised.
note.lvl18_details_zh:
難以捉摸

從 18 級開始，你的躲避能力很強，攻擊者很少能在對抗你時佔據上風。當你沒有喪失行動能力時，任何攻擊檢定都對你沒有優勢。
note.lvl18_details_en:
Elusive

Beginning at 18th level, you are so evasive that attackers rarely gain the upper hand against you. No attack roll has advantage against you while you aren't incapacitated.
note.lvl19_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到19級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl19_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 19th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl20_details_zh:
幸運一擊

在 20 級時，你擁有在需要時取得成功的不可思議的本領。如果你的攻擊未命中範圍內的目標，你可以將未命中變成命中。或者，如果你未通過能力檢查，你可以將 d20 檢定視為 20。

一旦你使用此特性，你就無法再次使用它，直到你完成短休或長休。
note.lvl20_details_en:
Stroke of Luck

At 20th level, you have an uncanny knack for succeeding when you need to. If your attack misses a target within range, you can turn the miss into a hit. Alternatively, if you fail an ability check, you can treat the d20 roll as a 20.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

熟練

• 武器：匕首、飛鏢、投石索、長棍、輕弩
• 技能：從奧秘、欺瞞、察言觀色、威嚇、遊說、宗教中選擇兩項

起始裝備

• 輕弩與 20 支弩矢，或任一簡易武器
• 法術材料包或秘法法器
• 地城探索者套組或探險者套組
• 兩把匕首

施法

• 施法能力：魅力
• 法術豁免 DC：8 + 熟練加值 + 魅力調整值
• 法術攻擊加值：熟練加值 + 魅力調整值
• 戲法：從術師法術表選擇四個
• 1 環法術：從術師法術表選擇兩個
• 升級時，可將一個已知法術替換為另一個符合條件的術師法術
• 可使用秘法法器作為施法法器

術法起源

選擇「龍族血脈」或「狂野魔法」作為術法起源；它們會在不同等級賦予不同能力。

龍族血脈

龍族祖先

1 級時選擇一種龍族祖先及其傷害類型。你能讀寫並說龍語；與龍互動時，若進行魅力檢定，任何適用的熟練加值均加倍。

龍族韌性

1 級時生命值上限額外增加 1，此後每升一級再增加 1。未穿著護甲時，護甲等級為 13 + 敏捷調整值。

狂野魔法

狂野魔法潮湧

1 級起，當你施放 1 環或更高環級的術師法術後，DM 可要求你擲 d20；若擲出 1，則擲 d100 並依狂野魔法潮湧表產生效果。每回合最多進行一次此判定。

狂野魔法潮湧表

{{table:wild_magic_table}}

混亂浪潮

每次長休間，可使自己的一次攻擊檢定、能力檢定或豁免具有優勢。使用後，DM 可在你施放 1 環或更高環級的術師法術時，直接要求你擲狂野魔法潮湧表；完成後便恢復此能力。

術法起源選項

龍族血脈

你的先天魔法來自與你或你祖先的血液混合的龍類魔法。最常見的是，具有這種起源的巫師將他們的血統追溯到遠古時代的一位強大的巫師，他與龍做了一筆交易，或者甚至可能聲稱自己有龍的父母。其中一些血統在世界上已廣為人知，但大多數卻鮮為人知。由於契約或其他特殊情況，任何特定的巫師都可能成為新血統的第一個。

龍祖

在第一級，你選擇一種龍作為你的祖先。與每條龍相關的傷害類型將由你稍後獲得的特性使用。

|龍|損壞類型 |
| --- | --- |
|黑色|酸|
|藍色|閃電|
|黃銅|火|
|銅獎|閃電|
|銅|酸|
|黃金|火|
|綠色|毒|
|紅色|火|
|銀 |寒冷|
|白色|寒冷|

你可以說、讀、寫龍語。此外，每當你在與龍互動時進行魅力檢定時，如果適用於該檢定，你的熟練加值就會加倍。

龍之韌性

當魔法流過你的身體時，你的龍祖先的身體特徵就會顯現出來。在第 1 級，你的最大生命值增加 1，並且每當你在該等級中獲得一個等級時，你的生命值最大值就會再次增加 1。

此外，你的部分皮膚還覆蓋著一層薄薄的龍鱗狀光澤。當你不穿盔甲時，你的 AC 等於 13 + 你的敏捷調整值。

狂野魔法

你與生俱來的魔法來自於受造秩序背後的狂野混沌力量。你可能已經忍受過接觸某種形式的原始魔法，也許是通過通往地獄邊境、元素位面或神秘的遙遠國度的位面傳送門。也許你受到了強大的精類生物的祝福或被惡魔標記。或者你的魔法可能是你出生時的僥倖，沒有明顯的原因或原因。不管它是怎樣的，這種混亂的魔法在你體內翻騰，等待任何出口。

狂野魔法湧動

當你在第一級選擇這個起源時開始，你的施法可以釋放出狂野的魔法。在你施放 1 級或更高等級的術士法術後，DM 可以立即讓你擲 d20。如果你擲出 1，則在狂野魔法湧動桌上擲出隨機魔法效果。每回合可以發生一次狂野魔法湧動。

如果狂野魔法效果是一個法術，那麼它太狂野而不會受到超魔的影響。如果平常需要集中註意力的話，那麼此時就不需要集中註意力了；該法術持續到其整個持續時間。

混沌之潮

從第 1 級開始，你可以操縱機會和混亂的力量，在一次攻擊檢定、能力檢定或豁免檢定中獲得優勢。完成此操作後，你必須完成長休才能再次使用此特性。

在你重新使用此特性之前的任何時間，DM 都可以在你施展 1 級或更高等級的術士法術後立即讓你在狂野魔法湧動桌上進行擲骰。然後你就可以重新使用此特性。
note.lvl01_details_en:
Proficiencies

• Weapons: Daggers, darts, slings, quarterstaffs, and light crossbows
• Skills: Choose two from Arcana, Deception, Insight, Intimidation, Persuasion, and Religion

Starting Equipment

• A light crossbow and 20 bolts, or any simple weapon
• A component pouch or arcane focus
• A dungeoneer's pack or explorer's pack
• Two daggers

Spellcasting

• Spellcasting Ability: Charisma
• Spell Save DC: 8 + proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier
• Spell Attack Modifier: proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier
• Cantrips: Choose four from the sorcerer spell list
• 1st-Level Spells: Choose two from the sorcerer spell list
• When you gain a level, you can replace one known spell with another eligible sorcerer spell
• You can use an arcane focus as a spellcasting focus

Sorcerous Origin

Choose Draconic Bloodline or Wild Magic as your sorcerous origin. Each grants features at different levels.

Draconic Bloodline

Dragon Ancestor

At 1st level, choose a draconic ancestor and its associated damage type. You can speak, read, and write Draconic. When making a Charisma check while interacting with dragons, double any proficiency bonus that applies.

Draconic Resilience

At 1st level, your hit point maximum increases by 1 and increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level. While not wearing armor, your Armor Class equals 13 + Dexterity modifier.

Wild Magic

Wild Magic Surge

Starting at 1st level, after you cast a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher, the DM can have you roll a d20. On a 1, roll a d100 and apply the corresponding result from the Wild Magic Surge table. This check can occur at most once per turn.

Wild Magic Surge Table

{{table:wild_magic_table}}

Tides of Chaos

Once per long rest, you can gain advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. After you use this feature, the DM can have you roll directly on the Wild Magic Surge table when you cast a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher; after resolving the surge, you regain this feature.

Sorcerous Origin Options

Draconic Bloodline

Your innate magic comes from draconic magic that was mingled with your blood or that of your ancestors. Most often, sorcerers with this origin trace their descent back to a mighty sorcerer of ancient times who made a bargain with a dragon or who might even have claimed a dragon parent. Some of these bloodlines are well established in the world, but most are obscure. Any given sorcerer could be the first of a new bloodline, as a result of a pact or some other exceptional circumstance.

Dragon Ancestor

At 1st level, you choose one type of dragon as your ancestor. The damage type associated with each dragon is used by features you gain later.

| Dragon | Damage Type |
| --- | --- |
| Black | Acid |
| Blue | Lightning |
| Brass | Fire |
| Bronze | Lightning |
| Copper | Acid |
| Gold | Fire |
| Green | Poison |
| Red | Fire |
| Silver | Cold |
| White | Cold |

You can speak, read, and write Draconic. Additionally, whenever you make a Charisma check when interacting with dragons, your Proficiency bonus is doubled if it applies to the check.

Draconic Resilience

As magic flows through your body, it causes physical traits of your dragon ancestors to emerge. At 1st level, your hit point maximum increases by 1 and increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level in this class.

Additionally, parts of your skin are covered by a thin sheen of dragon-like scales. When you aren't wearing armor, your AC equals 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

Wild Magic

Your innate magic comes from the wild forces of chaos that underlie the order of creation. You might have endured exposure to some form of raw magic, perhaps through a planar portal leading to Limbo, the Elemental Planes, or the mysterious Far Realm. Perhaps you were blessed by a powerful fey creature or marked by a demon. Or your magic could be a fluke of your birth, with no apparent cause or reason. However it came to be, this chaotic magic churns within you, waiting for any outlet.

Wild Magic Surge

Starting when you choose this origin at 1st level, your spellcasting can unleash surges of untamed magic. Immediately after you cast a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher, the DM can have you roll a d20. If you roll a 1, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table to create a random magical effect. A Wild Magic Surge can happen once per turn.

If a Wild Magic effect is a spell, it's too wild to be affected by Metamagic. If it normally requires concentration, it doesn't require concentration in this case; the spell lasts for its full duration.

Tides of Chaos

Starting at 1st level, you can manipulate the forces of chance and chaos to gain advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. Once you do so, you must finish a long rest before you can use this feature again.

Any time before you regain the use of this feature, the DM can have you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table immediately after you cast a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher. You then regain the use of this feature.
note.lvl02_details_zh:
魔法之源

在第二級，你將挖掘自己內心深處的魔法泉源。這個泉源以術法點為代表，可以讓你創造出各種魔法效果

術法點

你有 2 點術法點，每次升級時都會額外獲得 1 點，在 20 級時最多獲得 20 點。你擁有的術法點永遠不會多於表中所示的你的等級。當你完成長休後，你會恢復所有消耗的術法點。

靈活鑄造

你可以使用術法點來獲得額外的法術位，或是犧牲法術位來獲得額外的術法點。當你達到更高的水平時，你會學習其他使用術法點的方法。

創建法術位

你可以將未消耗的術法點轉化為法術位，作為你回合中的一項附贈動作。創建的法術位在長休結束時消失。建立法術位表顯示了創建給定等級的法術位的成本。你可以創造等級不高於5級的法術位。

|法術位等級 |術法點成本|
| --- | --- |
|第一 | 2 |
|第二 | 3 |
|第三 | 5 |
|第四 | 6 |
|第五 | 7 |

將法術位轉換為術法點

作為你回合的附贈動作，你可以消耗一個法術位並獲得等於法術位等級的術法點。
note.lvl02_details_en:
Font of Magic

At 2nd level, you tap into a deep wellspring of magic within yourself. This wellspring is represented by sorcery points, which allow you to create a variety of magical effects

Sorcery Points

You have 2 sorcery points, and you gain one additional point every time you level up, to a maximum of 20 at level 20. You can never have more sorcery points than shown on the table for your level. You regain all spent sorcery points when you finish a long rest.

Flexible Casting

You can use your sorcery points to gain additional spell slots, or sacrifice spell slots to gain additional sorcery points. You learn other ways to use your sorcery points as you reach higher levels.

Creating Spell Slots

You can transform unexpended sorcery points into one spell slot as a bonus action on your turn. The created spell slots vanish at the end of a long rest. The Creating Spell Slots table shows the cost of creating a spell slot of a given level. You can create spell slots no higher in level than 5th.

| Spell Slot Level | Sorcery Point Cost |
| --- | --- |
| 1st | 2 |
| 2nd | 3 |
| 3rd | 5 |
| 4th | 6 |
| 5th | 7 |

Converting a Spell Slot to Sorcery Points

As a bonus action on your turn, you can expend one spell slot and gain a number of sorcery points equal to the slot's level.
note.lvl03_details_zh:
超魔法

在第 3 級，你獲得了改變你的法術以滿足你的需要的能力。你可以選擇以下超魔法選項中的兩個。在第 10 級和第 17 級時你會獲得另一個。

除非另有說明，當你施展法術時，你只能使用一個超魔法選項。

選擇以下選項之一：

謹慎法術

當你施放一個迫使其他生物進行豁免的法術時，你可以保護其中一些生物免受該法術的全部力量的影響。為此，你花費 1 個術法點並選擇數量不超過你的魅力調整值的生物（最少一個生物）。被選中的生物自動成功通過該法術的豁免檢定。

遠距法術

當你施展射程為 5 呎或以上的法術時，你可以花費 1 點術法點來使法術射程加倍。

當你施展具有接觸範圍的法術時，你可以花費 1 個術法點來使法術的範圍達到 30 呎。

強化法術

當你投擲法術傷害時，你可以花費 1 個術法點來重新投擲一定數量的傷害骰子，最多可達你的魅力調整值（最少 1 個）。你必須使用新的擲骰結果。

即使你在施法期間已經使用了不同的超魔法選項，你也可以使用強化法術。

延長法術

當你施展持續時間為 1 分鐘或更長的法術時，你可以花費 1 個術法點來使其持續時間加倍，最長持續時間為 24 小時。

強化法術

當你施放一個法術，迫使一個生物進行豁免檢定來抵抗其效果時，你可以花費 3 點魔法值，使一個目標在對抗該法術的第一次豁免檢定中處於劣勢。

加速法術

當你施放一個施法時間為 1 個動作的法術時，你可以花費 2 個術法點將施法時間改為該施法的 1 個附贈動作。

無聲法術

當你施展法術時，你可以花費 1 個法術點來施展它，而無需任何軀體或言語成分。

雙生法術

當你施展的法術沒有自身範圍並且無法以該法術當前等級瞄準多個生物時，你可以花費等於該法術等級的術法點來用相同法術瞄準範圍內的第二個生物（如果該法術是戲法，則為1術法點）。
note.lvl03_details_en:
Metamagic

At 3rd level, you gain the ability to twist your spells to suit your needs. You gain two of the following Metamagic options of your choice. You gain another one at 10th and 17th level.

You can use only one Metamagic option on a spell when you cast it, unless otherwise noted.

Choose one of the following:

Careful Spell

When you cast a spell that forces other creatures to make a saving throw, you can protect some of those creatures from the spell's full force. To do so, you spend 1 sorcery point and choose a number of those creatures up to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one creature). A chosen creature automatically succeeds on its saving throw against the spell.

Distant Spell

When you cast a spell that has a range of 5 feet or greater, you can spend 1 sorcery point to double the range of the spell.

When you cast a spell that has a range of touch, you can spend 1 sorcery point to make the range of the spell 30 feet.

Empowered Spell

When you roll damage for a spell, you can spend 1 sorcery point to reroll a number of the damage dice up to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one). You must use the new rolls.

You can use Empowered Spell even if you have already used a different Metamagic option during the casting of the spell.

Extended Spell

When you cast a spell that has a duration of 1 minute or longer, you can spend 1 sorcery point to double its duration, to a maximum duration of 24 hours.

Heightened Spell

When you cast a spell that forces a creature to make a saving throw to resist its effects, you can spend 3 sorcery points to give one target of the spell disadvantage on its first saving throw made against the spell.

Quickened Spell

When you cast a spell that has a casting time of 1 action, you can spend 2 sorcery points to change the casting time to 1 bonus action for this casting.

Subtle Spell

When you cast a spell, you can spend 1 sorcery point to cast it without any somatic or verbal components.

Twinned Spell

When you cast a spell that doesn't have a range of self and is incapable of targeting more than one creature at the spell's current level, you can spend a number of sorcery points equal to the spell's level to target a second creature in range with the same spell (1 sorcery point if the spell is a cantrip).
note.lvl04_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到4級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此特性將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl04_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 4th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl06_details_zh:
術法起源特性

在第 6 級時，你獲得了你的術法起源所賦予的特性。

術法起源選項

龍族血脈

元素親和力

從 6 級開始，當你施放一個造成與你的龍類血統相關類型傷害的法術時，將你的魅力調整值加到一次傷害檢定中。

此外，你可以花費1點魔法點數來獲得對該傷害類型的抵抗力，持續1小時。

狂野魔法

彎曲運氣

從 6 級開始，你就有能力使用狂野魔法扭轉命運。當你看到的另一個生物進行攻擊檢定、能力檢定或豁免檢定時，你可以使用你的反應並花費 2 個法術點進行 1d4 擲骰，並將擲出的數字作為加值或懲罰（你的選擇）應用到該生物的擲骰上。你可以在生物擲骰後但在擲骰的任何效果發生之前執行此操作。
note.lvl06_details_en:
Sorcerous Origin feature

At 6th level, you gain a feature granted by your Sorcerous Origin.

Sorcerous Origin Options

Draconic Bloodline

Elemental Affinity

Starting at 6th level, when you cast a spell that deals damage of the type associated with your draconic ancestry, add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll.

In addition, you can spend 1 sorcery point to gain resistance to that damage type for 1 hour.

Wild Magic

Bend Luck

Starting at 6th level, you have the ability to twist fate using your wild magic. When another creature you can see makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can use your reaction and spend 2 sorcery points to roll 1d4 and apply the number rolled as a bonus or penalty (your choice) to the creature's roll. You can do so after the creature rolls but before any effects of the roll occur.

術法起源特性

在 14 級時，你獲得了你的術法起源所賦予的特性。

術法起源選項

龍族血脈

龍翼

14級時，你獲得從背後長出一對龍翼的能力，並獲得與你目前速度相同的飛行速度。你可以在你的回合中創造這些翅膀作為附贈動作。它們會一直持續到你在輪到你時將它們作為附贈動作解散為止。

穿著盔甲時你無法顯現你的翅膀，除非盔甲是為了容納它們而製造的，而不是為了容納你的翅膀而製造的衣服可能會在你顯現它們時被摧毀。

狂野魔法

受控混沌

14級時，你對狂野魔法的湧動有了一定的控制力。每當你在狂野魔法湧動桌上滾動時，你可以滾動兩次並使用任一數字。
note.lvl14_details_en:
Sorcerous Origin feature

At 14th level, you gain a feature granted by your Sorcerous Origin.

Sorcerous Origin Options

Draconic Bloodline

Dragon Wings

At 14th level, you gain the ability to sprout a pair of dragon wings from your back, gaining a flying speed equal to your current speed. You can create these wings as a bonus action on your turn. They last until you dismiss them as a bonus action on your turn.

You can't manifest your wings while wearing armor unless the armor is made to accommodate them, and clothing not made to accommodate your wings might be destroyed when you manifest them.

Wild Magic

Controlled Chaos

At 14th level, you gain a modicum of control over the surges of your wild magic. Whenever you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table, you can roll twice and use either number.

術法起源特性

在 18 級時，你獲得了由你的術法起源所賦予的特性。

術法起源選項

龍族血脈

龍的存在

從 18 級開始，你可以引導龍祖先的可怕存在，讓你周圍的人感到敬畏或恐懼。作為一個動作，你可以花費 5 個法術點數來利用這種力量，並在 60 呎的距離內散發出敬畏或恐懼的光環（由你選擇）。在 1 分鐘內或直到你失去注意力（就像你正在施展集中法術一樣），在此光環中開始其回合的每個敵對生物都必須成功通過感知豁免檢定，或者被迷住（如果你選擇敬畏）或受到驚嚇（如果你選擇恐懼），直到光環結束。成功通過此豁免的生物將在 24 小時內免疫你的光環。

狂野魔法

法術轟炸

從 18 級開始，你的法術的有害能量會增強。當你對法術擲出傷害並在任何骰子上擲出盡可能高的數字時，選擇其中一個骰子，再次擲骰子並將該骰子加到傷害中。每回合只能使用該特性一次。
note.lvl18_details_en:
Sorcerous Origin feature

At 18th level, you gain a feature granted by your Sorcerous Origin.

Sorcerous Origin Options

Draconic Bloodline

Draconic Presence

Beginning at 18th level, you can channel the dread presence of your dragon ancestor, causing those around you to become awestruck or frightened. As an action, you can spend 5 sorcery points to draw on this power and exude an aura of awe or fear (your choice) to a distance of 60 feet. For 1 minute or until you lose your concentration (as if you were casting a concentration spell), each hostile creature that starts its turn in this aura must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed (if you chose awe) or frightened (if you chose fear) until the aura ends. A creature that succeeds on this saving throw is immune to your aura for 24 hours.

Wild Magic

Spell Bombardment

Beginning at 18th level, the harmful energy of your spells intensifies. When you roll damage for a spell and roll the highest number possible on any of the dice, choose one of those dice, roll it again and add that roll to the damage. You can use the feature only once per turn.
